blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: How an object deforms when it hits the ground reveals what it is made of. From a single real video of a drop, we estimate a deformable object's density-normalized stiffness $E/ρ$, and its yield stress $σ_Y/ρ$ when the impact causes plastic deformation, with a feed-forward predictor trained only in simulation. Real videos carry no material labels, so such predictors are developed and validated on synthetic data alone. We show that synthetic validation ranks their geometric inputs in the wrong order. Material acts through 3D deformation, and tracklets lifted to 3D with estimated depth are indeed the most accurate input in simulation. However, on real drops they are the least accurate, and better depth does not repair them: the failure persists with simulator depth in training, LiDAR depth at test time, and exact depth on rendered replays of the real drops. Short 2D optical-flow tracklets do the opposite: they improve nothing in simulation, yet they transfer best. Material is therefore better read from what perception measures consistently in both domains than from what is most informative in simulation. Our predictor, PhysReader, reads the video and 2D tracklets and learns the lift to 3D in simulation by matching a teacher that sees exact 3D deformation. To measure transfer, we introduce PhysReader-Real: 16 everyday objects dropped five times each, with reference materials fit jointly to each object's drops and checked against tensile tests. On PhysReader-Real, PhysReader is closer to the reference materials than every other input and baseline. The one exception is a per-scene optimizer started from PhysReader's prediction, which ends slightly closer but takes 49 minutes per video instead of 12 seconds.
blocks.zh: 物体撞到地时如何变形,揭示出它是由什么而来. 从一个真实的下降视频中,我们估计出一个可变形物体的密度常态性硬度 $E/ρ$,及其产量应力 $σ_$ 当撞击导致塑性变形时,Y/ρ美元,其向导预测器仅接受模拟训练. 真实的视频没有材料标签,因此此类预测器仅在合成数据上进行开发和验证. 我们显示,合成验证将它们的几何输入按错误顺序排列. 材料通过3D变形发生作用,被提升到有估计深度的3D轨道确实是模拟中最准确的输入. 然而,在实际投放时,它们是最不准确的,更好的深度并不能修复它们:在训练中,失败继续存在模拟深度,测试时的LiDAR深度,以及所渲染出的真实投放的精确深度回放. 短的2D光学流轨则做相反的事情:它们在模拟中没有任何改进,然而它们传输最好. 因此,比起模拟中最翔实的内容,材料更能从这两个领域一致的什么感知度量来解读。 我们的预测者PhysReader读取了视频和2D轨迹,并在模拟中通过匹配一个看到精确3D变形的老师来学习升到3D. 为了测量转录,我们引入了PhysReader-Real:每天有16个物体每投出5次,参考材料与每个物体的出射相匹配,并与抗拉强度测试相匹配. 在PhysReader-Real上,与所有其他输入和基线相比,PhysReader更接近于参考材料. 一个例外是从PhysReader的预测开始的每个场景优化器,它结束稍近,但每个视频需要49分钟而不是12秒.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : What a drop reveals, and what transfers. A predictor trained only in simulation estimates an object’s material from a video of its drop. Should it read 2D optical-flow tracklets (blue) or the same tracklets lifted to 3D with estimated depth (orange)? Lifting lowers the error slightly in simulation (left) but raises it sharply on real drops (right). Observed video: the drop at impact (earlier and later frames translucent), the 2D tracklets, and the 3D tracklets, rotated to show depth. Re-simulation: the drop re-simulated from the same initial state with the true material (simulation) or a reference material fit to the object’s drops (real), and with the materials predicted by PhysReader trained on 2D tracklets and by the same model trained on 3D tracklets. Color shows strain at impact (scales differ), and log E is log 10 \log_{10} of Young’s modulus in Pa. Both predictions are close to the truth in simulation, but on the real drop the 3D one is far too soft. Error: averaged over all validation clips and real drops, in dex ( log 10 \log_{10} units); real drops are scored by their distance to the plausible region, the materials that reproduce the object’s drops. The 3D tracklets look noisier on the real drop, but even better depth does not close the gap (Sec. 5.3).

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Dropping an object on the floor is a quick test of what it is made of: a plush toy flattens on impact, while a plastic bin barely deforms.
Reading this response from a single video as simulation-ready material parameters would let us build physical digital twins of everyday objects and re-simulate observed scenes under new conditions [ 82 , 36 , 13 ] .
A drop is a convenient probe, since gravity and ground contact are the only external forces, but it reveals material only briefly.
Before contact, the motion depends only on the initial state, and after contact, the bounce depends on the initial pose and velocity as much as on the material.
What singles out the material is local deformation at impact (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
将一个物体丢在地板上是对它是由什么构成的快速测试:在撞击时有一个加的玩具扁平,而一个塑料桶几乎没有变形.
从一个视频中读到这个反应,作为模拟准备的材料参数,将使我们能够建立日常物体的物理数字双胞胎,并在新的条件下重新模拟观测到的场景[82、36、13]。
下降是一种方便的探测器,因为重力和地面接触是唯一的外部力量,但它只短暂地揭示出物质.
在接触前,运动只取决于初始状态,在接触后,弹跳与材料一样取决于初始姿势和速度.
哪些材料是撞击时局部变形(图1)。

blocks.en:
Per-scene inverse simulation searches for the material whose simulation best matches pixels, depth, flow, silhouettes, or a generated video [ 44 , 90 , 87 , 50 , 36 , 63 ] .
Each video needs a new search, and an overly stiff object launched slightly differently can follow nearly the observed path, so the result depends strongly on where the search starts (Table 5 ).
Feed-forward predictors amortize the search [ 13 , 47 , 85 ] .
When trained in simulation, they must transfer to real footage zero-shot, and since real videos carry no material labels, these methods are developed and validated on synthetic data alone.
blocks.zh:
对模拟最符合像素、深度、流量、硅胶或生成的视频[44、90、87、50、36、63]的材料进行场景反向模拟搜索。
每段视频都需要新的搜索,发射的过于僵硬的物体略有不同,可以接近观测到的路径,因此结果在很大程度上取决于搜索的开始地点(表5).
Feed-warward预测器对搜索进行摊销[13,47,85].
在接受模拟训练时,他们必须转移到真实的镜头零镜头,由于真实的视频没有材料标签,这些方法仅靠合成数据就得到开发和验证.

blocks.en:
Which geometric input should such a predictor read beside the video?
Material acts through 3D deformation: from the exact deformation of the whole object surface, a network recovers E / ρ E/\rho with a mean error of 0.145 dex in simulation, where 1 dex is a factor of ten (Table 3 ).
The natural input is therefore optical-flow tracks lifted to 3D with estimated depth, and synthetic validation agrees: these lifted tracklets are the most accurate geometric input in simulation.
blocks.zh:
视频旁边应该读到哪个几何输入?
物质行为通过3D变形:从整个物体表面的精确变形中,一个网络恢复了E / ^ E/\rho,模拟中的平均误差为0.145 dex,其中1 dex为系数10(表3).
因此,自然输入是光学流轨提升到有估计深度的3D,合成验证同意:这些被解除的轨道是模拟中最精确的几何输入.

blocks.en:
On real drops, the order reverses.
With the video backbone, training data, and protocol fixed, lifted tracklets are the least accurate input, worse than the same tracklets kept in 2D on 12 of 16 objects (Table 1 , Fig. 4 ).
Better depth does not repair them: the failure persists with simulator depth or another depth estimator in training, with LiDAR depth on the real videos, and even with exact depth on rendered replays of the real drops (Sec. 5.3 ).
2D optical-flow tracklets do the opposite. Added to the video, they leave the synthetic error unchanged, yet they give the largest gain on real drops.
Staying in 2D also costs little: in simulation, adding exact depth to the 2D tracklets lowers the error by only 0.065 dex (Table 3 ). Material is better read from what perception measures consistently in both domains than from what is most informative in simulation. Synthetic validation misses this because it shares the training distribution, whereas renders of the target scenes, which need scans but no material labels, rank the inputs far more faithfully (Kendall τ \tau of + 0.50 +0.50 vs. − 0.71 -0.71 with real error; Table 2 ).
blocks.zh:
在真正的滴,顺序反转。
有了视频主干线,培训数据和协议固定了,升空的轨道是最不准确的输入,比16个物体中12个物体的2D保存的相同轨道更糟糕(表1,图4)。
更好的深度并不能修复它们:失败在训练中持续使用模拟深度或另一个深度估计器,在真实视频中使用LiDAR深度,甚至在渲染的重播中也使用精确深度真实滴滴(第5.3节).
2D光学流轨则相反. 加入到视频中,他们保留了合成错误不变,然而却在真实投注上贡献了最大的收益.
停留在2D中成本也很小:在模拟中,在2D轨道上添加精确的深度,将误差降低0.065 dex(表3 ). 材料比模拟中最丰富的材料更能从这两个领域中一致的什么感知度量中读取出来。 合成验证错过了这一点,因为它分享了训练分布,而使需要扫描但没有材料标签的目标场景更忠实地排列输入(Kendall \ tau + 0.50+ 0.50对 − 0.71-0.71有实际错误;表2)。

blocks.en:
Pose estimation offers a precedent: 3D pose can be lifted from detected 2D keypoints by networks trained without images [ 54 ] , and keypoint-based object-pose estimators [ 59 ] can be trained on synthetic images alone [ 73 ] .
Our predictor, PhysReader, follows this recipe: perception supplies a 2D measurement, and the step to 3D is learned in simulation.
It reads the video with a pretrained backbone [ 2 ] and short optical-flow tracklets [ 76 ] , needs no depth at test time, and is trained to reach the feature space of a teacher that sees exact 3D deformation (Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh:
Pose估计提供了一个先例:3D姿势可以通过未经图像培训的网络从检测到的2D键点上解脱[54],基于键点的物体-pose估计器[59]可以单独接受合成图像培训[73].
我们的预测器PhysReader遵循了这个配方:感知提供2D测量,步骤到3D是在模拟中学习的.
它读取视频时使用预先训练的骨干[2]和短的光学流轨[76],在测试时不需要深度,并且经过训练可以到达一个看到精确3D变形的老师的特征空间(图2).

blocks.en:
To measure transfer, we build PhysReader-Real: 16 everyday deformable objects, each dropped five times in different orientations, and 40 recordings of one object under varied viewpoint, distance, background, and lighting.
Reference materials are fit jointly to the five drops of each object, with every comparably fitting material kept as a plausible region, and tensile tests place seven of eight references within or close to the measured range (Sec. 4 ).
On PhysReader-Real, PhysReader is closer to the references than every other input and every feed-forward, vision-language, and agent baseline, and the materials it predicts reproduce the observed deformation best of all methods.
Of the per-scene optimizers started from its predictions, only one ends slightly closer, after 49 minutes per video instead of 12 seconds (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh:
为了测量转录,我们构建了PhysReader-Real:16个日常可变形物体,每个物体在不同的方向下落下5次,在不同的视角,距离,背景,和照明下对一个物体进行40次录音.
参考材料与每个物体的5个滴合在一起,每个可比较的配制材料都保持为可信的区域,抗拉强度测试将8个参考材料中的7个置于或接近测量范围(第4节)。
在PhysReader-Real上,PhysReader比其他每一个输入和每一个向导,视觉语言,和剂基线都更接近参考,它预测的材料会复制所有方法中观测到的变形最佳.
每个场景优化器中,只有1个从预测开始,在每段视频49分钟而不是12秒(表5)之后稍近一点结束。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are: • A controlled study showing that synthetic validation misranks the inputs of a simulation-trained material predictor: tracklets lifted with exact, estimated, or sensor depth do not transfer, 2D optical-flow tracklets do, and renders of the target scenes rank the inputs far better. • PhysReader, a feed-forward predictor trained only in simulation that reads density-normalized stiffness and yield stress from video and 2D tracklets. • PhysReader-Real, a benchmark of repeated real drops with multi-drop reference materials checked against tensile tests.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们的贡献是: 控制研究显示,合成验证对模拟训练材料预测器的投入有误:精确、估计或传感器深度的轨迹不会转移,2D光学流轨迹会转移,使目标场景对投入的排名要好得多。 • 支助 PhysReader是一个向导的预测器,只受过模拟训练,能够读取密度常态化的僵硬度,并从视频和2D轨道产生应力. • PhysReader-Real,是经过抗拉强度测试的多滴参考材料反复实际下降的基准。

blocks.en: A controlled study showing that synthetic validation misranks the inputs of a simulation-trained material predictor: tracklets lifted with exact, estimated, or sensor depth do not transfer, 2D optical-flow tracklets do, and renders of the target scenes rank the inputs far better.
blocks.zh: 一项可控研究显示,合成验证对模拟训练材料预测器的输入有误:有精确、估计或传感器深度的轨迹不会转移,2D光学流轨迹会转移,使目标场景对输入的排序要好得多。

blocks.en: PhysReader, a feed-forward predictor trained only in simulation that reads density-normalized stiffness and yield stress from video and 2D tracklets.
blocks.zh: PhysReader是一个向导的预测器,只受过模拟训练,能够读取密度常态化的僵硬度,并从视频和2D轨道产生应力.

blocks.en: PhysReader-Real, a benchmark of repeated real drops with multi-drop reference materials checked against tensile tests.
blocks.zh: PhysReader-Real,是经过抗拉强度测试的多滴参考材料反复真实下降的基准.

blocks.en:
Figure 2 : Overview of PhysReader. Training in simulation (left): ❶ a teacher encodes exact 3D deformation, available only in simulation, into a feature 𝒇 T \boldsymbol{f}_{T} , from which material heads predict E / ρ E/\rho and σ Y / ρ \sigma_{Y}/\rho (loss ℓ \ell against the GT material).
❷ PhysReader sees only inputs that real video also provides: the RGB clip (V-JEPA 2 with LoRA), 2D optical-flow tracklets, and temporal and scale context.
It maps them to 𝒇 ^ T \hat{\boldsymbol{f}}_{T} and is trained to match 𝒇 T \boldsymbol{f}_{T} (loss d d ) and the material through a frozen copy of the teacher’s heads ( ℓ \ell ; Eq. 4 ). Inference in real (right): PhysReader alone predicts the material, without depth.
For evaluation, the prediction re-simulates the drop with density ρ \rho and Poisson’s ratio ν \nu , and we report the replay loss and the parameter distance to the plausible region of reference materials (Sec. 4 ).
2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Most methods that estimate physical parameters from video simulate candidate parameters and compare the result with the observation.
Early work fit cloth parameters to calibration videos by simulated annealing [ 6 ] or inferred object properties with a physics engine [ 79 ] .
Differentiable simulators [ 32 , 23 ] turned the search into gradient descent through simulation and rendering [ 34 ] .
Material has since been fit to multi-view videos [ 44 , 90 ] , depth scans [ 1 ] , point clouds [ 70 , 84 ] , sparse RGB-D videos [ 36 ] , or a single camera [ 63 ] .
Known equations can also be fit to a single video [ 26 ] .
Generative models supply another signal.
PhysDreamer fits a generated video [ 87 ] , Physics3D and OmniPhysGS distill video diffusion models [ 49 , 48 ] , and PhysFlow refines materials with optical-flow guidance from a generated video [ 50 ] .
Visual observation constrains material only weakly.
Jointly fit manipulations leave many plausible parameter combinations [ 84 ] , and per-scene fits of the same material can disagree [ 85 ] .
We use optimization only to build references for real videos, fitting one material across the five drops of each object (Sec. 4 ).
blocks.zh:
大多数从视频中估计物理参数的方法模拟候选参数,并将结果与观测结果进行比较.
早期的工作适合布料参数通过模拟肛门[6]或通过物理引擎推断物体属性来校准视频[79].
可区分模拟器[32,23]通过模拟和渲染[34],将搜索转化为梯度下降.
从此材料适合多景视频[44,90],深度扫描[1],点云[70,84],稀疏的RGB-D视频[36],或单摄像头[63].
已知的方程也可以适合单视频 [26].
基因模型提供另一个信号.
PhysDreamer符合生成的视频[87],Physy3D和OmniPhysGS蒸馏视频扩散模型[49,48],PhysFlow用生成的视频的光流引导精炼材料[50].
视觉观察只能对材料产生微弱的制约.
联合适配的操控会留下许多可能的参数组合[84],而同一种材料的每个场景可以不同意[85].
我们使用优化只是为了建立真实视频的参考,在每个物体的五滴之间配一个材料(第4节)。

blocks.en:
Learning amortizes this search.
From real videos, Physics 101 learns mass and density [ 80 ] , and Bouman et al . regress fabric stiffness from video statistics [ 8 ] .
For deformable objects, Vid2Sim predicts elastic parameters from a front-view video with a predictor trained on simulated drops, and refines them per scene [ 13 ] .
MatPhys predicts part-level spring-mass parameters from a single view [ 85 ] .
Analytic Dynamics aligns video features with a representation learned from privileged simulator states [ 47 ] .
UniPhy fits a per-object latent of a shared neural constitutive model [ 56 ] .
A parallel family infers materials from static appearance: through CLIP features distilled into 3D [ 42 , 33 ] , single images [ 18 , 58 ] , or the knowledge of language and vision-language models [ 86 , 67 , 41 , 12 ] .
Agents that write simulation code from video do not yet recover dynamics reliably [ 65 ] .
Appearance indicates what an object is typically made of, whereas the response of a specific object shows in how it deforms.
We read material from that deformation, and we score it against real material references rather than by rendering or replay quality alone.
Material representations and identifiability are reviewed in App. A .
blocks.zh:
学习会分期偿还这个搜索。
从真实的视频中,Physics 101学习了质量和密度[80],而Bouman等人则从视频统计中倒退出织物僵硬度[8].
对于可变形物体,Vid2Sim从一个前视视频中预测弹性参数,并用模拟投影技术训练的预测器,并精炼每个场景[13].
MatPhys从单一视角预测部分水平的弹簧质量参数[85].
Analytic Dynamics 将视频功能与从特权模拟器状态中学习到的描述相配合 [47].
UniPhy符合共享神经构象模型的每个对象潜伏[56].
平行的家族推断材料来自静态外观:通过CLIP特征蒸馏成3D[42,33],单图像[18,58],或语言和视觉语言模型的知识[86,67,41,12].
从视频中写入模拟代码的特工尚未可靠地恢复动态 [65].
外观表示一个物体通常是由什么构成的,而特定物体的反应则显示它是如何变形的.
我们从这种变形中读到材料, 我们根据真实的材料参考来评分, 而不是仅仅通过渲染或重播质量。
App.A审查了材料说明和可识别性。

blocks.en:
A predictor trained in simulation must cope with differences in appearance, sensing, and dynamics.
Domain randomization widens the training distribution [ 72 , 60 ] , and domain adaptation aligns the two domains with unlabeled real data [ 66 , 25 , 28 , 29 ] .
The target error of such a predictor is bounded by its source error plus a divergence between the domains [ 5 ] , although invariance alone does not guarantee transfer [ 88 ] .
A third strategy maps both domains to an intermediate representation with a smaller gap.
RISP predicts rendering-invariant states for system identification [ 52 ] .
In pose estimation, 2D keypoints play this role.
Lifting networks map them to 3D pose without seeing images [ 54 ] .
Object-pose estimators that detect them before solving for pose are robust to occlusion [ 59 ] and can be trained on synthetic images alone [ 73 ] .
Vision foundation models now supply candidate intermediates off the shelf, including depth [ 83 , 31 , 14 ] , optical flow [ 71 , 78 , 76 ] , point tracks [ 39 , 27 , 81 ] , and 3D and 4D reconstruction [ 74 , 37 , 51 ] .
They are benchmarked on scene-level geometry and motion.
We ask which of them keeps the material signal of a brief impact consistent across domains.
blocks.zh:
受过模拟训练的预测器必须处理外观、感知和动态方面的差异。
域随机化拓宽了训练分布[72,60],域适应将两个域与无标签的真实数据相协调[66,25,28,29].
这种预测器的目标错误被其源错误加上域间差异[5]所约束,尽管单是偏移并不能保证转移[88].
第三个战略将这两个领域描绘为中间代表,差距较小。
RISP预测系统识别的渲染-变异状态[52].
在假设中,2D关键点发挥这一作用.
将网络映射到3D的姿势而不见图像 [54].
在溶解成姿势之前探测到的物体-pose估计器是坚固的,可以隔离[59],并且可以单独接受合成图像的培训[73].
展望基础模型现在提供从架子上选择的中间体,包括深度[83,31,14],光学流[71,78,76],点轨[39,27,81],以及3D和4D重建[74,37,51].
它们以场景级几何和运动为基准.

blocks.en: 3.2 Training in Simulation
blocks.zh: 3.2 模拟培训

blocks.en:
PhysReader-Sim consists of simulated drops of Objaverse meshes [ 20 ] , filtered for unsuitable geometry [ 45 ] and rendered from multiple cameras. Material parameters are randomized independently of semantics and appearance: E ∈ [ 10 ​ kPa , 1 ​ GPa ] E\in[10\,\mathrm{kPa},1\,\mathrm{GPa}] , σ Y ∈ [ 100 ​ kPa , 20 ​ MPa ] \sigma_{Y}\in[100\,\mathrm{kPa},20\,\mathrm{MPa}] , ν ∈ [ 0.10 , 0.45 ] \nu\in[0.10,0.45] , and ρ ∈ [ 100 , 2000 ] ​ kg / m 3 \rho\in[100,2000]\,\mathrm{kg/m^{3}} .
Scales, camera distances, initial orientations, and drop heights ( 0.25 0.25 – 0.75 0.75 m) vary. Videos have 60 frames at 30 fps. Backgrounds from MIT Indoor67 [ 62 ] , lighting, motion blur, and compression are randomized.
Training and validation are split 0.95 : 0.05 by object (App. F ).
In both domains, we extract optical flow with WAFT [ 76 ] , depth with 4RC [ 51 ] , and object masks with SAM 3.1 [ 10 ] . Every geometric input the predictor sees is therefore estimated rather than simulator-derived.
We use a 16-frame window from C − 3 C-3 to C + 12 C+12 around the collision frame C C . One square crop around the union of masks is expanded by 15% and resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 . Depth is made metric with one robust scale per video clip, taken from rendered depth in simulation and from registered LiDAR depth on real videos (App. F ).

blocks.en: 4 PhysReader-Real Benchmark
blocks.zh: 4 读数-读数基准

blocks.en: Figure 3 : PhysReader-Real. Left: the 16 objects, each dropped five times in different orientations. Right: for the 8 objects we cut specimens from, the reference stiffness fit jointly to the five drops (dot) and its plausible region (blue) against the measured stiffness of tensile specimens (gray).

blocks.en:
PhysReader-Real contains 16 everyday objects of different material types and geometries. Each is dropped five times in different orientations and recorded at 960 × 720 960\times 720 . A supplementary set contains 40 videos of a plush toy, Kitty, under varied camera angles, backgrounds, distances, and lighting, ten per condition.
We scan the static scene with an iPhone LiDAR camera using Record3D [ 68 ] and reconstruct an object mesh, which gives the simulator an explicit surface for internal filling (App. F ). We then fix the camera, release the object from a mechanical gripper, and clip each drop to 60 frames at 30 fps.
blocks.zh:
PhysReader-Real包含16个不同材料类型和几何的日常对象. 每种都在不同方向上投下5次,记录在960×720960\时间720. 一个补充的集包含40个视频,一个加的玩具,凯蒂,在不同的相机角度,背景,距离,和照明,每个条件10个.
我们用一台使用Record3D [68] 的 iPhone LiDAR 相机扫描静态场景,并重建一个物体网格,使模拟器有一个清晰的表面进行内部填充(App. F). 然后我们修复摄像头, 释放物体 从机械的钳子, 和每个滴到60帧 在30英尺。

blocks.en:
Real videos carry no material labels, so we construct object-level references by fitting one material jointly to the five drops of each object.
Drops in different orientations load the object differently, as in system identification from repeated tests of one specimen [ 6 , 84 ] . This leaves the initial states less room to compensate for a wrong material. Each object shares material parameters θ i = ( E i , σ Y , i ) \theta_{i}=(E_{i},\sigma_{Y,i}) , while each drop has its own initial state η i , d \eta_{i,d} (position, orientation, and linear and angular velocity). Density and Poisson’s ratio are fixed per object (Tab. S2 ).
The objective combines four terms: object-center trajectory, image-plane pose, projected residual-flow thickness near the object boundary after removing the dominant affine motion, and local pair-distance changes along short tracks. In this way, local deformation, not only the trajectory, decides the material (App. L.2 ).
We alternate between two steps for up to four rounds. The first step refines each drop’s initial state with the material fixed. The second searches the shared material by Bayesian optimization [ 38 ] with the initial states fixed. We alternate because the projected deformation can be compared only after trajectory and pose are aligned.
blocks.zh:
真实的视频没有材料标签,所以我们构建对象级别参考,将每个对象的5个滴合在一起一个材料.
不同方向的投放对物体的载荷不同,例如从一个标本[6,84]的重复测试中得出的系统识别. 这就使得最初的状态更没有空间补偿错误的材料. 每个对象共享= (E i, σ i, i)\theta_{i}=(E_{i),\sigma_{Y, i})的物质参数, 而每滴都有自己的初始状态 ηi, d\eta_{i, d}(位置,方向,以及线性和角速度). 密度和Poisson的比例是固定的每个物体(Tab. S2 ).
目标结合了四个术语:物体中心轨迹,图像平面姿势,去除主轴运动后在物体边界附近预测的残流厚度,以及沿短轨的局部对距变化. 这样,局部变形,而不仅仅是轨迹,决定材料(App.L.2.).
我们轮流走两步 最多四轮 第一步用固定的材料来改进每滴的初始状态。 第二次搜索由巴伊西亚优化的共享材料[38],初始状态固定. 我们之所以交替,是因为预测的变形只能在轨迹和姿势一致之后才能进行比较。

blocks.en: Several coupled combinations of E E and σ Y \sigma_{Y} can explain the drops comparably well. From each reference, we therefore search outward along 32 directions in the ( log 10 ⁡ E , log 10 ⁡ σ Y ) (\log_{10}E,\log_{10}\sigma_{Y}) plane, with the initial states fixed. We keep the pairs whose multi-drop loss stays within a tolerance of the reference loss (App. I.1 ). They form a local plausible region rather than a unique label.

blocks.en: As in earlier checks of video-based estimates [ 8 , 19 ] , we compare our references with tensile tests of specimens cut from eight objects. Seven fall within or close to the measured range of Young’s modulus (Fig. 3 ). The recorded stress–strain curves do not reliably identify yield stress, so it is not compared (App. O ).

blocks.en:
Synthetic videos are scored by the mean absolute error of z E z_{E} and, for yield-excited windows, z Y z_{Y} , in dex (App. L.1 ).
On real videos, the first metric is the distance from a prediction 𝐳 ^ \widehat{\mathbf{z}} to the plausible region 𝒜 i \mathcal{A}_{i} of object i i , d param i , d = min 𝐳 ∈ 𝒜 i ⁡ ( z ^ E , i , d − z E ) 2 + m i , d ​ ( z ^ Y , i , d − z Y ) 2 , d_{\mathrm{param}}^{i,d}=\min_{\mathbf{z}\in\mathcal{A}_{i}}\sqrt{(\widehat{z}_{E,i,d}-z_{E})^{2}+m_{i,d}(\widehat{z}_{Y,i,d}-z_{Y})^{2}}, (5) where m i , d m_{i,d} indicates yield excitation in the reference simulation. Predictions inside the region score zero, and we average over drops.
The second metric measures whether the predicted material reproduces the observed drop. With the predicted material fixed, we refine each drop’s initial state. We then report the relative increase of the total and deformation replay losses over the reference material refined the same way, Δ i , d , m replay = ℒ i , d , m pred − ℒ i , d , m ref ℒ i , d , m ref × 100 % , m ∈ { total , deform } . \Delta^{\mathrm{replay}}_{i,d,m}=\frac{\mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{pred}}_{i,d,m}-\mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{ref}}_{i,d,m}}{\mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{ref}}_{i,d,m}}\times 100\%,\quad m\in\{\mathrm{total},\mathrm{deform}\}. (6) We also report Err ref \mathrm{Err}_{\mathrm{ref}} , which compares trajectory, pose, and Hencky strain between simulations with the predicted and the reference material from the same initial state (App. L.3 ).

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: All predictors are trained only on PhysReader-Sim and evaluated zero-shot on PhysReader-Real. Lower is better for all error metrics.
blocks.zh: 所有预测器都只接受PhysReader-Sim的训练,并在PhysReader-Real上评价零射. 下调更适合所有错误度量。

blocks.en:
Direct predictors and students are trained for five epochs with AdamW on 277,050 training and 14,588 validation videos.
The teacher is trained for ten epochs. Its epoch-8 checkpoint, selected on synthetic validation, is frozen.
We measure inference time per video with batch size one on one A100 GPU, including flow and masks.
Hyperparameters, appearance robustness, ablations, and the adaptation of external methods are in App. G , App. M , and App. L.9 .
App. R adds object-level intervals, per-epoch results, and other optimizer initializations, and App. P shows qualitative replays.

师为十载训. 其以合成验证方式选择的epoch-8检查站被冻结.
我们用一个A100 GPU的批量尺寸, 包括流量和口罩,
超参数,外观坚固性,冲洗,以及外部方法的调整,分别见App.G,App.M,和App.L.9.

blocks.en: 5.1 Does Simulation Accuracy Predict Real Accuracy?
blocks.zh: 5.1 模拟准确性是否真实准确性?

blocks.en: Table 1: Inputs in simulation and on real drops. Every model uses the same RGB branch, training data, and protocol, except the “tracklets only” rows. Syn.: z E z_{E} error on synthetic validation (dex). Real: distance to the plausible region, relative increases in total and deformation replay loss, and direct simulation difference (Sec. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 表1:模拟和真实下降的投入。 每个模型都使用相同的RGB分支,培训数据和协议,但“只跟踪”行除外. syn.: z E z_{E}合成验证错误 (dex). 真实性:与可信区域的距离,总和变形重播损失的相对增加,以及直接模拟差异(第4节)。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Simulation ranks the inputs backwards: stiffness error on synthetic validation and on real drops. Left: arrows connect each model with 2D flow tracklets to the same model with tracklets lifted to 3D (tracklets only, RGB + tracklets, and the two students). Every arrow leads to a lower error in simulation and a higher error on real videos. The feed-forward baselines (gray) are less accurate than PhysReader in both. Right: lifted tracklets, under each geometry condition of Table S7 , beat 2D flow tracklets in simulation and lose to them on real videos.
blocks.zh: 图4:模拟向后排列输入:合成验证和实投时的硬度误差. 左键:箭头将每个型号与2D流轨连接到同一个型号,将轨迹解除到3D(只有轨迹,RGB+轨迹,以及两个学生). 每个箭头都会导致模拟中较低的错误和真实视频中较高的错误. 饲料向导基线(gray)在两者中都不如PhysReader准确. 右:在表S7的每个几何条件下,在模拟中击败2D流轨,并在真实视频中输给它们.

blocks.en:
Table 1 compares geometric inputs under a fixed RGB branch, training set, and protocol.
In simulation, all inputs with RGB lie within 0.05 dex of each other, and tracklets lifted to 3D with estimated depth give the lowest error (0.444 dex).
On real drops, the order reverses.
Lifted tracklets are the least accurate input (parameter distance 1.210), worse even than 2D tracklets without RGB.
2D flow tracklets do not lower the synthetic error of RGB alone (0.482 vs. 0.478 dex), yet they give the largest real gain (0.745 vs. 0.797).
Selecting inputs by synthetic validation would have chosen the input that fails and given no reason to add the one that helps.
The reversal holds on 12 of 16 objects, with an average increase of 0.465 (paired object-level bootstrap, 95% interval [ 0.073 , 0.843 ] [0.073,0.843] ; App. R ), and at every training epoch (Table S21 ).
Figure 4 shows it for each pair of models that differ only in their tracklets (left), and for every combination of exact and estimated depth and tracks (right; Sec. 5.3 ).
Without RGB, lifted tracklets again win in simulation and lose on real drops (0.702 vs. 0.764; 1.337 vs. 1.080), so the reversal is not caused by the fusion with RGB.
Adding dense flow or depth to RGB changes little (0.833 and 0.789), and image-plane deformation cues add little to 2D tracklets (0.739).
2D tracklets without RGB transfer poorly (1.080), so the video backbone supplies context that the tracklets do not.
PhysReader, the student given 2D tracklets, lowers the parameter distance further to 0.677, with the smallest deformation replay increase (12.32%) and direct simulation difference (0.1072).
Its total replay increase, however, is higher than that of the direct 2D predictor (10.15% vs. 4.88%).
It is more accurate than the direct 2D predictor on 12 of 16 objects, but the paired 95% interval of the difference, [ − 0.136 , 0.009 ] [-0.136,0.009] , includes zero.
All predictors respond to material: in a held-out simulated sweep in which only E E changes, every RGB-based predictor orders stiffness correctly for 90–95% of pairs, against 71.45% for 2D tracklets alone (Table S10 ).
blocks.zh:
表1比较了固定RGB分支、培训集和协议下的几何输入。
在模拟中,所有带有RGB的输入都位于彼此的0.05 dex范围内,有估计深度的轨迹被提升到3D会给出最小错误(0.444 dex).
在真正的滴,顺序反转。
提升的轨道是最不准确的输入(参数距离1.210),甚至比没有RGB的2D轨道还要糟糕.
2D流轨并不降低单RGB的合成错误(0.482 vs. 0.478 dex),然而它们给出了最大的实际收益(0.745 vs. 0.797.
通过合成验证来选择输入会选择失败且没有理由添加帮助输入的输入.
16个物体中,有12个是倒置的,平均增加0.465个(标有物体级的靴子,间隔95%[0.073,0.843] [0.073,0.843];App.R]),在每个训练时代(表S21).
图4显示的是每对只有轨迹(左)有差异的模型,以及准确和估计深度和轨迹的组合(右;第5.3节)。
没有RGB,升起的轨迹在模拟中再次获胜,并在真实投注中输掉(0.702 vs. 0.764;1.337 vs. 1.080),因此逆转不是由与RGB的聚变引起的.
将密集的流量或深度添加到RGB变化很小(0.833和0.789),图像-平面变形提示小于2D轨道(0.739).
2D音轨没有RGB传输差(1.080),因此视频主干线提供上下文,而音轨没有.
PhysReader,学生给予2D音轨,将参数距离进一步降低到0.677,最小的变形回放增加(12.32%)和直接模拟差(0.1072).
然而,其总的重播增长高于直接2D预测器(10.15%对4.88%)。
它比16个物体中的12个的直立2D预测器更准确,但对应的95%的差值间隔[−0.136,0.009] [-0.136,0.009],包括0.
所有预测器都对材料做出回应:在只有E E 变化的悬浮模拟扫描中,每个基于 RGB 的预测器都正确命令90–95%的对子的硬度,而仅2D轨迹的硬度为71.45%(表S10 ) 。

blocks.en:
Table 2 asks how well each validation set orders the eight predictors that share the RGB branch.
Synthetic validation, drawn from the training distribution, is anti-correlated with real accuracy (Kendall τ \tau = − 0.71 -0.71 ) and selects a lifted model.
Renders of the real scenes, the real drops re-simulated with E E swept from 10 4 10^{4} to 10 9 10^{9} Pa (App. M.1 ), need scanned scenes but no material labels.
They correlate with real accuracy ( + 0.50 +0.50 ) and select PhysReader, though they do not separate the closely spaced RGB, flow, and 2D inputs.
Replays with the reference materials order the inputs as real video does ( τ \tau = 0.929), and four real objects with references select the best input for the remaining objects in 65.8% of subsets.

表2 询问每个验证设置对共享 RGB 分支的8 个预测器的指令有多好 。
从训练分发中抽取的合成验证,具有抗腐蚀性,真实准确性(Kendall \tau = − 0.71 - 0.71),并选择一个被解除的模型.
真实场景的渲染者,真实的滴滴重新与E E扫射相模拟,从10 4 10^{4}到10 9 10^{9}帕(App. M.1),需要扫描场景,但没有材料标签.
它们与真实准确性(+ 0.50+0.50)相关,并选择物理读取器,尽管它们没有将密闭的RGB,流量,和2D输入分开.
与参考材料重放按真实视频的顺序排序输入(\\tau = 0.929),四个带有参考物的真对象在65.8%的子集中选择其余对象的最佳输入.

blocks.en: Table 2: Which validation predicts transfer? Kendall’s τ \tau between each validation error and the real parameter distance over the eight predictors of Table 1 that share the RGB branch (without the depth-augmentation variant), and the predictor each would select (its real parameter distance). Intervals and the k k -object protocol are in App. R .

blocks.en: 5.2 Where Does the Error Come From?
blocks.zh: 5.2 错误来自何处?

blocks.en: Table 3: Error budget for log 10 ⁡ ( E / ρ ) \log_{10}(E/\rho) (MAE, dex). Each row is one step from the row above. Synthetic rows use the 10,202 validation videos on which every row is defined; real rows use the 80 PhysReader-Real drops, scored against the reference materials. Exact geometry comes from the simulator; flow tracks from WAFT [ 76 ] ; estimated depth from 4RC [ 51 ] .

Table 3 changes one source of error at a time.
With exact geometry, replacing simulator correspondences by optical-flow tracks costs 0.008 dex, and dropping depth costs 0.065 dex.
2D flow tracklets therefore keep most of what exact depth adds for this predictor.
Moving to real video costs the 2D model 0.313 dex, whereas the model on lifted tracklets, 0.034 dex better in simulation, loses 0.744 dex.
The largest synthetic step (+0.189 dex) separates the teacher, which reads exact deformation of the visible surface, from a predictor given exact 3D tracks of the same surface.
The teacher–student training of PhysReader targets this gap.
It leaves the synthetic error unchanged (0.481 vs. 0.482 dex) but improves every real-video measure in Table 1 except total replay.
Linear probes show that the student’s features retain strain of the visible surface ( R 2 = 0.625 R^{2}=0.625 ; teacher 0.726) better than strain near the ground (0.506; App. L.5 ).
blocks.zh:
表3一次改变一个错误来源.
用精确的几何学,用光学流轨取代模拟函式成本为0.008 dex,下降深度成本为0.065 dex.
2D流轨因此保留了这个预测器所添加的精确深度的大部分.
移动到真实的视频成本为2D型号0.313 dex,而升空轨迹上的型号0.034 dex在模拟中较好,损失为0.744 dex.
最大的合成步骤(+0.189 dex)将读取可见表面精确变形的老师与给定同一表面精确3D轨道的预测器分开.
PhysReader的师生培训以这一差距为目标。
它使合成错误保持不变(0.481 vs. 0482 dex),但除了总重播外,改进了表1中的每一个真视频量度.
线性探测仪显示,学生的特征保留了可见表面的菌株(R 2 = 0.625 R^{2}=0.625;教师0.726),优于接近地面的菌株(0.506;App.L.5).

blocks.en: 5.3 Why Does Lifting with Estimated Depth Fail?
blocks.zh: 5.3 为何抬高深度估计失败?

blocks.en: Table 4: Same drops, three domains: z E z_{E} error (dex) of epoch-5 predictors on synthetic validation, on rendered replays of the real drops, and on real videos. The second column names the training depth and its alignment (one scale per clip or frame). “Rendered” and “LiDAR” replace the estimated depth at evaluation. Dashes: not applicable.
blocks.zh: 表4:相同的滴滴,三个域:z E z_{E}epoch-5预测器在合成验证上的误差(dex),在真实滴滴的渲染重播上,在真实视频上. 第二栏命名了训练深度及其校准(每段或每帧一个比例尺). “招标”和“LiDAR”取代评价时的估计深度。 合同:不适用。

blocks.en:
To separate the representation from its estimation, we train the RGB + 3D tracklets predictor with each combination of simulator or 4RC depth and simulator or WAFT tracks (A–D; App. L.7 and Fig. 4 , right).
A model trained on exact geometry loses 0.12 dex when WAFT replaces simulator tracks but 0.41 dex when 4RC replaces simulator depth.
Training on 4RC depth removes this cost in simulation: these models are within 0.04 dex of those trained on simulator depth and insensitive to which depth they receive.
Yet all four lifted models remain 0.34–0.51 dex worse than 2D tracklets on real drops (1.132–1.305 vs. 0.792 dex).
blocks.zh:
为了将表示和它的估计区分开来,我们用模拟器或4RC深度和模拟器或WAFT轨迹(A–D;App.L.7和Fig. 4,右)的每个组合来训练RGB+3D轨迹预测器.
WAFT更换模拟轨道时,经过精确几何学训练的模型损失0.12 dex,但4RC更换模拟深度时损失0.41 dex.
关于4RC深度的培训消除了模拟中的这一成本:这些模型在接受模拟深度和不敏感深度培训的模型的0.04度以内。
然而,所有四个升起的型号都比实际投放的2D轨距(1.132-1.305对0.792 dex)差0.34-0.51。

blocks.en:
Better depth does not repair the transfer (Table 4 ).
4RC is the most accurate of the 17 depth estimators we tested on our data (App. L.6 ).
Depth Anything 3 [ 46 ] with per-frame scale lowers the synthetic error to 0.426 dex but raises the real error.
Replacing estimated depth with registered LiDAR depth on the real videos changes the error little (1.249 to 1.220 for the lifted model, 1.305 to 1.289 for A).
Training with depth augmentation (App. R ) reduces the real parameter distance from 1.210 to 0.928 but does not close the gap to 2D tracklets (0.745).
The gap already appears on rendered replays of the real drops, which share their objects, scenes, and initial states: lifted tracklets score 0.808 against 0.453 dex for 2D tracklets, and 0.809 with the renderer’s depth.
Model A, trained on simulator depth and tracks and given them on the replays, still scores 1.118.
This suggests that lifting ties the predictor to 3D statistics of the training scenes, which change with the scene and the sensor.
2D optical flow behaves alike across these shifts, and the free fall fixes the metric scale of image motion.
In domain-adaptation terms, the real error of a predictor is bounded by its synthetic error plus a divergence between the domains as seen through its input [ 5 ] .
Lifting with depth lowers the first term and raises the second.
blocks.zh:
更好的深度不能修复传输(表4)。
4RC是我们在数据上测试的17个深度估计器中最准确的(App.L.6).
深度 Anything 3 [46] 带有每帧尺度的将合成错误降低到0.426 dex,但提高了真实错误.
在真实视频上以注册的LiDAR深度取代估计深度,将错误改变得很小(解除型号为1.249到1.220,A为1.305到1.289).
深度增强的训练(App.R)将实际参数距离从1.210缩短到0.928,但不会将差距拉近到2D轨道(0.745)。
空隙已经出现在真实的滴滴的重播上,这些滴滴滴分享了它们的物体,场景和初始状态:解除的轨迹得分0.808,2D轨迹得分0.453 dex,而渲染器的深度为0.809。
型号 A,接受模拟深度和轨迹训练并在重播中给予它们,仍然得分1.118.
这表明提升将预测器与训练场景的3D统计联系起来,这些统计随场景和传感器而变化.
2D光学流在这些转变中表现得相同,自由掉落会固定图像运动的度量尺度.
在域适应术语中,一个预测器的真正错误被其合成错误加上通过输入所看到的域之间的差[5]所约束.
深处的升降会降低第一个术语,提高第二个术语。

blocks.en:
Lifted tracklets are also the least consistent input (App. L.8 ).
Across 40 recordings of one object under changed viewpoint, distance, background, and lighting, their predictions spread by 1.018 dex, against 0.241 for PhysReader and 0.309 for RGB.
Their predictions from real drops and from the rendered replays differ by 0.704 dex, against 0.530 for PhysReader, which also varies least across the five drops of an object (0.319 dex).
Analytic Dynamics, which reads object masks, is the most stable across the recordings (0.195 dex) but varies most across drops (0.613).
blocks.zh:
提升的音轨也是最不连贯的输入(App.L.8.
在改变视野、距离、背景和照明下对一个物体的40个录音中,其预测传播了1.018度,而PhysReader为0.241度,RGB为0.309度。
他们从真实的滴滴和被制成的重播的预测值相差0.704 dex,而PhysReader的预测值为0.530,在一个物体的五个滴滴滴(0.319 dex)中,两者也相差最小.
分析动态(Analytic Dynamics),它读作物体口罩,是整个录音中最稳定的(0.195 dex),但不同滴(0.613)差异最大.

blocks.en: 5.4 Comparison with Prior Methods
blocks.zh: 5.4 与先前方法的比较

blocks.en:
Table 5: Comparison with prior methods on real videos (Sec. 4 ), on all 80 drops.
PhysDreamer, PhysFlow, and MonoPhysics use Neo-Hookean elasticity and von Mises plasticity.
PhysTwin retains its mass–spring model.
For the per-scene optimizers, the initialization is given in parentheses.
blocks.zh:
表5:与真实视频(第4节),所有80滴的以往方法比较.
PhysDreamer,PhysFlow,以及MonoPhysics使用Neo-Hookean弹性和冯·米塞斯可塑性.
PhysTwin保留其质量-春季模型.
对于每个场景优化器,初始化在括号中给出.

blocks.en:
We compare with the per-scene optimizers PhysDreamer [ 87 ] , PhysFlow [ 50 ] , MonoPhysics [ 63 ] , and PhysTwin [ 36 ] , and with the feed-forward predictors of Vid2Sim [ 13 ] and Analytic Dynamics [ 47 ] .
We also compare with a vision-language model, GPT-6 Astra, given the first frame or the same 16 frames as our predictors (App. Q ), and with a Codex agent that estimates material parameters from the full video, given the object mesh and our MPM simulator (App. Q.1 ).
blocks.zh:
我们比较了人均场景优化器 PhysDreamer [87], PhysFlow [50], MonoPhysics [63],和 PhysTwin [36], 以及 Vid2Sim [13] 和 Analytic Dynamics [47] 的饲料预测器.
我们还与视觉语言模型GPT-6 Astra进行比较,考虑到第一个帧或与我们的预测器(App. Q)相同的16帧,以及考虑到对象网和我们的MPM模拟器(App. Q.1),与一个从完整视频中估计材料参数的Codex代理.

blocks.en:
PhysDreamer and PhysFlow run in our simulator on our meshes, MonoPhysics keeps its Gaussian representation and is evaluated through replay on our meshes, and all three use our fixed density and Poisson’s ratio.
PhysTwin keeps its mass–spring model and is compared through replay only, and PhysDreamer’s material field through its volume-weighted average (App. L.9 ).
blocks.zh:
梦与梦 MonoPhysics保留其高斯派代表身份, 并且通过回放来评估,
PhysTwin保留其质量-春季模型,仅通过重播进行对比,PhysDreamer的物质场则通过量加权平均值进行对比(App.L.9).

blocks.en:
PhysReader has the lowest deformation replay increase and the lowest direct simulation difference of all methods (Table 5 ), and it takes 12 s per video.
The other feed-forward predictors, the vision-language model, and the agent have a higher parameter distance than even our RGB-only predictor (0.797; Table 1 ).
The per-scene optimizers mostly end close to where they start.
From our predictions (0.677), PhysFlow reaches 0.668 and a lower total replay increase after about 49 minutes per video, and MonoPhysics reaches 0.698 in 17 minutes.
From a VLM-image prediction, as in its original paper, PhysFlow moves from 1.267 to 1.266, and from its original initialization, MonoPhysics moves from 1.972 to 1.933.
Only PhysDreamer moves far: from our predictions, it increases the parameter distance from 0.677 to 1.203.
blocks.zh:
PhysReader拥有最小的变形重播增量和所有方法的最小直接模拟差(表5),每个视频需要12 s.
其它向导预测器,视觉语言模型,以及剂的参数距离甚至比我们的RGB唯一预测器(0.797;表1)还要高.
每个场景优化器大多结束于它们开始的地方.
从我们的预测(0.677)来看,PhysFlow达到0.668,每段视频约49分钟后的总重播增加量降低,单曲在17分钟内达到0.698.
从VLM-图像预测,如其原始论文中,PhysFlow从1.267移动到1.266,从最初的初始化,MonoPhysics从1.972移动到1.933.
只有PhysDreamer移动很远:从我们的预测来看,它把参数距离从0.677增加到1.203.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
How an object deforms on impact reveals its material.
A predictor trained only in simulation can read it from real video if its input is measured alike in both domains.
Synthetic validation does not find that input.
Tracklets lifted with estimated depth are the most accurate input in simulation and the least accurate on real drops, for every training condition, depth estimator, and alignment we tried.
2D optical-flow tracklets lose little in simulation and transfer.
Renders of the target scenes rank the inputs far better.
We therefore suggest that simulation-trained estimators of physical properties validate their inputs on such renders rather than on the training distribution.
As with 2D keypoints in pose estimation, perception supplies a measurement that is consistent across domains.
The step to 3D is left to a network trained in simulation.
PhysReader, built on this choice, is closest to the reference materials among all inputs and baselines in their original form, in 12 s per video.
blocks.zh:
物体在撞击上的变形如何揭示其物质.
一个只受过模拟训练的预测器,如果其输入量在两个领域都相同,就可以从真实的视频中读取.
合成验证找不到该输入.
在模拟中最精确的输入 而在真实的下降中最不准确 对于我们尝试过的每一个训练条件 深度估计和校正
2D光学流轨在模拟和传输中几乎没有损失.
目标场景的播映量对投入排序要好得多。
因此,我们建议,经过模拟训练的物理特性估计器应验证其对此种物质的投入,而不是对培训分配的投入。
与提出估算的2D关键点一样,感知提供一种不同领域一致的计量。
步骤到3D则留给接受模拟训练的网络.
基于这个选择的物理阅读器最接近原始形式的所有输入和基线中的参考材料,每段视频为12s.

blocks.en:
PhysReader-Real covers 16 objects and 80 drops, recorded with one fixed camera and a gripper release; more objects and in-the-wild capture are left to future work.
It is costly to extend because every object needs a scan, repeated drops, and a multi-drop fit.
We therefore report object-level intervals (App. R ).
Tensile tests cover eight of the objects, since they destroy the specimen, and they check stiffness only.
Yield stress is determined only when the impact causes plastic deformation, so it is less constrained than stiffness.
The references are effective parameters of one homogeneous material under our simulator.
They are not intrinsic constants of each object, and they can depart from tensile measurements of cut specimens for structured objects.
blocks.zh:
PhysReader-Real覆盖了16个对象和80个滴滴,用一个固定的相机和抓取器释放来录制;更多的对象和闪闪闪发光的捕捉留给未来工作.
由于每个对象都需要扫描,重复的滴滴,以及多滴的配体,所以扩展成本很高.
因此,我们报告对象水平间隔(App.R)。
tensile测试覆盖了其中8个物体,因为它们摧毁了标本,它们只检查硬度.
只有在撞击导致塑性变形时才会确定 Yi应力,因此其约束性比硬度小.
参考文献是我们模拟器下一种同质材料的有效参数。
它们不是每个物体的内在常数,它们可以脱离对结构化物体切片标本的抗拉强度测量.

blocks.en: Appendix A Extended Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 扩大的相关工作

blocks.en:
Methods that estimate material from video differ in what they estimate and simulate.
Material can be one homogeneous parameter set per object [ 44 , 13 ] , one set per semantic part [ 85 ] , or a spatial field over particles, springs, or voxels [ 87 , 90 , 36 , 42 ] .
It drives a material point method [ 35 , 44 , 82 , 87 ] , a spring-mass system [ 90 , 36 ] , a finite-element model [ 1 ] , or a reduced model based on linear blend skinning [ 13 ] , and UniPixie predicts parameters for several of these solvers [ 33 ] .
Neural constitutive models relax the analytic material law [ 53 , 56 , 89 ] or learn residual corrections to it [ 75 , 21 ] , learned simulators replace the solver [ 64 , 61 ] , and FreeGave bypasses material parameters by learning per-Gaussian physics codes that drive a velocity field [ 43 ] .
Richer representations fit observed motion more closely but are harder to infer from one view and harder to compare across methods.
We use one homogeneous elastoplastic material per object in MPM: it cannot capture internal variation, but it yields a compact effective quantity that can be compared with references and measurements.
What a video can determine is also limited by physics.
Vibration-based methods recover the elasticity-to-density ratio of rods [ 19 ] and stiffness and density fields only up to a common scale [ 24 ] ; in a drop, gravity and inertia both scale with density, so we likewise predict E / ρ E/\rho (Sec. 3.1 ).
Finally, simulator-fitted parameters need not equal laboratory values: Arnavaz et al . found that manufacturer-specified silicone parameters did not reproduce the observed deformation in their simulator [ 1 ] .
Video-based estimates have been validated against measured or known properties of fabrics and rods [ 8 , 19 ] ; we compare impact-based reference materials of everyday objects with tensile tests.
blocks.zh:
估计视频材料的方法在估计和模拟方面有所不同。
材料可以是每个物体[44,13]的一个同质参数集,一个自语义部分[85],或粒子、弹簧或阴道上的空间场[87,90,36,42]。
它驱动一种物质点法[35,44,82,87],弹簧质量系统[90,36],有限元素模型[1],或基于线性混合物剥皮[13]的减量模型,UniPixie为其中几个解析器预测参数[33].
神经构象模型放松分析材料定律[53,56,89]或学习剩余校正[75,21],学习模拟器取代解析器[64,61],FreeGave通过学习驱动速度场的每个古西语物理代码绕过材料参数[43].
更丰富的表述更贴近观察到的运动,但更难从一种观点推断,也更难对各种方法进行比较。
我们使用一个同质异构材料在MPM中每个物体:它不能捕捉内部变异,但它产生一个紧凑的有效数量,可以与参照和测量相比较。
视频能够确定的东西也受到物理的限制.
基于振动的方法恢复棒的弹性-密度比[19],硬度和密度场的弹性-密度只达到共同的尺度[24];在下降,重力和惯性两个尺度的密度,因此我们同样预测E / ^ E/\rho(第3.1节).
最后,模拟-适配参数不需要等同的实验室值: Arnavaz等人发现,制造商指定的硅酮参数没有在其模拟器中复制所观察到的变形[1].
已对照布料和棒子的测量或已知特性验证了基于视频的估计数[8,19];我们比较了日常物体的撞击参考材料和抗拉强度测试。

Appendix C Physically Accurate MPM Simulator

blocks.en:
MPM represents matter with Lagrangian particles that store the complete history of strain and stress, while using a background Eulerian grid to evaluate spatial derivatives required for force calculations [ 35 , 69 ] .
Each time step proceeds in a particle-to-grid transfer (P2G), grid-processing, and grid-to-particle transfer (G2P) loop.
Below, we detail the standard formulation and our specific enhancements for physical accuracy.

每个时间步骤在粒子对电网传输(P2G),电网处理,以及电网对粒子传输(G2P)循环中进行.
下面我们详细介绍标准制定和具体提高物理准确性的情况。

blocks.en:
When the particles are near boundaries, the grid nodes outside the boundaries have their velocities clamped to 𝟎 \boldsymbol{0} .

We address this issue by fitting a local affine velocity field via moving least squares (MLS) with Tikhonov regularization and boundary pre-conditioning.

blocks.zh: 附录D 物理参数的缩放

blocks.en:
The reconstructed scenes used for the reference fit and the replays need an absolute metric scale, which the RGB-D scan provides; PhysReader itself reads no depth. To show why the scale matters, we analyze how a global rescaling of the reconstructed geometry affects the physical parameters used in simulation.
Specifically, suppose we isotropically scale the input point cloud by a factor s s . To keep the discrete equations dimensionally consistent, every quantity that carries the dimension of length must be rescaled by the appropriate power of s s . Poisson’s ratio still affects the simulation. It shows in how much the object expands sideways and changes its volume when it is compressed at impact. In exact 3D deformation this can be seen: the teacher, which reads it, predicts part of ν 
u (Fig. S15 , top row). In a video, the change is so small that it is hard to see in pixels (App. W ), and the student, which reads the video, does not learn ν 
u (Fig. S15 , bottom row). We therefore fix ν 
u per object (Table S2 ). Likewise, a drop without plastic deformation shows only that the yield stress was not reached; it does not give its value. These limits are why we predict the two ratios and mask the yield term for drops without plastic deformation. They do not mean that the ratios determine every aspect of the motion.
blocks.zh: Poisson的比例仍然影响着模拟。 它以显示物体在撞击时被压缩时会有多大的侧面膨胀并改变其体积. 确切的3D变形可以看见: 阅读它的老师预测了\nu(图S15,上行)的一部分. 在视频中,变化如此之小,难以在像素(App. W)中看到,而读视频的学生则不会学习\nu(图S15,下行). 因此,我们将每个物体固定(表S2)。 同样,没有塑胶变形的下降仅表明产量应力没有达到;没有给出其价值。 因此,我们预测这两个比率,并掩盖没有塑料变形的下降的产量。 它们并不意味着比率决定运动的方方面面。

blocks.en: Appendix F Data and Observation Processing Details
blocks.zh: 附录F 数据和观察处理细节

blocks.en: PhysReader-Sim has 291,769 simulated videos. We remove 131 whose estimated depth cannot be calibrated to metric scale (see below), for every model, including those that do not read depth. The remaining 291,638 videos are split by source mesh into 277,050 training and 14,588 validation videos (0.95 : 0.05); no mesh appears on both sides. Each simulated trajectory is rendered from up to three cameras, and all views of a trajectory stay in the same split. The replays of the real drops (Table 4 ) and the stiffness sweep (App. M.1 ) are simulated in the reconstructed real scenes and belong to neither split.
blocks.zh: PhysReader-Sim拥有291,769个模拟视频. 我们删除了131个其估计深度不能校准为计量尺度(见下文)的模型,包括不读深度的模型。 其余的291,638个视频按源网点划分为277,050个培训,14,588个验证视频(0.95:0.05);两侧没有网点出现. 每个模拟轨迹由最多三台相机进行渲染,所有轨迹的视线都停留在同一片段. 真实滴滴的重播(表4)和僵硬扫荡(App.M.1)都是在重建的真实场景中模拟的,属于两个不分裂的.

blocks.en: Each video is composited on one photograph from the MIT Indoor67 training set [ 62 ] , chosen by its sample seed. Premultiplied foreground color and alpha are warped together with stored flow, accumulated across 11 exposure samples, and composited on the photograph. Color is approximately linearized with exponent 2.2 before accumulation. Exposure is sampled in [ 0.5 , 1.0 ] [0.5,1.0] frame intervals. H.264 uses yuv420p, CRF 23–28, and the source frame rate.
blocks.zh: 每段视频都是在麻省理工学院室内67训练集的一张照片上合成的[62],由其样本种子选择. 预先多面的前景颜色和α与存储的流合在一起,累积在11个接触样品之间,并在照片上复合. 彩色在积累前大约呈线性化,并带有激素2.2. 接触在[0.5,1.0][0.5,1.0]帧间隔中取样。 H.264使用yuv420p,CFR 23–28以及源帧率.

blocks.en: Flow, depth, and masks are estimated from these composited, blurred, and compressed videos, not from the clean renders. SAM 3.1 is prompted with one box per frame. In simulation the box comes from the simulator’s silhouette of the object, enlarged to cover the exposure interval and by a margin of at most 4 pixels or 5%; on real videos we annotate the boxes by hand on the RGB frames. Masks select and validate the tracked points and define the crop. RGB, flow, and depth keep their background.
blocks.zh: 从这些混凝土、模糊和压缩的录像中,而不是从干净的制作中,估计出流动、深度和面具。 SAM 3.1是用每帧一个盒子来提示的. 在模拟中,这个盒子来自模拟器对物体的遮挡,被放大以覆盖曝光间隔,并用最多4像素或5%的边距;在真实的视频中,我们用手在RGB框架上对盒子进行注释。 面具选择和验证跟踪点并定义作物. RGB,流量和深度保持他们的背景.

blocks.en: On the real videos, we chose the collision frame C C by hand, once per video. It is the same for every model. The window has 16 RGB and depth frames, and a 17th RGB frame for the 16th forward flow. The object masks take up only a small portion of the original 960 × 720 960\times 720 frames, with different distributions in the synthetic (2.7%) and real videos (1.2%), so the same cropping rule is applied in both domains. A fixed union-of-masks square crop with 15% margin is applied to every frame and modality; individual frames are not recentered. The window is resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 . Flow vectors are rescaled into the same crop coordinates. Flow and depth are estimated on the full frames and cropped afterwards.
blocks.zh: 在真实的视频上,我们用手选择了碰撞帧C C,每段视频一次. 每个模特都一样 窗口有16个RGB和深度框架,以及第16个前进流的第17个RGB框架. 物体口罩只收录了原960×720 960\time720帧的一小部分,合成器(2.7%)和真视频(1.2%)的发行量不同,所以这两个领域都适用同样的裁剪规则. 每种框架和模式都采用15%的固定联合马鞍形平方作物;不更新单个框架。 窗口的大小调整为224×224/224\times 224 . 流矢量被重新调整成相同的作物坐标. 整个框架的流量和深度估计,然后收割。

blocks.en: We need to recover the metric scale of relative depth; App. D explains why scale matters for simulation and for the predicted ratios. For predicted camera- z z depth d ~ \widetilde{d} , reference depth d ref d_{\rm ref} , and valid paired calibration pixels 𝒫 \mathcal{P} , we use one positive scale for the whole clip, a robust scalar alignment: s = median p ∈ 𝒫 ⁡ d ref ​ ( p ) d ~ ​ ( p ) , d ⁡ ( p ) = s ​ d ~ ​ ( p ) . s=\operatorname{median}_{p\in\mathcal{P}}\frac{d_{\rm ref}(p)}{\widetilde{d}(p)},\qquad d(p)=s\widetilde{d}(p). (S3) Synthetic references use rendered metric depth; re-simulation references use the corresponding renderer depth. On real clips, d ref d_{\rm ref} is registered LiDAR depth and support is static background outside the union of object masks dilated by a 21 × 21 21\times 21 kernel. The scale is estimated on the first frame of the window that has at least 20 valid pairs (in simulation, among its first three frames) and is then kept for the whole clip. Simulated videos without such a frame are the 131 removed above. This is scale calibration, not a per-frame scale-and-shift fit: it avoids fitting a separate scale to the deforming foreground at every time step. No depth shift is added.

(S3)合成参考文献使用使度量深度;再模拟参考文献使用相应的渲染深度. 在真实的剪辑中,d ref d_{\rm ref}注册为LiDAR深度,支持为静态背景,在物体口罩的结合之外,由21×21 21\time 21内核放大. 比例尺是在窗口的第一帧上估计的,该帧至少有20个有效对(在模拟中,在它的前三个帧中),然后保留用于整个剪辑. 没有这种帧的模拟视频是上面删除的131段. 这是比例尺校准,而不是每帧比例尺和轮值配制:它避免了在每一步的变形前方安装单独的比例尺. 不添加深度变化 。

blocks.zh: 4RC运行在窗口的16帧上. 无效的深度被设定为零并标记为无效;有效的背景深度被保留.

blocks.en:
We place each object in a gripper, scan the static scene with Record3D, then open the gripper to start the drop and record it with the camera fixed.
The RGB-D sensor gives the absolute scale of the scene, on which the inferred parameters depend (App. D ).
We reconstruct the object mesh from the scan with the pipeline of ReconViaGen [ 11 ] : VGGT [ 74 ] gives a point cloud from multi-view images of the object, which is passed to the second and third stages of TRELLIS.2 [ 55 ] .
This gives one candidate mesh per scan, five per object; we pick the best one by hand, trim outliers, voxelize it, and fill holes from coarse to fine before converting it back to a mesh. Fig. S4 shows the meshes of the 16 objects and of the Kitty of the 40 additional recordings (App. L.8 ).
From the same scan, we also reconstruct the whole static scene as 3D Gaussians, with the gsplat implementation of Gaussian splatting in Nerfstudio. Among the baselines, MonoPhysics needs the object as 3D Gaussians; we initialize them from the particles of our object mesh (App. L.9 ). In these Gaussians, we segment the wooden platform and the object by hand. We align the scene so that the platform lies on the ground plane of the MPM simulation, at its center, with the x x – z z plane as the floor and the y y axis vertical, so that gravity is 𝒈 = [ 0 , − 9.8 , 0 ] ⊤ \boldsymbol{g}=[0,-9.8,0]^{\top} . The side of the platform on which the object lies sets the direction of the platform normal, that is, which way is up. The mesh is then placed at the segmented object, and its pose is refined for each drop against the video (Sec. 4 ).

这给每个扫描一个候选的网格,每个对象五个;我们用手挑一个最好的网格, 修剪外线,把网格化,然后在将网格转换回网格之前,把粗糙的洞填充到精细的洞中。 费格。 S4展示了16个物体的夹层和另外40个录音中的凯蒂的夹层(App.L.8 ).
从相同的扫描中,我们还重建了整个静态场景作为3D高斯人,在Nerfstudio中高斯人镀板的gsplat执行. 在基线中,单体物理需要对象作为3D高斯人;我们从对象网的粒子中初始化(App.L.9 ). 在这些高斯人中,我们用手把木质平台和物体分开. 我们把场景对齐,使平台位于MPM模拟的地面平面上,处于其中心,以xx – z 平面作为地板和y 轴垂直,因此引力是g= [0, – 9.8, 0]\\ boldsymbol{g}=[0,-9.8,0]\ top}. 物体所在的平台的侧面设定了平台正常的方向,即向上的方向. 然后将网格放置在切片对象上,其姿势在每滴对着视频(第4节)进行精细化.

blocks.en: G.1 Deformation cue definitions
blocks.zh: G.1 变形提示定义

blocks.en: We use short correspondences derived from optical flow rather than long correspondences from a point tracker, because the long-range trackers that we tested are not stable across our drops. On the 80 real drops, we tested eleven long-range trackers and tracker modes (App. V ). Each of them covers less than half of the object at the end of the window, C + 12 C+12 , in some drops: in 10 drops for the best one (CoWTracker), and in 16 to 67 drops for the others. Our short tracklets restart at window frames 0, 4, 8, and 11 and cover more than half of the object at C + 12 C+12 in every drop. Fig. S3 looks at one tracker in detail, CoTracker3, a successor of CoTracker [ 39 ] , in its online mode (App. P ). We start its points before the collision. About ten frames after the collision, it reports most of these points as no longer visible, because the object rotates and blurs. Tracks are propagated with Eq. ( 3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们使用来自光学流的短通信,而不是来自点跟踪器的长通信,因为我们测试的长程跟踪器在我们的滴滴之间并不稳定. 在80个真正的投篮上,我们测试了11个远程跟踪器和跟踪器模式(App.V.). 每一个都覆盖在窗口端的不到一半的物体,C+12 C+12,在一些下降中:在10个下降为最佳(CoWTRacker),在16到67个下降为其他. 我们在窗口框架0、4、8和11重新启动短轨,每滴C+12 C+12时覆盖超过半数的对象。 费格。 S3在其在线模式(App. 我们从碰撞开始 碰撞后约十帧,它报告这些点大部分已经不可见,因为物体旋转和模糊. 轨迹以Eq.(3)传播。

blocks.en: The models on 2D tracklets (RGB + 2D tracklets and PhysReader) read the 2D tracklets of the main paper directly, without derived cues. For each point i i and each frame t t of a tracklet, it receives the position 𝒑 i , r \boldsymbol{p}_{i,r} of the point in the reference frame r r , in which the tracklet starts, and the displacement from that position, both divided by the crop size of 224 pixels: 𝒈 i , t raw = [ 𝒑 i , r 224 , 𝒑 i , t − 𝒑 i , r 224 ] . \boldsymbol{g}^{\rm raw}_{i,t}=\left[\frac{\boldsymbol{p}_{i,r}}{224},\frac{\boldsymbol{p}_{i,t}-\boldsymbol{p}_{i,r}}{224}\right]. (S6) This input contains the local reference geometry and the motion of every point, which is what is needed to compute deformation. It is therefore more than the motion of the object’s centroid. The control uses the same graph and geometry encoder as the cue models.
blocks.zh: 2D音轨上的模型(RGB + 2D音轨和PhysReader)直接读取主纸的2D音轨,没有衍生的提示. 对于一个音轨的每个i点和每个帧 t t t, 它得到参考框 r r 中点的位置 p i, r\boldsymbol{p}_{i,r}, 即该音轨的起始位置, 以及该音位的移位, 两者除以224像素的农作物大小: g i, t 生 = [p i, r 224, p i, t - p i, r 224]. \ boldsymbol{ g}^{\rm} (中文(简体) ). r\ 224}\ frac\ boldsymbol{ p}_{i, t} -\ boldsymbol{ p}_{i, t}\ boldsymbol{ p}_{i, r}}{224}\\ n右 。 (S6)这个输入包含了每个点的局部参考几何和运动,这是计算变形所需要的. 因此,它不仅仅是物体的中间行星的运动。 控制器使用与提示模型相同的图形和几何编码器.

blocks.en: For a point i i and one of its neighbors j j , define the offset between the two points in the reference frame r r and in the current frame t t : 𝒂 i ​ j = 𝒑 j , r − 𝒑 i , r , 𝒃 i ​ j , t = 𝒑 j , t − 𝒑 i , t . \boldsymbol{a}_{ij}=\boldsymbol{p}_{j,r}-\boldsymbol{p}_{i,r},\qquad\boldsymbol{b}_{ij,t}=\boldsymbol{p}_{j,t}-\boldsymbol{p}_{i,t}. (S7) We robustly fit a local affine map from the reference offsets to the current offsets. The fit runs over the k k nearest neighbors 𝒩 k ​ ( i ) \mathcal{N}_{k}(i) of point i i , with the weights w i ​ j , t w_{ij,t} described below: 𝑨 i , t ( k ) = arg ​ min 𝑨 ∑ j ∈ 𝒩 k ​ ( i ) w i ​ j , t ∥ 𝒃 i ​ j , t − 𝑨 𝒂 i ​ j ∥ 2 2 . \boldsymbol{A}_{i,t}^{(k)}=\operatorname*{arg\,min}_{\boldsymbol{A}}\sum_{j\in\mathcal{N}_{k}(i)}w_{ij,t}\|\boldsymbol{b}_{ij,t}-\boldsymbol{A}\boldsymbol{a}_{ij}\|_{2}^{2}. (S8) We fit the map four times: first with Gaussian weights, then after each of three reweighting steps. The initial weight w i ​ j , t w_{ij,t} is zero for a neighbor that is not valid in frame t t . For a valid neighbor, it is a Gaussian function of the distance between the neighbor and point i i in the reference frame. At each reweighting step, the weight of neighbor j j is multiplied by an additional factor min ⁡ ( 1 , δ / max ⁡ ( e j , ϵ ) ) \min(1,\delta/\max(e_{j},\epsilon)) . Here e j e_{j} is the residual of neighbor j j in the previous fit, δ \delta is 1.5 times the median residual of the valid neighbors, and ϵ \epsilon is a small numerical floor. We reject a fit that has fewer than six valid neighbors. We also reject a fit whose reference Gram matrix, the Gram matrix of the weighted reference offsets 𝒂 i ​ j \boldsymbol{a}_{ij} , is ill-conditioned: the smallest eigenvalue of this matrix must exceed 10 − 3 10^{-3} times its largest eigenvalue, and it must exceed 10 − 8 10^{-8} in crop-pixel units. We also require that the fitted map is finite and that the eigenvalues of 𝑨 ⊤ ​ 𝑨 \boldsymbol{A}^{\top}\boldsymbol{A} lie between 10 − 6 10^{-6} and 10 4 10^{4} . blocks.en: G.2 Branch architecture
blocks.zh: G.2 分支结构

blocks.en:
Our models have three branches: RGB, geometry, and shared context.
The geometry branch reads either the 2D tracklets (RGB + 2D tracklets and PhysReader) or the deformation cues of App. G.1 (the cue models). We describe the cue version here; the input of the tracklet models is given in App. G.3 . The geometry branch reads the four tracklets (tracking windows), each with five time steps and up to 128 tracked points.
At each point and time, the combined 2D representation contains six strain, eight stretch, and two non-affine residual channels, computed at neighborhood sizes of 8 and 24.
We standardize each cue channel using fixed statistics computed from valid observations in the synthetic training split.
We then append three cue-validity indicators, one per cue family, and the five context values defined below. This gives a 24-dimensional input ( 16 + 3 + 5 16+3+5 ).
Unavailable cue families ( e.g . , not enough neighbors) are zeroed after standardization and identified by their validity indicators.
A pointwise linear layer followed by GELU maps this input to a 128-dimensional feature.
This width is fixed across cue variants; only the input projection size changes.
blocks.zh:
我们的模型有三个分支:RGB,几何,和共享上下文.
几何分支要么读取2D轨道(RGB + 2D tracklets and PhysReader),要么读取App.G.1的变形提示(提示模型). 我们在这里描述提示版本; 轨道模型的输入在 App 中给出 。 G.3 (英语). 几何分支读取4个轨迹(跟踪窗口),每个轨迹有5个时间步,最多128个跟踪点.
在每个点和时间,综合2D代表包含6个菌株,8个拉伸,以及两个非亚芬残留通道,按街区大小8和24计算.
我们利用从合成训练分解中的有效观察计算出来的固定统计数据,使每个线索通道标准化。
然后我们附加三个提示效果指标,一个提示家庭,以及下面定义的五个上下文值。 这给出了一个24维输入(16+3+5 16+3+5 ).
无法获取的提示家族(例如,没有足够的邻居)在标准化之后被零化,并通过其有效性指标加以识别。
GELU将这个输入图映射到128维特性之后的指向线性图层.
这个宽度被固定在提示变量之间;只有输入投影大小变化.

blocks.en:
Three spatial-temporal blocks update these point features.
Within each block, EdgeConv [ 77 ] computes messages from the same 24 reference neighbors, aggregates them by channel-wise maximum over valid neighbors, and adds the result through a residual connection with GELU.
A one-dimensional convolution then processes each point along its own track, with kernel size three and dilations 1, 2, and 4 in successive blocks.
The output of this convolution is rescaled by the number of valid time steps among its inputs. LayerNorm, GELU, and a residual connection follow.
Invalid point outputs remain zero.
Let 𝒉 w , t , i ∈ ℝ 128 \boldsymbol{h}_{w,t,i}\in\mathbb{R}^{128} be the final feature of point i i at time t t in window w w , and let 𝒱 \mathcal{V} contain the entries with at least one valid cue family.
We pool over all windows, times, and points: 𝒇 G = [ 1 | 𝒱 | ∑ ( w , t , i ) ∈ 𝒱 𝒉 w , t , i , max ( w , t , i ) ∈ 𝒱 𝒉 w , t , i ] ∈ ℝ 256 , \boldsymbol{f}_{G}=\left[\frac{1}{|\mathcal{V}|}\sum_{(w,t,i)\in\mathcal{V}}\boldsymbol{h}_{w,t,i},\quad\max_{(w,t,i)\in\mathcal{V}}\boldsymbol{h}_{w,t,i}\right]\in\mathbb{R}^{256}, (S14) where the maximum is channel-wise and an empty valid set gives a zero geometry feature.

三个空间时空块更新了这些点特征.
在每个块内,EdgeConv [77] 计算来自同一24个参考邻居的訊息,按照通道最大比有效邻居汇总,并通过与GELU的剩余连接添加结果.
然后沿着自己的轨迹进行一维演化, 内核大小为3, 并依次进行1,2和4。
这种革命的输出量根据其投入中有效时间步骤的数量重新调整. LayerNorm, GELU, 以及一个剩余连接后继.
无效点输出为零 。
让 h w, t, i \ boldsymbol{h}_{w, t, i}\in\ mathbb{R}^{128} 成为窗口 w 中 i 的终极特征, 让 V\ mathcal{V} 包含至少一个有效提示家族的条目 。
我们在所有窗口、时间和点数上游泳: f G = [1 | V ∑ (w, t, i ) ∈ Vh w, t, I, max (w, t, i) ∈ ∈ V h w, t, i] → R 256,\boldsymbol{ f}_{左 [\frac{ 1}{|\ mathcal{ V}|}\sum}\ in mathcal{ V}}\boldsymbol{h}_{w, t,i},\quad\max}(w,t,i)\ mathcal{v}_{右},(S14) 最大方向为频道方向,空有效集给出零几何特性.

blocks.en:
The RGB branch processes the unmasked clip with V-JEPA 2 ViT-L [ 2 ] and LoRA adaptation.
Mean pooling over its output tokens, followed by LayerNorm, gives a 1024-dimensional video feature 𝒇 R \boldsymbol{f}_{R} .
RGB uses its pretrained input normalization, independently of the cue statistics.
The context consists of five values: the time relative to the collision, the frame interval Δ ​ t \Delta t , the ratio of crop size to focal length in each of the two image axes, and g grav ​ Δ ​ t 2 g_{\mathrm{grav}}\Delta t^{2} with g grav = 9.81 ​ m / s 2 g_{\mathrm{grav}}=9.81\,\mathrm{m/s^{2}} .
The frame interval and gravity term are divided by fixed constants 1 / 30 ​ s 1/30\,\mathrm{s} and 0.01 ​ m 0.01\,\mathrm{m} , respectively, before encoding.
The same five context values are supplied to all points at a given window and time in the geometry branch.
The context branch is separate from the geometry branch. It takes the five context values at each of the five time steps of the four tracklets ( 4 × 5 × 5 4\times 5\times 5 values), flattens them to 100 dimensions, and maps them with a linear layer and GELU to a 32-dimensional video feature 𝒇 ctx \boldsymbol{f}_{\mathrm{ctx}} .

平均集合在它的输出符上,然后是LayerNorm,给出一个1024维的视频功能f R\boldsymbol{f}_{R}.
RGB使用其经过预先训练的输入正常化,独立于提示统计.
上下文由5个值组成:与碰撞相关的时间,帧间隔QQ t\Delta t,两个图像轴中每个轴上的裁剪大小与焦距之比,以及g grav QQ t 2 gQQMThrm{grav_X 三角洲 t^{2}用gggrav=9.81 m/s 2 g_{\mathrm{grav}}=9.81\,\mathrm{m/s^{2}}.

同样的5个上下文值在几何分支中提供给给定窗口和时间的所有点.
上下文分支与几何分支分离. 它在四个音轨的五个时间步骤(4×5×5 4\tims 5\tims 5)中,每个都取五个上下文值,将其扁平到100维,并用线性图层和GELU映射到一个32维的视频特征fctx\boldsymbol{f×5 mathrm{ctx}.

blocks.en:
Late fusion concatenates the three video features into a 1312-dimensional vector for the regression MLP in Eq. ( S20 ).
The constants in that equation are fixed target normalization parameters.
RGB-only omits the geometry feature while retaining the same RGB adaptation and context branch.

该方程式中的常数是固定的目标正常化参数.
仅RGB省略了几何特征,同时保留了相同的RGB适应和上下文分支.

blocks.en: G.3 Implementation details
blocks.zh: G.3 执行细节

blocks.en: V-JEPA 2 ViT-L supplies 1,024-dimensional tokens. Rank-16 LoRA with scale 32 adapts query/value projections in the last half of the backbone; the input projection and the LayerNorm parameters are also trainable. The image branches for dense depth and dense flow use the same backbone; they adapt its input projection to one depth channel or two flow channels. Each image branch has its own LoRA weights and its own trainable parameters. The frozen weights are identical in all branches and can share memory, but each branch computes its own adapted features. The tokens of each branch are mean-pooled and passed through a LayerNorm without learned scale and bias before concatenation. The two regression heads are MLPs with hidden widths 512, 256, and 128 and no dropout, one for z E z_{E} and one for z Y z_{Y} .
blocks.zh: V-JEPA 2 VIT-L提供1,024维的代币. Rank-16 LORA,比例为32,调整了主干线上半段的查询/值预测;输入预测和图层诺姆参数也可以训练. 用于密度深度和密度流量的图像分支使用相同的主干;它们将其输入投影调整为一个深度通道或两个流量通道. 每个图像分支都有自己的LORA重量和自己的可训练参数. 冰冻重量在所有分支中都是相同的,可以共享内存,但每个分支都会计算自己的适应性特征. 每个分支的符号都是平均集合的,在交接之前没有学到的尺度和偏差,经过一个LayerNorm. 两个回归头是MLP, 隐藏宽度为512, 256, 和128, 并且没有辍学, 一个是 z E z_{E }, 一个是 z Y z_{Y } 。

blocks.en: Four five-frame tracklets start at window indices 0, 4, 8, and 11. Each starts with 128 points sampled on the object mask. We sample them from the mask eroded with a 3 × 3 3\times 3 kernel if at least 32 pixels remain after the erosion, and from the original mask otherwise. Each point is advanced to the next frame with the WAFT flow, sampled bilinearly at its position. A point counts as visible in a frame if its flow is finite, it lies inside the image, and it lies on the object mask. These tracklets are not exact physical correspondences, and we apply no forward–backward check. The graph connects each point to its 24 nearest neighbors in the reference frame and stays the same throughout the tracklet.
blocks.zh: 四个五帧轨道从窗口指数0、4、8和11开始。 每个都从在物体面具上取样的128分开始. 如果在侵蚀后至少保留32像素,我们用3×3 3\时的内核从被侵蚀的面具中取样,或者从原来的面具中取样。 每个点随着WAFT流向下一帧前进,在位置上双线性地进行取样. 如果一个点的流量是有限的,它就位于图像内部,它就位于物体的面具上,那么这个点在框架里算得出来。 这些音轨不是精确的物理通信, 我们没有进行前向的检查。 该图将每个点与参照框中其24个最近的邻接点连接,并在整个轨道上保持不变.

blocks.en: For each neighborhood size k ∈ { 8 , 24 } k\in\{8,24\} , the affine fit of App. G.1 starts from Gaussian weights in reference distance and refines them with three Huber reweighting steps. A fit is kept only if it has at least six valid neighbors, the ratio of the smallest to the largest eigenvalue of the reference Gram matrix is greater than 10 − 3 10^{-3} , and the singular values of the fitted map 𝑨 \boldsymbol{A} lie between 10 − 3 10^{-3} and 100 100 . These are the checks of App. G.1 ; the bounds on the singular values of 𝑨 \boldsymbol{A} are the bounds given there on the eigenvalues of 𝑨 ⊤ ​ 𝑨 \boldsymbol{A}^{\top}\boldsymbol{A} . Invalid fits are excluded, not interpreted as zero deformation. Strain, stretch, and the non-affine residual are computed for both neighborhood sizes, giving 6+8+2=16 channels. The logarithm in Eq. ( S9 ) is the matrix logarithm of the symmetric positive-definite matrix 𝑨 ⊤ ​ 𝑨 \boldsymbol{A}^{\top}\boldsymbol{A} , not an element-wise logarithm.

blocks.en: Each cue channel is normalized with a fixed mean and standard deviation computed on the synthetic training split. Each cue family (strain, stretch, non-affine residual) has its own validity flag. All cue variants receive the same timing and scale context: the time relative to the collision, the frame interval, the ratio of crop side to focal length in each image axis, and g ​ Δ ​ t 2 g\Delta t^{2} . The cue model projects 16 cue channels, three validity flags (one per cue family), and five context values; the tracklet models project the four tracklet channels of Eq. ( S6 ) instead. Three blocks of width 128 follow. Each applies EdgeConv and then a temporal convolution with kernel size 3; the dilations of the three blocks are 1, 2, and 4. Masked mean and max pooling produce 256 features; concatenating the RGB feature (1,024) and the context feature (32) gives 1,312 features before the output heads. The model does not sample RGB tokens at track locations.
blocks.zh: 每一个提示通道都与一个固定的中间偏差和在合成训练分裂时计算的标准偏差正常化。 每个线索家族(绳索、拉伸、非亚芬残留)都有自己的有效旗帜。 所有提示变体都得到相同的时间和尺度上下文:与碰撞的时间,帧间隔,每个图像轴中作物侧与焦距的比例,以及g Δ t 2 g\Delta t\\2}. cue模型预测16个cue频道,3个有效旗(每个cue家族1个)和5个上下文值; tracklet模型则预测Eq.(S6)的4个轨道频道。 宽度128的3个街区紧随其后. 每个都应用EdgeConv,然后与内核大小3进行时间演化;三个区块的拓扑是1,2和4. 蒙面的平均值和最大集合共产生256个特性;调制RGB特性(1,024)和上下文特性(32)在输出头之前给出1,312个特性. 该模型不会在轨迹位置对 RGB 令牌进行抽样.

blocks.en: We train with AdamW. The learning rate is 10 − 4 10^{-4} for the adapted backbone, the geometry encoder, and the context branch, and 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} for the heads. Weight decay is 0.05, the betas are (0.9,0.999), and epsilon is 10 − 8 10^{-8} . Gradients are clipped at 1, and computation uses bfloat16. The seed is 1701. A warm-up over 5% of the steps is followed by cosine decay to 5% of the initial learning rate over four epochs; the fifth epoch keeps this final rate. Each GPU holds four videos, and gradients are accumulated to an effective batch of 480 videos; the number of GPUs differs between runs (for example, 10 accumulation steps on 12 GPUs). All direct predictors share this schedule and are reported after the fifth epoch; no checkpoint is selected on real videos. The teacher and the students are described in App. H and App. L.5 .
blocks.zh: 我们跟亚当W一起训练 学习率为10–4 10–QQ-4} 适应骨干,几何编码器,以及上下文分支, 3×10–4 3\times 10–4} 头部. 体重衰变为0.05,β为(0.9,0.999),epsilon为10−8 10^{-8}. 梯度被剪切为1,计算使用bfloat16. 种子为1701. 热身超过5%的步数之后,余弦衰减到四个纪元中初始学习率的5%;第五纪元保持这个终极速率. 每个GPU持有4个视频,梯度累积到有效批量的480个视频;运行间GPU的数量不同(例如12个GPU上的10个积分步骤). 所有直接预测器都共享这个时间表,并在第五个纪元后报告;在真实视频中没有选择检查点. App.H和App.L.5对教师和学生进行了描述。

blocks.en: Appendix H Teacher on Exact Surface Deformation
blocks.zh: 附录H 精确表面变形教师

blocks.en: The teacher reads the motion of points on the simulated object surface. For each video we take up to 1,024 surface particles of the simulation and their positions in the 16 frames of the window. The particles are the same in every frame, so the tracks are exact. Positions are centered and divided by the object size in the first frame. Each point has up to 16 fixed neighbors on the surface, chosen in the first frame with tangent and normal checks. From these positions we compute ten features per point and frame: the two principal logarithmic strains of the surface, the area change, the strain anisotropy, the rates of the strains and of the area change, bending, the residual of the local affine fit, and a validity flag. Edges carry the reference length, the stretch, the agreement of normals, bending, and validity. These features describe how the surface deforms; they are not the full volumetric deformation gradient. The teacher does not read the solver’s 𝑭 e \boldsymbol{F}_{e} , 𝑭 p \boldsymbol{F}_{p} , stress, or energy, and it does not read RGB, absolute coordinates, density, or Poisson’s ratio.
blocks.zh: 老师在模拟物体表面读取点的运动. 对于每个视频,我们取取多达1 024个表面粒子 模拟及其位置 在窗口的16帧。 每个框架的颗粒都是一样的,所以轨道是准确的. 位置以第一帧中的对象大小为中心并划分. 每个点在表面最多有16个固定的邻居,在第一个框中选择,进行切换和正常检查. 从这些位置计算出每个点和框架的十个特征:表层的两大对数菌株,面积变化,菌株异同位素,菌株的速率和面积变化,弯曲,局部附属物的残基适合,以及一个有效性旗帜. 边缘承载着参考长度,伸展,常态的一致,弯曲,以及有效性. 这些特征描述了表面的变形;它们不是完整的体积变形梯度. 老师不读解器的F e\boldsymbol{F}_{e},F p\boldsymbol{F}_{p},压力,或能量,也不读RGB,绝对坐标,密度,或Poisson的比例.

blocks.en: The network has four 128-wide blocks. Each block passes messages over the fixed neighbors and then applies a temporal convolution along each track, with dilations 1, 2, 4, and 8. Attention pooling and mean pooling over all points and frames give 256 features. A small branch encodes three context values into 32 features: the logarithm of the object size, the logarithm of the frame interval, and the vertical speed before impact. Concatenating the 256 and the 32 features gives a 288-dimensional vector. This vector is the feature 𝒇 T \boldsymbol{f}_{T} that the student regresses (Sec. 3.4 ). One 128-wide layer and two linear outputs map it to z E z_{E} and z Y z_{Y} . The teacher has 572,451 parameters.
blocks.zh: 该网络有四个128宽的区块. 每个区块都会将信息传递到固定的邻居身上,然后沿着每个赛道进行时间演化,同时进行第1,2,4,和8段的拓扑. 在所有点和框上集中注意力和表示集中,具有256个特性。 一个小分支将三个上下文值编码为32个特性:对象大小的对数,帧间隔的对数,以及撞击前的垂直速度. 凝聚256和32个特性给出了288维的矢量. 此向量是学生退步的功能 f T\ boldsymbol{ f\ t} (Sec. 3. 4 ) 。 一个128宽的层和两个线性输出将其映射到z E z_{E}和z Y z_{Y}. 师有572,451个参数.

blocks.en: We train the teacher with the Smooth L1 loss ( β = 0.25 \beta=0.25 ), with the yield term masked as in App. G , using AdamW with learning rate 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and gradient clipping at 5. The learning rate follows a cosine schedule to 10% over five epochs and keeps that rate for five more. We keep the epoch with the lowest sum of z E z_{E} and z Y z_{Y} errors on synthetic validation, epoch 8; no real video enters this choice. The training split provides 107,039 simulated trajectories with usable surface geometry, which cover 98.9% of the training videos. On validation, 14,293 of the 14,588 videos have usable geometry, and the teacher is scored on those (Table S1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们用平滑的L1损失(β = 0.25\beta = 0.25)来训练老师,产量术语像 App. G 中一样被掩盖,使用 AdamW 的学习率 3× 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4 },体重衰减 10− 4 10^{-4 } 5 的梯度剪切. 学习率遵循了5个世纪的10%的余弦表,并将这一比率维持在5个以上。 我们保留这个时代,其中Z E z_{E}和z Y z_{Y}在合成验证上的误差最小, epoc 8; 没有真实的视频进入这个选择. 培训分解提供了107,039个模拟轨迹,可使用表面几何,覆盖98.9%的培训视频. 在验证时,14 588个视频中有14 293个有可用的几何功能,教师在这些视频上打分(表S1)。

blocks.en: Table S1 also lists a teacher that sees only the camera-visible part of the surface, with neighborhoods rebuilt from the retained points. It is trained in the same way, and its best validation epoch is the tenth. It has usable geometry for 10,202 validation videos. Table 3 evaluates every one of its rows on these 10,202 videos. This is why the full-surface teacher has a z E z_{E} error of 0.145 dex in that table and of 0.161 dex on all 14,293 videos with usable geometry.
blocks.zh: 表S1还列出一个教师只看到表面的相机可见部分,邻里从保留点重建. 其训练方式相同,其最好的验证时代是第十. 它有可用于10,202个验证视频的几何功能. 表3评价了这10,202个视频的每行内容. 因此,全表面教师的表格中有0.145 dex的z E z E}错误,所有14 293个带可用几何的视频中都有0.161 dex的错误。

This is clearly worse than predicting the density-normalized ratios (0.272 against 0.161 dex for stiffness), in line with App. E : a drop does not determine density, so the absolute parameters are not determined either. Exact points remove perception error, but not simulator bias, finite sampling, or the limits of the architecture, so the teacher’s error is not an information-theoretic bound.
