blocks.en: Appendix I Optimization and Conditional Range Search
blocks.zh: 附录一 优化和条件范围搜索

blocks.en: Each object shares ( E , σ Y ) (E,\sigma_{Y}) across its five drops. Each drop has a 12-dimensional initial state: position, rotation, linear velocity, and angular velocity. Density, Poisson’s ratio, geometry, cameras, and contact settings are not fit. They are fixed for each scene (Table S2 lists the density and Poisson’s ratio of each object). The fit starts from a grid search whose best candidate was chosen by visual rating (App. L.2 ), and it uses the scanned scene, the reconstructed mesh, and the calibrated camera. It is therefore not an automatic estimator from RGB alone, and the references are parameters fit in our simulator, not independent measurements.
blocks.zh: 每个对象共享(E, \ Y) (E,\sigma\Y}) 横跨其五滴. 每一次下降都有一个12维初始状态:位置,旋转,线性速度,以及角速度. 密度, Poisson的比例, 几何, 相机, 和接触环境都不适合 。 它们是每个场景的固定的(表S2列出了每个物体的密度和波森的比例). 配体从网格搜索开始,其最佳候选者通过视觉评分(App.L.2)选择,它使用扫描场景,重建的网格,校准的相机. 因此,它不单是RGB的自动估计器,引用是适合我们模拟器的参数,而不是独立的测量.

blocks.en: The Bayesian search over the material uses a Gaussian process with Matérn- 5 / 2 5/2 covariance, a noise regularizer of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and normalized responses. It selects new candidates by expected improvement with an exploration offset of 0.002. Each round proposes 12 material candidates; three promising branches receive eight initial-state proposals per trial. At most four rounds are run. The search stops earlier after two rounds without improvement, provided that a minimum number of rounds has been completed. The candidate pool contains 3,000 proposals.
blocks.zh: 巴耶西亚人对材料的搜索使用高斯工艺,与Matérn- 5 / 2 5/2 共变,噪声调节器为 10 - 4 10 - 4 + - 4 → 4 → , 反应正常化. 它通过预期的改进来挑选新候选人,勘探费用抵消0.02美元。 每轮提议12名物质候选人;3个有前途的分支机构每次审判收到8份初始州提案。 最多四轮比赛 在两轮没有改进的情况下,只要完成最少的一轮,搜索就提前停止。 候选人人才库载有3 000份提案。

blocks.en: Table S2: Fixed inputs of the reference fit. Densities are our measurements where available (App. O ) and common values otherwise. Poisson’s ratios are estimates made before the tensile data were processed, or common values; App. O lists the apparent Poisson’s ratios measured in the tensile tests; App. W explains why we keep the values of this table and shows the effect of Poisson’s ratio on the simulation. Both are assumptions of the fit. n Y n_{Y} : number of drops whose reference simulation yields.
blocks.zh: 表S2:参考文献的固定数字。 密度是我们现有的(App.O)和共同价值的衡量标准。 Poisson的比例是处理抗拉强度数据之前所作的估计,或共同值; App. O列出了抗拉强度测试中所测量的Poisson的明显比率; App. W解释为什么我们保留这个表格的数值,并显示普瓦森比率对模拟的影响. 两者都是合适的假设。 n Y n_{Y}:参考模拟产量的下降数。

blocks.en: The reference fit uses SEA-RAFT flow [ 78 ] with a two-pixel forward–backward criterion. The trajectory term compares the 3D motion of the visible surface. On the real video, SEA-RAFT short tracks are lifted to 3D with DepthCrafter depth aligned to metric scale; in the simulation, the rendered surface points are used. The 3D parts of the trajectory and pose terms use only the rigid motion of the object, which is fit robustly to all tracked points in each short window (App. L.2 ). This robust fit averages out the depth noise at individual points, so it describes the overall motion of the object well. It does not describe the local deformation, which the image-plane terms below compare. We did not repeat the reference fit with another depth estimator. Over short windows, the term compares the direction of the 3D velocity, its vertical part, and its horizontal speed, with weights 0.55, 0.30, and 0.15. The pose term combines the relative 3D rotation over short windows (weight 0.6, used only where it is reliable) with the distance between the silhouette boundaries (weight 0.4). The deformation and short-track terms compare image-plane cues.
blocks.zh: 引用适合使用SEA-RAFT流[78],带有双像素前向-后向标准. 轨迹术语比较可见表面的3D运动. 在真实的视频中,SEA-RAFT短轨被提升到3D,深度Crafter深度与公制尺度一致;在模拟中,使用渲染的表面点. 轨迹的3D部分和造型术语只使用物体的刚性运动,这与每个短窗口中的所有跟踪点都紧密吻合(App.L.2. 这种坚固的适合个别点的深度噪声的平均值,所以它很好地描述了物体的整体运动. 它没有描述局部变形,下面的图像平面术语与之比较. 我们没有重复与另一个深度估计值相符的提法。 在短窗口上,术语比较了3D速度的方向,垂直部分,以及水平速度,其重量为0.55,0.30和0.15. 姿势名词将相对的3D旋转在短窗上(重量0.6,仅在可靠的情况下使用)与硅胶边界之间的距离(重量0.4)相结合. 变形和短轨术语比较图像-平面提示.

blocks.en: The deformation term ℒ deform \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{deform}} works on the flow that remains after the dominant affine motion of the object in the image is removed. A sigmoid turns the magnitude of this residual flow into a soft support, that is, a soft mask of the pixels with residual motion. The sigmoid is centered at 0.01 object lengths and has width 0.0025. Its spatial extent is integrated in a boundary band from 2 pixels to 2 + 0.08 ​ L 2+0.08L , where L L is the image object scale, and normalized by boundary length/object scale. The simulated and real thickness curves are compared using a scale floor of 0.01. This is a projected residual-flow thickness, not a 3D material thickness or a per-particle strain measurement.
blocks.zh: 变形词 L 变形 \ mathcal{ L}_{\Q mathrm{ 变形 } 作用于图像中对象主要亲缘运动被移除后的流 。 一个Sigmoid将这种残余流的大小变成一个软支持,即一个带有剩余运动的像素的软面具. sigmoid以0.01物体长度为中心,宽度为0.0025. 其空间范围被集成在从2像素到2+0.08 L 2+0.08L的边界带中,其中LL为图像对象尺度,并通过边界长度/对象尺度实现正常化. 模拟和真实厚度曲线采用0.01平方平面比对。 这是预测的残流厚度,而不是三维材料厚度或每颗粒子株的测量。

blocks.en: The short-track term ℒ short \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{short}} starts new five-frame tracks every two frames around impact. For pairs of tracked points, it takes the absolute change of the logarithm of their distance after 2, 3, and 4 frames, and it uses the 75th percentile of these changes. Penalties on low coverage and on missing tracks prevent a simulation from scoring well simply because difficult tracks are lost. The prior term ℒ prior \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{prior}} penalizes the departure of each initial state from its initialization (App. L.2 ). The reference fit can use frames beyond the predictor’s 16-frame window; the replay metrics of Sec. 4 use the 16 frames from C − 3 C-3 (App. J ).

blocks.en: The global material search domain is log 10 ⁡ ( E / Pa ) ∈ [ 4 , 9 ] \log_{10}(E/\mathrm{Pa})\in[4,9] and log 10 ⁡ ( σ Y / Pa ) ∈ [ 5 , log 10 ⁡ ( 2 × 10 7 ) ] \log_{10}(\sigma_{Y}/\mathrm{Pa})\in[5,\log_{10}(2\times 10^{7})] . The local search starts from the reference material, which we call the center. It searches outward along 32 directions in the ( log 10 ⁡ E , log 10 ⁡ σ Y ) (\log_{10}E,\log_{10}\sigma_{Y}) plane: first rays along the axes and the diagonals, then directions at intermediate angles. Along each direction, it advances in steps of 0.05 dex for at most ten steps. At the first rejected sample, it bisects the interval between the last accepted and the first rejected sample twice. blocks.en:
The physical model says that local deformation is an important source of information about stiffness. But recovering a deforming 3D mesh from a single collision video is difficult, for three reasons. From one view, depth gives at most a point cloud of the visible surface, which differs from the complete object surface. Rotation changes which points are visible. And depth errors can introduce false motion even when the 2D tracks are correct.
A simple approach trains a pretrained video backbone with prediction heads on synthetic RGB videos to predict E / ρ E/\rho and σ Y / ρ \sigma_{Y}/\rho . Can explicit motion and local deformation cues improve it?
We study 2D trajectories, which describe motion, and three 2D cues that describe local deformation: strain, stretch, and the non-affine residual.
We also lift these to 3D.
We found that 2D motion and deformation, estimated from the video, retain useful material information. They are less sensitive to the estimation errors of the foundation models than their 3D versions. The pretrained RGB backbone supplies complementary context.
Physical intermediate representations have been studied before [ 52 , 47 ] ; we focus on which video-observable local cues remain useful after imperfect estimation.

物理模型说局部变形是硬度的重要信息来源. 但从一个单一的碰撞视频中恢复一个变形的3D网格是困难的,原因有三. 从一种观点来看,深度最多给出可见表面的点云,这与完整的物体表面不同. 旋转改变可见的点数 。 而深度错误即使在2D轨迹正确时也能引入假运动.
一个简单的方法训练一个预先训练的视频主干线,在合成的RGB视频上设预测头,以预测E / ^ E/\rho 和 \ Y \\\ sigma\Y}/\rho . 明确的运动和局部变形提示能改善它吗?
我们研究描述运动的2D轨迹,以及描述局部变形的3个2D提示:菌株,拉伸,以及非亚芬残基.
我们还把这些提升到3D。
我们发现从视频中估计的2D运动和变形保留了有用的材料信息. 他们对基础模型估计错误的敏感度低于其3D版本. 预先训练的RGB骨干提供互补的背景.
在[52,47]之前已经研究了物理中间表示;我们的重点是,在不准确的估计之后,哪些可观看的当地提示仍然有用。

Each of the eleven trackers and tracker modes covers less than half of the object at the end of the window in some drops, while our short tracklets cover more than half at that frame in every drop (App. G.1 and V ). blocks.en:
Our models have three branches for RGB, geometry, and shared context (Fig. 2 ).
In the cue models, the geometry branch reads the deformation cues; in the models on 2D tracklets, including PhysReader, it reads the 2D tracklets. For every tracked point and time step, it maps the standardized cue channels, the cue-validity indicators, and five timing and scale context values to a 128-dimensional feature. Three blocks update these features, each with EdgeConv [ 77 ] over the 24 reference neighbors and a dilated temporal convolution along each track. Masked mean and max pooling then give the geometry feature 𝒇 G ∈ ℝ 256 \boldsymbol{f}_{G}\in\mathbb{R}^{256} .
The RGB branch encodes the unmasked clip with V-JEPA 2 ViT-L [ 2 ] and LoRA adaptation ( 𝒇 R ∈ ℝ 1024 \boldsymbol{f}_{R}\in\mathbb{R}^{1024} ), and a context branch encodes the timing and scale values ( 𝒇 ctx ∈ ℝ 32 \boldsymbol{f}_{\mathrm{ctx}}\in\mathbb{R}^{32} ).
Late fusion feeds the concatenated features 𝒇 = [ 𝒇 R , 𝒇 G , 𝒇 ctx ] \boldsymbol{f}=[\boldsymbol{f}_{R},\boldsymbol{f}_{G},\boldsymbol{f}_{\mathrm{ctx}}] to two regression heads for the targets of Eq. ( 2 ), z ^ E = 3.5 + 2.5 ​ MLP E ​ ( 𝒇 ) , z ^ Y = 3.1505 + 1.1505 ​ MLP Y ​ ( 𝒇 ) , \widehat{z}_{E}=3.5+2.5\,\mathrm{MLP}_{E}(\boldsymbol{f}),\;\;\widehat{z}_{Y}=3.1505+1.1505\,\mathrm{MLP}_{Y}(\boldsymbol{f}), (S20) with fixed target-normalization constants (App. E ); the yield head is supervised only on windows with plastic excitation.
RGB-only omits 𝒇 G \boldsymbol{f}_{G} while retaining the same RGB adaptation and context branch. Further details are in App. G .

blocks.en: L.2 Reference Optimization Objective
blocks.zh: L.2 参考优化目标

blocks.en:
This objective constructs the reference material of each object. The replay evaluation of a predicted material (App. J ) uses the same comparison terms but keeps the predicted material fixed: it refines only the initial state of each drop, with no alternation and no material search.
For each drop, the optimization objective is ℒ total = \displaystyle\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{total}}={} 0.25 ​ ℒ traj + 0.25 ​ ℒ pose + 0.45 ​ ℒ deform \displaystyle 0.25\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{traj}}+0.25\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{pose}}+0.45\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{deform}} (S22) + 0.05 ​ ℒ short + 0.02 ​ ℒ prior . \displaystyle+0.05\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{short}}+0.02\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{prior}}. The first four terms compare the simulation with the real video. ℒ traj \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{traj}} compares the 3D motion of visible surface points; ℒ pose \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{pose}} compares short-window 3D rotations and silhouette boundaries; ℒ deform \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{deform}} compares projected residual-flow thickness near object boundaries after removing dominant affine motion; ℒ short \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{short}} compares local pair-distance changes along short tracks;
and ℒ prior \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{prior}} keeps the optimized parameters close to their initialization.
Sec. 4 calls the first two terms object-center trajectory and image-plane pose.
As described here, the trajectory term and the rotation part of the pose term use 3D motion; the rest of the pose term compares silhouette boundaries in the image (App. I ).
The 3D parts describe the rigid motion of the object: in each short window, one rigid displacement and one rotation are fit robustly to all tracked points.
This fit averages out the noise of the depth at individual points, but it also removes the local deformation, through which the material acts.
The deformation itself is measured by ℒ deform \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{deform}} and ℒ short \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{short}} , which compare image-plane cues. The initialization is the candidate of a grid search that a human rated best. The rater compared the real video with re-simulations of the grid candidates, which were shown without their material values.
The object-level objective averages this loss across its eligible drops.

blocks.en:
To construct the reference, we alternate initial-state refinement and material search for up to four rounds:
with material parameters fixed, we refine each drop’s initial state to improve trajectory and pose alignment; with initial states fixed, we optimize the shared material parameters by Bayesian optimization.
The alternation matters because the deformation loss is a projected 2D metric affected by 3D rotation and trajectory, so trajectory and pose must be aligned first.
The material and initial states with the lowest total loss form the reference ( θ i ⋆ , { η i , d ⋆ } ) (\theta_{i}^{\star},\{\eta_{i,d}^{\star}\}) (App. I ).

交替作用很重要,因为变形损失是受到三维旋转和轨迹影响的2D预测量度,所以轨迹和姿势必须先对齐.
总损失最低的物质和初始状态构成参考(θi⋆, {i, d⋆}) (\theta_{i}^{\star},\{\ta_{i, d}^{\star}\}). (第1页).

The pose error e pose e_{\mathrm{pose}} is the mean rotation error, normalized by 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} . The third is the deformation error e strain e_{\mathrm{strain}} .

blocks.en: Material acts through 3D deformation, but predicting material directly from video is hard. Can a video model predict an intermediate description of the 3D deformation instead?
blocks.zh: 材料通过3D变形来作用,但直接从视频中预测材料是很难的. 视频模型能否预测三维变形的中间描述?

blocks.en:
During training in simulation, the teacher predicts material from exact 3D deformation of the object surface (App. H ): an encoder turns the deformation into a feature, and a material head turns the feature into z E z_{E} and z Y z_{Y} .
The student takes RGB and 2D tracklets, or RGB and 3D tracklets, and predicts the teacher’s feature. It then applies the teacher’s frozen material head. The student is the direct predictor of App. K with its regression heads replaced by the projection to the teacher’s feature.
The student is supervised by the teacher’s feature and by the material labels. At test time it sees a real video and its tracklets, predicts the feature, and then the material.

In this way the student can use 3D information without exact 3D deformation at test time.
With exact 3D deformation, the material can be predicted accurately: on synthetic validation, the teacher reaches an error of 0.161 dex for z E z_{E} and 0.192 dex for z Y z_{Y} on the 14,293 videos with usable surface geometry (0.145 dex for z E z_{E} on the 10,202 videos of Table 3 ; App. H ).
We ask whether 2D tracklets and RGB can recover this information, and whether tracklets lifted with estimated depth recover it better.
The student on 3D tracklets has the lower synthetic error, yet it is worse on real videos than the student on 2D tracklets.
Sec. 5.3 examines this failure.
blocks.zh:
这样学生就可以使用3D信息,而不在测试时精确的3D变形.
准确的3D变形,材料可以准确预测:在合成验证时,老师在表3的10,202个视频上,在14,293个可用表面几何的视频(z E z _{ E } E 的0.145 ex)上,为 z E z _{ E → E → E → }和 z Y _{ Y → 的 0.192 ex ) 得出错误.
我们询问,2D轨道和RGB是否能够恢复这一信息,以及是否有估计深度的轨迹可以更好地恢复。
3D轨道上的学生有较低的合成错误,然而在真实视频中比2D轨道上的学生更糟糕.
第5.3条审查了这一失败。

blocks.en:
We freeze the teacher and the student and train linear probes on their features. For each frame, a probe predicts the magnitude of the Hencky strain of the surface, averaged over a region of the object. This target is computed from the simulator’s surface-point trajectories.
We compare two regions: the camera-visible surface, and the part of the surface near the ground ( y ≤ 0.07 ​ m y\leq 0.07\,\mathrm{m} ), which approximates the part of the object that is in contact with the ground.
We first fit the probes on 271,134 synthetic training videos and select the regularization on the other 5,916 training videos, whose meshes do not appear among the 271,134. We then refit the probes on all 277,050 training videos.
We evaluate on the synthetic validation split and score both regions on the same videos and frames, those that are valid for both regions.
The student’s features recover visible-surface strain with R 2 = 0.625 R^{2}=0.625 , compared with 0.506 0.506 near the ground.

We therefore test multiple recent and established video and image
depth estimation models, including DepthCrafter, Video Depth Anything,

To separate the representation from its estimation, we train the lifted model with each combination of simulator or 4RC depth and simulator or WAFT tracks (A–D in Table S7 ).
We evaluate each model under all four synthetic conditions and on real videos, where only D exists (Fig. 4 , right).
D has the same inputs as RGB + 3D tracklets in Table 1 , but it is a separate training run (App. M.2 ).
Model A, trained on exact geometry, is evaluated with one input replaced at a time. Its E / ρ E/\rho error rises by 0.12 dex when WAFT tracks replace simulator tracks (column Syn B), but by 0.41 dex when 4RC depth replaces simulator depth (column Syn C).
Training on estimated depth removes this cost in simulation: models C and D are within 0.04 dex of A and B and insensitive to which depth they receive.
Yet all four lifted models remain 0.34–0.51 dex worse than 2D tracklets on real drops (1.132–1.305 vs. 0.792 dex).

D在表1中与RGB + 3D音轨有相同的输入,但它是一个单独的训练运行(App. M.2.).
型号 A,经过精确几何学的训练,通过一次替换一个输入来评价. 它的E / ^ E/\rho 误差在WAFT轨道取代模拟轨道时上升0.12 dex(列Syn B),但在4RC深度取代模拟深度时上升0.41 dex(列Syn C).
关于估计深度的培训消除了模拟中的这一成本:模型C和D在A和B的0.04度以内,其深度不敏感。
然而,所有四个升起的型号都比实际投放的2D轨距(1.132-1.305对0.792 dex)差0.34-0.51。

blocks.en: L.8 Stability Metrics
blocks.zh: L.8 稳定计量

blocks.en:
Reliable sim-to-real transfer requires consistent predictions.
We therefore evaluate prediction stability on real data in three ways.
blocks.zh:
可靠的成象到真转移需要一致的预测.
因此,我们以三种方式评价真实数据的预测稳定性。

blocks.en:
First, we evaluate stability across different drops of the same object.
Each object has five drops with different orientations, and the model predicts log 10 ⁡ ( E / ρ ) \log_{10}(E/\rho) and log 10 ⁡ ( σ Y / ρ ) \log_{10}(\sigma_{Y}/\rho) from each drop.
We compute the standard deviation across drops for each object and average across the 16 objects. Second, we evaluate prediction stability and accuracy under substantial changes in recording conditions.
We use 40 additional real videos of Kitty with changes in camera viewing angle, distance, background, and lighting.
The benchmark Kitty does not yield in any of its five drops, so we report only stiffness results. The toy in these recordings is a second copy of the same product, because the toy of the benchmark was no longer available. The two copies differ only in appearance: the second copy wears a dress and has a different surface print. The tensile specimens of Kitty were cut from the head of this second copy (App. O ). The log-MAE of Table S8 uses the reference stiffness of Kitty.
We measure the standard deviation of predicted log stiffness ratios: S E = Std n = 1 , … , 40 ⁡ [ log 10 ⁡ q ^ E , n ] . S_{E}=\operatorname{Std}_{n=1,\ldots,40}\left[\log_{10}\widehat{q}_{E,n}\right]. (S28)

我们使用了另外40个真实的视频 Kitty, 相机观看角度、距离、背景和照明的变化。
基准凯蒂在5个跌幅中都没有收成 所以我们只报告僵硬的结果 这些录音中的玩具是同一产品的第二份副本,因为基准的玩具已经无法使用. 两种拷贝仅在外观上有所不同:第二种拷贝穿着一件礼服,具有不同的表面印记. Kitty的抗拉强度标本是从这第二本副本的头部剪下来的(App. O.). 表S8的对数-MAE采用了Kitty的参考硬度.

blocks.en:
A predictor that reads material should give the same answer for the five drops of an object and for one object recorded under different conditions.
We report the spread of predictions across the drops of each object, across the 40 Kitty recordings, and between each real drop and its rendered replay (Table S8 ).
Lifting with estimated depth is the least consistent across the Kitty recordings, and among our inputs it has the largest real–replay shift.
The predictions of RGB + 3D tracklets have a standard deviation of 1.018 dex across the Kitty recordings, against 0.241 dex for PhysReader and 0.309 dex for RGB. This standard deviation is large under every recording change (Table S9 ).
We also compare the prediction from each real video with the prediction from the rendered replay of the same drop. The mean absolute difference between the two is 0.704 dex for RGB + 3D tracklets and 0.530 dex for PhysReader.
PhysReader also has the smallest standard deviation of predicted stiffness across the five drops of an object (0.319 dex in Table S8 ; RGB + 2D tracklets, the direct 2D model, has 0.324 dex).
Analytic Dynamics, which reads object masks, is the most stable across the Kitty recordings (standard deviation 0.195 dex) and the closest to the reference stiffness of Kitty (log-MAE 0.163 dex).
But it varies most across drops (0.613) and is much less accurate across objects (Sec. 5.4 ).
Consistency alone does not establish accuracy, so we read these results together with Table 1 .
blocks.zh:
读取材料的预测器应该对一个物体的五滴和记录在不同条件下的一个物体给出相同的答案.
我们报告预测在每一个物体的下降中,在40个凯蒂录音中,在每一次真实下降之间,以及在它的重播(表S8)之间的分布。
以估计深度的提升是凯蒂录音中最不连贯的,在我们的投入中,它具有最大的真实-重播转变。
对RGB + 3D 轨迹的预测标准偏差为1.018dex横跨Kitty录音,对应PhysReader的0.241dex和RGB的0.309dex. 这种标准差在每次记录变化下都是很大的(表S9).
我们还将每个真实视频的预测与同一滴的重播预测进行比较。 两者的平均绝对差值为RGB + 3D轨道0.704 dex和PhysReader0.530 dex.
PhysReader对一个物体的五滴中预测的硬度也有最小的标准偏差(表S8中的0.319 dex;RGB + 2D tracklets,直接的2D模型,有0.324 dex).
分析动态(Analytic Dynamics),它读作物体口罩,是Kitty录音全程最稳定的(标准偏差0.195 dex),最接近Kitty的参考硬度(log-MAE 0.163 dex).
但它在不同的滴(0.613)之间差异最大,在对象之间准确度要低得多(第5.4条)。
仅靠一致性并不能确定准确性,所以我们将这些结果与表1一起阅读。

blocks.en:
Table S9 breaks the Kitty spread down by recording condition.
Viewpoint and distance are the most informative conditions. A predictor that reads 3D deformation should not change its prediction with the camera angle, and a predictor that reads metric motion should not change it with the distance to the camera.
For the two models on lifted tracklets, the standard deviation is 0.85–1.33 dex under every condition, whereas for PhysReader it stays within 0.17–0.25 dex.
Analytic Dynamics, which uses object masks as input and is therefore less affected by changes in pixel appearance, is the most stable overall.
blocks.zh:
表S9通过录制条件打破了Kitty的分布.
视点和距离是信息最丰富的条件. 读取3D变形的预测器不应该用相机角度改变其预测,读取公制运动的预测器不应该用相机的距离来改变它.
对于升空轨迹上的两种型号,每个条件的标准偏差为0.85–1.33 dex,而对于PhysReader则停留在0.17–0.25 dex.
分析动力学(Analytic Dynamics)使用对象口罩作为输入,因此受像素外观变化的影响较小,是总体最稳定的.

blocks.en: L.9 Adapting the External Baselines
blocks.zh: L.9 调整外部基线

blocks.en:
PhysDreamer and PhysFlow use our meshes, simulator, Neo-Hookean elasticity, von Mises plasticity, and fixed density and Poisson’s ratio.
In the main paper (Table 5 ), PhysDreamer is initialized from the predictions of PhysReader (Fig. S12 ). App. R.6 also starts it from the predictions of our RGB + 2D tracklets + cues predictor (parameter distance 0.739; Table 1 ).
PhysFlow is initialized either from the predictions of PhysReader (our student) or from the predictions of the vision-language model given the first frame (VLM-image). The original paper also starts from a VLM prediction.
MonoPhysics retains its Gaussian representation, because all of its losses are computed on renderings of its Gaussians: the rendered alpha against the object mask, the optical flow rendered from the moving Gaussians against SEA-RAFT flow, and a silhouette loss. A regularizer also keeps the Gaussian centers evenly spaced. The Gaussians are initialized from the particles of our mesh. MonoPhysics uses Neo-Hookean elasticity and von Mises plasticity with our fixed density and Poisson’s ratio.
It starts either from the predictions of PhysReader or from its original initialization ( E = 10 5 E=10^{5} Pa, σ Y = 10 4 \sigma_{Y}=10^{4} Pa).
Its estimated material parameters are evaluated through replay on our benchmark meshes.
PhysTwin retains its mass–spring model and is compared through replay only.
PhysDreamer’s material field is compared through its volume-weighted average.
blocks.zh:
梦与梦 流动利用了我们的网格、模拟器、新胡克弹性、冯·米塞斯可塑性、固定密度和普瓦松的比例。
在主论文(表5)中,PhysDreamer是从PhysReader的预测(图S12)中初始化的. App.R.6还从我们的RGB + 2D轨道+提示预测器(参数距离0.739;表1)的预测开始。
PhysFlow要么从PhysReader(我们的学生)的预测中初始化,要么从给定第一帧(VLM-image)的视觉语言模型的预测中初始化. 原论文也从VLM预测开始.

PhysDreamer runs take two and a half to three hours per video, and App. R.6 discusses the initializations.
Density and Poisson’s ratio are fixed to the same values used in our reference simulations.
blocks.zh:
PhysDreamer运行每个视频需要两个半小时到三个小时,App. R.6讨论初始化.
密度和Poisson的比值 固定在我们参考模拟中使用的数值上。

blocks.en:
For PhysDreamer, the original version uses Gaussians and optimizes a Young’s modulus field. We change the object representation to a mesh and use our corrected MPM implementation with differentiable optimization.
We use neo-Hookean elasticity with von Mises plasticity and optimize both E E and σ Y \sigma_{Y} (Table 5 ).
To handle the wide E E range of [ 10 4 , 10 9 ] [10^{4},10^{9}] Pa, we optimize log 10 ⁡ E \log_{10}E and log 10 ⁡ σ Y \log_{10}\sigma_{Y} .
We retain PhysDreamer’s two-stage velocity-field and material-field optimization, image reconstruction and SSIM loss, and field smoothness regularization.
blocks.zh:
对于PhysDreamer,原始版本使用高斯语,并优化了一个Young的模态场. 我们把对象表示器改为网格,并使用我们经过修正的MPM执行,进行不同的优化。
我们使用新胡克语弹性与冯·米塞斯可塑性,并优化E & & & Y\sigma_{Y}(表5)。
处理[10 4, 10 9] [10^{4}, 10^{9] 宽 E 范围 爸爸,我们优化日志10 \\\\\\\\\\\\\E和日志 10\fn方正黑体简体\fs18\b1\bord1\shad1\3cH2F2F2F}(英语: 。 。 。
我们保留了PhysDreamer的两阶段速度-场和物质-场优化,图像重建与SSIM损失,以及场平滑的规范化.

blocks.en:
PhysDreamer represents material properties as spatial fields, whereas our reference parameters are object-level.
For parameter comparison, we compute volume-weighted averages: E ¯ = ∑ p V p ​ E p ∑ p V p , σ ¯ Y = ∑ p V p ​ σ Y , p ∑ p V p , \overline{E}=\frac{\sum_{p}V_{p}E_{p}}{\sum_{p}V_{p}},\qquad\overline{\sigma}_{Y}=\frac{\sum_{p}V_{p}\sigma_{Y,p}}{\sum_{p}V_{p}}, (S29) where V p V_{p} is the fixed reference volume of particle p p .
Replay retains the spatial fields rather than replacing them with these averages.
Every PhysDreamer run is evaluated after exactly 25 velocity-field updates followed by 25 material-field updates.
blocks.zh: 每次PhysDreamer运行都要经过精确的25个速度-场更新之后再经过25个材料-场更新后进行评估.

blocks.en:
The released PhysDreamer code runs 300 velocity updates and 200 material updates, and it adds its learned field to a constant stiffness in Pa.
With this parameterization and the released material learning rate ( 10 − 3 10^{-3} ), the stiffness hardly moved on our drops.
The first material update changed the mean E E by less than 1 Pa, and after 200 material updates E E had changed by only 2.5–9%.
With 100 velocity and 200 material updates, a run takes eight to nine hours per video.
We therefore changed two things.
First, we optimize log 10 ⁡ E \log_{10}E and log 10 ⁡ σ Y \log_{10}\sigma_{Y} instead of the values in Pa, with a larger learning rate. The learning rate peaks at 4 × 10 − 3 4\times 10^{-3} in the velocity stage and at 5 × 10 − 3 5\times 10^{-3} in the material stage, each after a warm-up of three updates.
Second, we stop after 25 velocity and 25 material updates.
A run then takes two and a half to three hours per video.
blocks.zh:
发行的PhysDreamer代码运行了300个速度更新和200个材料更新,并在帕语中将其所学的领域添加到一个恒定僵硬度.
由于这个参数化和释放的素材学习率(10−3 10−3}),僵硬性几乎没有在我们下降时移动.
第一次材料更新将平均EE修改了不到1帕,在200次材料更新之后,EE只修改了2.5-9%.
随着100速度和200个材料更新,每段视频运行需要8到9小时.
因此,我们改变了两件事。
首先,我们优化日志 10\\\\ E\log\10}E和日志 10 \\\Y\log\10\sigma\Y}而不是Pa中的值,学习率更高。 学习率高峰在速度阶段为4×10−3 4\time 10×3}在物质阶段为5×10×3 5\time 10×3),每期在三次更新的热身后.
第二,我们在25个速度和25个材料更新后停止。
然后每段录像需要两个半小时到三个小时。

blocks.en:
For PhysFlow, we retain its object-level material parameterization and RAFT flow-matching loss.
We optimize log 10 ⁡ E \log_{10}E and log 10 ⁡ σ Y \log_{10}\sigma_{Y} and keep the reference initial state fixed during material fitting. This initial state was fit together with the reference material, which favors PhysFlow. Table 5 reports neo-Hookean elasticity with von Mises plasticity.
blocks.zh:
对于PhysFlow,我们保留其对象级物质参数化和RAFT流量匹配损失.
我们优化日志10 E\log10}E和日志10\\Y\log10\sigma\Y}在材料配齐时保持参考初始状态。 这种初始状态与参考材料相配合,有利于PhysFlow. 表5报告新荷裔弹性与冯·米塞斯可塑性.

blocks.en:
PhysTwin uses a mass–spring model.
We use our mesh to construct its physical nodes and render the deformation while retaining its native mass–spring solver.
Depth-based initialization is used only when the mesh-only initialization fails.
Its spring parameters do not directly correspond to Young’s modulus or yield stress, so we compare replay errors only.
blocks.zh:
PhysTwin使用质量–春季模型.
我们利用网格来构建其物理节点,并在保留其原生质量-泉解器的同时使变形。
深度初始化只在网格唯一初始化失败时使用.
它的弹簧参数并不直接对应Young的模态或产量应力,所以我们只比较重播错误.

blocks.en:
For PhysDreamer and PhysTwin, replay retains each method’s native material representation and physical model.
The replay losses that compare a simulation with the video (the total and deformation replay losses of Eq. ( 6 )) use the same objective as for our predictors. As there, the initial state is refined both for the method’s material and for the reference material.
For Err ref \mathrm{Err}_{\mathrm{ref}} , both simulations use the reference initial state.
Its deformation error fits local deformation gradients F F to the simulated point tracks and compares the resulting strains. It does not use the deformation gradients saved by the simulators, because the methods use different simulators.
PhysTwin simulates spring nodes and the reference simulation uses MPM particles, so the two discretizations do not share points. For PhysTwin, this comparison therefore uses a common set of material query points and a mapping from the spring nodes to these points that is fixed in the rest configuration.
blocks.zh:
对于PhysDreamer和PhysTwin,重播保留了每种方法的本土物质表现和物理模型.
将模拟和视频进行比较的重播损失(Eq. (6)的总和变形重播损失)使用与我们的预测器相同的目标. 因此,对方法材料和参考材料的初始状态都作了改进。
对于 Err ref\mathrm{Err\ mathrm{ ref},两种模拟都使用参考初始状态.
它的变形误差与模拟点轨的F F 的局部变形梯度相匹配,并比较了由此产生的菌株. 它不使用模拟器保存的变形梯度,因为方法使用不同的模拟器.
PhysTwin模拟弹簧节点,参考模拟使用MPM粒子,因此两个盘点不共享点. 对于PhysTwin来说,这一比较因此使用了一套通用的材料查询点,以及从弹簧节点到这些点的映射,这些点固定在其余配置中.

blocks.en:
For Vid2Sim [ 13 ] , we use its feed-forward predictor and follow the released training code.
The backbone is VideoMAE-base. It is fully fine-tuned on 16 frames at 448 × 448 448\times 448 pixels. Its tokens are mean-pooled and passed to regression heads with the released architecture.
The released model has three heads: one for Young’s modulus, one for Poisson’s ratio, and one for the weights of its linear-blend-skinning (LBS) simulator.
We remove the LBS head, which our simulator does not use, and the head for Poisson’s ratio, which is fixed in our benchmark.
We keep two heads and train them on our two targets, log 10 ⁡ ( E / ρ ) \log_{10}(E/\rho) and log 10 ⁡ ( σ Y / ρ ) \log_{10}(\sigma_{Y}/\rho) . The yield term is masked as for our predictors.
The optimizer is the released one: Adam with a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , no weight decay, and no schedule.
We train on PhysReader-Sim for five epochs with our global batch of 480 and report the fifth epoch.
The input is our crop of the video with its background, resized from 224 to 448 pixels. The released model was trained on objects rendered on a white background.
We do not run the per-scene refinement stage of Vid2Sim.
blocks.zh:
对于Vid2Sim [13],我们使用它的向导预测器并遵循已发布的训练代码.
骨干是VideoMAE基地. 它在448×448 448\times 448像素的16帧上完全微调. 它的标志是平均集合的,随发行的架构传到回归头.
发行的模型有三个头:一个是Young的modulus,一个是Poisson的比例,一个是其线形-宽皮(LBS)模拟器的重量.
我们删除我们模拟器没有使用的LBS头,并删除我们基准确定的Poisson比例头。
我们保留两个头并训练他们达到我们的两个目标,即第10号日志(E/ρ)\log_{10}(E/\rho)和第10号日志(Y/ρ)\log_{10}(\sigma_{Y}/\rho). 收益期被掩盖 和我们的预测者。
优化者是发行者: 亚当的学习率为10 - 5 10 - 5 },没有重量衰减,也没有时间表.
我们以480个全球批量在PhysReader-Sim上培训五个世纪,并报告第五世纪。
输入内容是我们用其背景制作的视频,从224像素调整为448像素. 所释放的模型是在白色背景上制造的物体上训练的.
我们不运行 Vid2Sim 的每层改进阶段。

blocks.en:
Analytic Dynamics [ 47 ] has no released code, so we implement it from the paper.
The teacher reads simulator particle trajectories: 1,024 points over 16 frames, with their displacements and a local deformation gradient fitted to neighboring points.
It is a point-cloud video transformer (P4Transformer) and regresses the same two targets as our predictors.
The student reads the 16 object masks at 128 × 128 128\times 128 pixels, without RGB, with a UniFormer backbone.
It is trained with the regression loss and with an alignment loss to the feature of the frozen teacher, the sum of a cosine distance and an L1 distance.
The paper leaves some details open, such as the weights of the alignment terms, the normalization of the targets, and the layer sizes. For these we made our own choices.
The student uses batch normalization synchronized across GPUs, because each GPU holds one clip.
Both networks are trained on PhysReader-Sim for five epochs, and we report the fifth epoch.
blocks.zh:
Analytic Dynamics [47] 没有发布代码,所以我们从文件中执行.
老师阅读模拟粒子轨迹:在16帧以上1,024分,其迁移和局部的变形梯度适合邻点.
它是一个点云视频变压器(P4Transformer),并倒退了与我们的预测器相同的两个目标.
学生在128×128128\times128像素时读取16个物体口罩,没有RGB,有UniFormer主干线.
它与回归损失和与冷冻教师特征的对齐损失、一个余弦距离和一个L1距离的总和一起训练。
论文留下了一些细节,如对齐条款的权重,目标正常化,以及层层大小等. 为了这些,我们做了自己的选择。
学生在GPU之间使用批量正常化同步,因为每个GPU持有一个片段.
两个网络都为五个纪元接受了PhysReader-Sim的培训,我们报告了第五个纪元.

blocks.en: M.1 Material Sensitivity and Appearance Robustness
blocks.zh: M.1 材料敏感性和外观强度

blocks.en:
The real-object references are not evenly distributed over material
parameters. We therefore complement the real-video evaluation with
controlled simulations that change material parameters while keeping
each object’s appearance fixed. This tests whether the models respond
to material-dependent motion, rather than only to differences between
object appearances.

实际对象参考文献在材料中分布不均
参数。 因此,我们对实际录像评价的补充是:

对象外观。

blocks.en:
Simulation is the right place to test whether predictors respond to material at all.
We sweep the stiffness in two sets of simulations that are not used for training.
The first re-simulates each of the 80 real drops in its reconstructed scene.
The second re-simulates 200 clips of the synthetic validation set from their source meshes, with the same pipeline; these are the 200 clips of Table S6 , from 199 held-out meshes.
Each drop or clip is simulated at eleven stiffness levels, log 10 ⁡ E ∈ { 4 , 4.5 , … , 9 } \log_{10}E\in\{4,4.5,\dots,9\} with E E in Pa, and with the yield stress fixed at σ Y = 10 7 \sigma_{Y}=10^{7} Pa.
Within a drop or clip only E E changes: mesh, initial state, camera, density, and Poisson’s ratio are fixed.
A synthetic clip also keeps its background image, exposure, and compression setting.
Masks, flow, and depth are estimated again on every video.
Of the 880 simulations of the real scenes, we use 874: one at log 10 ⁡ E = 8.5 \log_{10}E=8.5 and five at 9 are numerically unstable.
Of the 2,200 synthetic simulations, we use 2,097, from 193 clips: 70 are numerically unstable, and 33, all simulations of three clips, failed for technical reasons.

blocks.en:
Every RGB-based model orders stiffness correctly for 90–95% of pairs in the real scenes and for 95–97% in the synthetic clips (Table S10 and Fig. S2 ).
For these models the slope of predicted against true log 10 ⁡ E \log_{10}E is 0.56–0.64 in the real scenes and 0.69–0.74 in the synthetic clips.
A slope below one means that the predictions cover a narrower range than the true stiffness.
Without RGB, the model on 2D tracklets alone orders only 71.45% and 81.76% of pairs correctly.
The predictors therefore read material, not only appearance, and they differ mainly in how that reading survives the move to real video.
In the synthetic clips, the two models on tracklets lifted to 3D have the lowest log- E E error (0.54 and 0.52 dex), as on synthetic validation. In the real scenes they do not (0.86 and 0.81 dex).
blocks.zh:
每个基于RGB的模型都会正确订购真实场景中90–95%的对子和合成片段中95–97%的硬度(表S10和图S2).
对于这些模型,预测的坡度与真实的日志相对 10  E\log_{10}E在真实场景中为0.56–0.64,在合成片段中为0.69–0.74.
一个下方的坡度意味着预测所覆盖的范围比真正的硬度要窄.
没有RGB,仅2D轨迹上的型号就只能正确订购71.45%和81.76%的配对.
因此,预测器阅读了材料,不仅仅是外观,它们主要在读取如何在向真实视频的移动中存活上有所不同.
在合成夹片中,轨迹上升至3D的两个模型的对数最低——E错误(0.54和0.52 dex),如同合成验证一样. 在真实的场景中它们不会(0.86和0.81 dex).

blocks.en:
Much of the error comes from the stiffest levels.
In these sweeps, σ Y = 10 7 \sigma_{Y}=10^{7} Pa, so the stiffest simulations stay elastic, and an elastic drop deforms less as E E grows.
We measure how much each simulation deforms. In every frame, we remove the best rigid motion of all particles and take the 95th percentile of the remaining displacement. We keep its largest value over the window, in pixels of the 224 × 224 224\times 224 crop given to the predictors.
In the real scenes, the median of this non-rigid displacement over the 80 drops is 10 pixels at 10 5 10^{5} Pa, 2.4 at 10 6 10^{6} Pa, 0.23 at 10 7 10^{7} Pa, and at most 0.07 from 10 7.5 10^{7.5} Pa on (Fig. S2 , bottom). From 10 8 10^{8} Pa on, 95–100% of the drops deform by less than one pixel.
In the synthetic clips, the median of this non-rigid displacement over the 193 clips is 20 pixels at 10 5 10^{5} Pa, 10 at 10 6 10^{6} Pa, 3.3 at 10 7 10^{7} Pa, and at most 1.6 from 10 7.5 10^{7.5} Pa on. From 10 8 10^{8} Pa on, 60–82% of the clips deform by less than one pixel.
The synthetic clips deform more at the same E E because their objects are denser (median density about 1,100 against 348 kg/m 3 ), and the deformation depends on E / ρ E/\rho (App. E ).
In the real scenes, the drops at 10 8 10^{8} Pa and above look like the drop of a rigid object, and E = 10 8 E=10^{8} and 10 9 10^{9} Pa give nearly the same video (Fig. S5 ).
Without the three stiffest levels, the log- E E error of the models with RGB falls from 0.71–0.86 to 0.52–0.58 dex in the real scenes and from 0.53–0.60 to 0.42–0.47 dex in the synthetic clips, and their slopes rise to 0.69–0.77 and 0.80–0.84 (Table S10 ).
Five objects of the benchmark have a reference stiffness of 10 8 10^{8} Pa or more: the bottle, the bowl, the box, the hanger, and the trash bin (Table S3 ).
All five yield in their reference simulations, at σ Y ≤ 10 6.2 \sigma_{Y}\leq 10^{6.2} Pa, so their real drops deform plastically and visibly.

blocks.en:
We test appearance in two ways.
In simulation, we change only the texture.
Each of the 200 synthetic validation clips is simulated once with its own material and rendered six times over identical motion: with its original texture and with the textures of five other objects, the same five for every clip (Fig. S8 ).
The texture can be replaced only if the mesh carries an image texture. This is the case for 182 of the 200 clips.
This gives 1,110 renders: one with the original texture for each of the 200 clips, and five with other textures for each of the 182 clips. We use 1,073 of them. For the others, the simulation is numerically unstable (19) or the run failed for technical reasons (18). This leaves 880 pairs of an original and a retextured render, from 176 clips.
Every render gets the background image, exposure, and compression setting of the original clip, and flow, depth, and masks are estimated again on every render.
Table S11 reports how much the predicted z E z_{E} changes from the original render to a retextured render.
Replacing the texture changes the predicted z E z_{E} by 0.22–0.26 dex for the models with RGB and by 0.34 dex for 2D tracklets alone.
The z E z_{E} error changes little with the texture, by at most 0.032 dex. For the models with RGB, it is 0.42–0.52 dex on the original renders and 0.43–0.50 dex on the retextured renders.
No model is invariant to texture: the predictions move. But no model is misled by it.
On real video, App. L.8 changes viewpoint, distance, background, and lighting over 40 recordings of one object (Fig. S9 ).
There the standard deviation of the predicted z E z_{E} over the 40 recordings is 0.24 dex for PhysReader and more than 1 dex for the two models on 3D tracklets.

200个合成验证片段的每个片段都用自己的材料模拟一次,并经过同样的运动做了6次:其原始纹理和另外5个物体的纹理,每片片段相同5次(图S8).

这使1,110个编组:一个为200个剪辑的原纹理,另一个为182个剪辑的原纹理。 我们使用其中的1073个. 对其他人来说,模拟数字不稳定(19)或运行因技术原因失败(18). 留下880对正本和折叠成品,来自176个片段。
每个渲染得到原始剪辑的背景图像、曝光和压缩设置,每一渲染再次估计流、深度和口罩。
表S11报告预测的z E z _{E } 从最初的渲染到重写渲染的渲染的改变幅度。

在那里,预测的z E z_{E}超过40个录音的标准偏差是PhysReader的0.24 dex,以及3D轨道上两个模型的1 dex以上.

blocks.en: M.2 More Ablations
blocks.zh: M.2 更多损害

blocks.en:
All ablations reuse the training set, the schedule, and the evaluation of the main paper.
Tables S12 and S13 evaluate every model on all 80 real drops.
blocks.zh:
所有涂料都重复了训练集,时间表,以及主要论文的评价.
表S12和S13评价所有80个真实投注的每个模型.

blocks.en:
Table S12 lists the direct predictors, that is, the predictors trained without a teacher, that differ in their geometric input. Table S7 adds the depth and tracking variants of the lifted model.
Combined with RGB, all 2D inputs reach nearly the same z E z_{E} error on synthetic validation (0.48 dex). The deformation cues are the local strain, the stretch, and the non-affine residual computed from the 2D tracklets. On real drops, RGB with each deformation cue alone, without the tracklets themselves, gives a parameter distance of 0.76–0.77, and RGB with all three cues gives 0.78. These values lie between RGB (0.80) and RGB + 2D tracklets (0.74).
Adding the cues to the 2D tracklets changes little: 0.739 with all three cues and 0.761 with the non-affine residual, against 0.745 for the tracklets alone.
The cues are computed from the tracklets, and they are relative quantities: strain, stretch, and the non-affine residual do not change when the whole object moves or rotates, so they carry no information about its motion.
The tracklets keep the position and the displacement of every point, so they contain both the motion of the object and the local deformation from which the cues are computed.
A likely reason why the cues add little is that the model can learn from the tracklets what it needs.
blocks.zh:
表S12列出了直接预测器,即没有老师培训的预测器,这些预测器在几何输入上有所不同. 表S7增加了升空模型的深度和跟踪变体.
结合RGB,所有2D输入在合成验证(0.48 dex)上达到几乎相同的z E z_{E}错误. 变形提示是局部的菌株,拉伸,以及从2D轨迹计算出来的非亚芬残留. 在真实投放时,单凭每个变形提示的RGB,没有轨迹本身,给出的参数距离为0.76–0.77,所有三个提示的RGB给出0.78. 这些值位于RGB(0.80)和RGB+2D轨道(0.74)之间.
将提示加到2D赛道上的变化很小:0.739与所有3个提示加到0.761与非亚芬残基加到0.745,而单是赛道就只有0.745.
提示是从轨迹中计算出来的,它们是相对量的: 菌株,拉伸,非亚芬残基在整体物体移动或旋转时不会改变,所以它们不会携带关于其运动的信息.
轨迹保持每个点的位置和移动,因此既包含物体的运动,也包含计算提示的局部变形.
提示没有多少增加的一个可能的原因是,模型可以从轨道中学习它所需要的东西.

blocks.en:
Every model of the main paper is a single training run; App. X retrains nine of them with two more seeds.
RGB + 3D tracklets was also trained a second time, in the study of Table S7 .
That study trains the model under four conditions, A–D. Condition D, with 4RC depth and WAFT tracks, has the same inputs as the main run, so it is a second run of the same model. We call it run D.

该研究在4个条件下对模型进行训练,A–D. Condition D,拥有4RC深度和WAFT轨迹,与主跑相同投入,因此是同一型号的第二次运行. 我们管它叫D

blocks.en:
Table S13 varies the teacher–student training.
With 2D tracklets, every student variant has a smaller parameter distance on real drops than the direct predictor, RGB + 2D tracklets: 0.68–0.73 against 0.74.
The z E z_{E} error on synthetic validation is nearly the same.
PhysReader uses a teacher that is trained for ten epochs and selected on synthetic validation.
With a teacher stopped after five epochs instead, the parameter distance of the student is 0.699 instead of 0.677.
Two variants change the student of the five-epoch teacher (0.699).
In the first, the material head is trained together with the student instead of being kept frozen; its parameter distance is 0.711.
In the second, the feature loss has a smaller weight, 0.25 (Table S13 ); its parameter distance is 0.726.
Neither helps.
With lifted tracklets, the two students have parameter distances of 1.09 and 1.16.
They stay far from every model on 2D tracklets, so training with the teacher does not repair the lifted input.

两个变体改变五经教师的学生(0.699).

在第二个中,特征损失的重量较小,为0.25(表S13);其参数距离为0.726.

blocks.en:
Our models predict the density-normalized ratios E / ρ E/\rho and σ Y / ρ \sigma_{Y}/\rho .
App. H compares this regression target with the absolute parameters E E and σ Y \sigma_{Y} , for the teacher on exact surface deformation (Table S1 ).
For this comparison, we train a second teacher on PhysReader-Sim with absolute targets, log 10 ⁡ E \log_{10}E and log 10 ⁡ σ Y \log_{10}\sigma_{Y} , and select its checkpoint in the same way.
On the 14,293 synthetic validation videos with usable surface geometry, its error is 0.272 dex for stiffness and 0.262 dex for yield stress.
On the same videos, the teacher with density-normalized ratios reaches 0.161 dex and 0.192 dex.
No input carries the density, so an absolute target adds the spread of log 10 ⁡ ρ \log_{10}\rho to the error.
We also train a student on the teacher with absolute targets, with everything else as for PhysReader.
On synthetic validation it is nearly as accurate as PhysReader: its error of log 10 ⁡ E \log_{10}E / log 10 ⁡ σ Y \log_{10}\sigma_{Y} is 0.494 / 0.360 dex, against 0.481 / 0.356 dex for PhysReader. For PhysReader these equal its z E z_{E} and z Y z_{Y} errors, because the density of each synthetic video is known.
On the real drops it is much worse.
Its parameter distance is 1.016, against 0.677 for PhysReader.
Replay with its material increases the total loss by 13.6% and the deformation loss by 19.7% over the reference, against 10.1% and 12.3% for PhysReader.
Its Err ref \mathrm{Err}_{\mathrm{ref}} is 0.136, against 0.107.

blocks.en:
All our predictors use V-JEPA 2 with the same adaptation: LoRA of rank 16 on the query and value projections of the last 12 layers, with the patch projection and the layer norms also trained (2.5 M of the backbone’s 305 M parameters).
For RGB + 2D tracklets we trained the same model with the backbone frozen entirely, all else equal.
Its z E z_{E} / z Y z_{Y} error on synthetic validation rises from 0.482 / 0.363 to 0.692 / 0.447 dex.
Its parameter distance on the 80 real drops rises from 0.745 to 0.960.
We also fine-tune the whole backbone without LoRA, at the learning rate of the trained backbone parameters in our default setting ( 10 − 4 10^{-4} ).
The synthetic error is then 0.374 / 0.317 dex and the parameter distance 0.818.
We did not vary the backbone itself in a matched setting.
The Vid2Sim predictor of Table 5 is a fully fine-tuned VideoMAE trained on the same videos and targets.
Its synthetic error is 0.556 / 0.414 dex and its parameter distance 0.960, against 0.478 / 0.362 dex and 0.797 for our RGB-only predictor.

blocks.en: Appendix N Per-Object and Per-Metric Results

blocks.en:
All predictors are evaluated after the fifth epoch.
Lifted models are the models that read tracklets lifted to 3D.
The main paper reports the parameter distance for some of them (Table 1 ) and the z E z_{E} error for others (Table 4 , Fig. 4 ).
Table S14 gives every parameter metric for all of them.
Every lifted model is worse than RGB + 2D tracklets in parameter distance and in both stiffness metrics, the E E distance and the z E z_{E} error.
This holds for each depth source and each training condition.
For most of them the z Y z_{Y} error is higher as well.
The two exceptions are model A, trained on simulator depth and tracks (0.361 dex against 0.423 dex for RGB + 2D tracklets), and the model on 3D tracklets alone (0.408 dex).

这两个例外是A型号,训练有模拟深度和轨迹(0.361 dex对0.423 dex对RGB+2D轨迹),单是3D轨迹上的型号(0.408 dex).

blocks.en:
Tables S15 – S17 break the real-video results down by object, for five of our predictors and three baselines.
On four soft objects (crocs, glove, pillow, and sneaker), the lifted models are closer to the references than the models on 2D tracklets. On the stiff objects, they are much farther from the references.
On real video, the stiffness that the lifted models predict is lower than the reference on 67 (RGB + 3D tracklets) and 66 (student on 3D tracklets) of the 80 drops, by 1.1 dex on average.
The 2D models have no such shift (App. T ).
PhysReader has a smaller parameter distance than RGB + 2D tracklets on 12 of the 16 objects.
It also has a smaller parameter distance than RGB + 3D tracklets on 12 of the 16 objects.
No predictor is accurate on every object: for box, hanger, and medkit, all of ours are more than 1 dex from the plausible region.
blocks.zh:
表S15 – S17按对象分解真视频结果,用于我们的5个预测器和3个基线.
在四个软物体(crocs,手套,枕头,和运动鞋)上,升空模型比2D轨道上的模型更接近引用. 在坚硬的物体上,它们比参考文献要远得多。
在真实的视频中,被解除的模型预测的僵硬度低于80个滴滴中67个(RGB + 3D轨道)和66个(3D轨道上的学生)的参考值,平均为1.1 dex.
2D模型没有这样的转变(App. T.).
PhysReader在16个对象中的12个对象的参数距离比RGB+2D轨道要小.
在16个对象中的12个对象上,它的参数距离也比RGB+3D轨道小.
每个物体上没有一个预测器是准确的:对于盒式,挂式,和medkit,我们所有的东西都超过来自可信区域的1dex.

blocks.en: The tensile tests were run on an Instron 68FM-100 universal testing machine. The specimens were photographed with a Teledyne FLIR Blackfly S BFS-U3-200S6M monochrome camera (Sony IMX183 CMOS sensor, 5472 × 3648 5472\times 3648 pixels) through a Kowa LM75FC24M C-mount lens (focal length 75 mm, aperture f/2.5–f/16). We analyze 38 tensile test records from eight objects. A record can contain several loading-unloading cycles. For the 11 records with four loading-unloading cycles, we use only the fourth loading data to calculate the stiffness. Each of the other records keeps all the loading branches it has. This gives 39 analyzed branches in total.
blocks.zh: 抗拉强度测试是在Instron 68FM-100通用测试机上进行的. 标本用一台Teledyne FLIR Blackfly S BFS-U3-200S6M单色相机(Sony IMX183 CMOS传感器,5472×3648 5472\times 3648像素)拍摄. 通过高瓦LM75FC24M C-悬挂镜头(焦距75毫米,孔径f/2.5–f/16). 我们分析8个物体的38个抗拉强度测试记录。 记录可以包含多个加载-卸载周期. 对于有四个加载-卸载周期的11个记录,我们只使用第四个加载数据来计算硬度. 其他记录中的每一张都保留着它所有的装载分支. 这样,共有39个分支经过分析。

Different types of materials have different definitions of yield stress σ Y \sigma_{Y} , and the recorded stress–strain curves do not reliably identify one. The tables below therefore list σ Y \sigma_{Y} as “Not identified”. Instead, we mark and report the peak stress σ peak = max i ⁡ F i / A 0 \sigma_{\rm peak}=\max_{i}F_{i}/A_{0} over the retained branch(es). The object summary lists it as “Peak stress”. Where rupture of the specimen is not documented, σ peak \sigma_{\rm peak} is the highest recorded nominal stress, not a confirmed fracture stress.
For display, a curve with negative stress is shifted upward so its minimum is zero. Fits and statistics use the original stresses. In the plots, the selected fit intervals are drawn darker, and the dashed fitted lines extend beyond these intervals so that they are visible. Some plots are cut at a maximum strain, which their captions state. The reported peaks σ peak \sigma_{\rm peak} are still taken over the full record. On the pages of the objects, M j j denotes measurement j j and L k k its k k -th loading.

blocks.en: We measure the transverse contraction from pairs of photos taken during the first loading. The first photo of a pair shows the specimen at 0% strain. The second shows it at the available strain nearest to 5%, or at the largest valid strain below 5%. In each photo, we annotate one horizontal section across the specimen by hand. Its left and right endpoints x L x_{L} and x R x_{R} give the width w w in pixels of the original image. The two photos of a pair are displayed with the same crop and scale. The photos are taken at 10 fps, and we interpolate the recorded displacement d d to the times t 0 t_{0} and t i t_{i} of the two photos. We then compute the apparent Poisson’s ratio [ 3 ] : w 0 = x R , 0 − x L , 0 , w i = x R , i − x L , i , ε ∥ = d ⁡ ( t i ) − d ⁡ ( t 0 ) L 0 + d ⁡ ( t 0 ) , ε ⟂ = w i w 0 − 1 , ν app = − ε ⟂ ε ∥ . w_{0}=x_{R,0}-x_{L,0},\hskip 9.24994ptw_{i}=x_{R,i}-x_{L,i},\hskip 9.24994pt\varepsilon_{\parallel}=\frac{d(t_{i})-d(t_{0})}{L_{0}+d(t_{0})},\hskip 9.24994pt\varepsilon_{\perp}=\frac{w_{i}}{w_{0}}-1,\hskip 9.24994pt\nu_{\rm app}=-\frac{\varepsilon_{\perp}}{\varepsilon_{\parallel}}. (S33) All 37 available pairs were confirmed; diaper transverse measurement 1 has missing photos. Napkin’s frayed boundaries make its ratios noisy, so they are excluded from Poisson’s ratio summaries. The silicone pad has a honeycomb structure. Its contraction therefore describes this structure, not the Poisson’s ratio of the silicone itself. The two loading directions of the diaper give apparent ratios of opposite sign, so we keep them separate. We do not clip the measured ratios. We also do not change the simulation inputs to match them: each object keeps its fixed Poisson’s ratio.

Appendix P Additional Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录P 定性分析

blocks.en:
Fig. S3 compares a long-range point tracker with our short tracklets on the real drops.
We ran CoTracker3 in its online mode.
Each query point is started three frames before the collision and tracked through the 16 frames of the clip.
This gave usable tracks on 77 of the 80 drops; on the other three it gave none.
A track counts as valid while the tracker reports the point as visible and the point lies inside the object mask.
In the median drop, 94% of the tracks are still valid one frame after the collision, 80% four frames after it, and 7% at the end of the window.
In 60 of the 77 drops, fewer than half of the tracks are still valid at the end of the window.
The tracks do not become invalid because they leave the object.
Of the points that are no longer valid, 94% still lie inside the mask.
They are invalid because the tracker itself reports them as not visible, as the object rotates and blurs.
Our tracklets carry no visibility estimate, so we count them by position alone: a tracklet counts while its point lies inside the object mask.
Counted in the same way, a median of 92% of the long-range tracks remain inside the mask at the end of the window.
The long-range tracks that remain valid cover little of the object.
We measure coverage as the share of the object mask that lies within 8 pixels of a valid track, on the 224 × 224 224\times 224 crop.
At the end of the window, the median coverage of the long-range tracks is 17%.
For our tracklets it is 91–95% at the end of each of their four windows.
Our tracklets restart on the visible surface at C − 3 C-3 , C + 1 C+1 , C + 5 C+5 , and C + 8 C+8 , and a median of 88–97% of them are still on the object when a window ends.
App. V runs ten more long-range trackers on the same drops and compares how consistently they and our tracklets cover the object.
blocks.zh:
Fig. S3 将远程点追踪器与我们的短道速滑在真正的滴滴上进行比较.
我们运行了CoTracker3的在线模式。
每个查询点在碰撞前开始三个帧,并通过短片的16帧跟踪.
这为80个滴水点中的77个提供了可用的音轨;其他3个则没有。
一个音轨计数为有效,而跟踪者报告点为可见,点位于对象罩内.
在中位下降中,94%的轨道在碰撞后仍有效1帧,80%在碰撞后4帧,7%在窗口端.
在77个滴滴中的60个中,只有不到一半的音轨在窗口端仍然有效.
音轨不会因为离开对象而变为无效.
在已经无效的分数中,94%仍在面具内.
它们是无效的,因为跟踪器本身报告它们不可见,如物体旋转和模糊.
我们的赛道没有可见度估计,所以我们只按位置来计算:一个赛道计数,而它的点位于物体遮罩内.
以同样的方式计算,92%的中位数的长距离铁轨仍留在窗端的面具内.
仍然有效的长距离轨道覆盖对象的小部分.
在224×224/224\times 224的裁剪上,我们测量覆盖度是位于有效轨迹8像素范围内的物体遮罩的比重。
在窗口的尽头,长途轨道的中位覆盖率为17%.
在我们的轨道上, 4个窗口的每个窗口的末端是91-95%。
我们的轨迹在可见表面重新开始,C−3 C-3,C+1 C+1,C+5 C+5,C+8 C+8,当一个窗口关闭时,其中88–97%的轨迹仍在物体上.
App. V在同一滴水上又运行了10个远程跟踪器,并比较了它们和我们的轨道如何一致地覆盖物体.

blocks.en: Figure S3 : Long-range tracks through impact. Left: three real drops at C − 3 C-3 , C C , C + 4 C+4 , and C + 12 C+12 . Red: CoTracker3 (online), one 16-frame track per query started at C − 3 C-3 . Blue: our five-frame flow tracklets, restarted at C − 3 C-3 , C + 1 C+1 , C + 5 C+5 , and C + 8 C+8 . Dark dots are tracks that are no longer valid, drawn where the tracker still places them. The numbers below each frame give the valid tracks / the started tracks. Right: the fraction of long-range tracks that are still valid, on 77 drops (thin red lines: single drops; bold red line: median). Blue: the median fraction of our tracklets that are still inside the mask, for each of the four tracklet windows on the same 77 drops (band: interquartile range). A long-range track is valid while the tracker reports it visible and it lies inside the object mask. The dashed line counts long-range tracks by position alone (inside the mask), as the tracklets are counted.

blocks.en:
Fig. S5 shows three of the 80 drops of the stiffness sweep of App. M.1 , as the predictors see them.
At the lowest stiffness levels the object visibly changes shape; at the highest it moves almost rigidly, and the frames differ mainly in pose.
On the trash bin, the predictions of all three predictors shown (PhysReader, the student on 3D tracklets, and RGB) follow the true stiffness, and the student on 3D tracklets has the lowest error.
On the hanger and the bowl, the predictions of the student on 3D tracklets stay below the true stiffness and below the predictions of PhysReader for the stiffer materials.
This is the same shift toward soft materials as on real video (App. T ).
Over all 80 drops of the sweep, PhysReader has the lower error on 46.
Single drops vary; the averages over all 80 drops are in Table S10 .

费格。 S5显示的是App.M.1的80滴硬度扫荡中的三个,如预测者所见.
在最低的硬度水平上,物体明显改变形状;在最高水平上,物体几乎僵硬地移动,框架主要在姿势上有所不同。
在垃圾桶上,所显示的三个预测器(PhysReader,3D轨道上的学生,以及RGB)的预测都跟随真实的僵硬性,3D轨道上的学生有最小的错误.
在吊架和碗上,3D轨迹上的学生的预测都停留在真实僵硬度以下,并且低于PhysReader对僵硬材料的预测.
这与真实视频(App.

blocks.en:
Fig. S6 replays six real drops with the reference material and with the materials predicted by PhysReader and by the student on 3D tracklets.
Each simulation has its own refined initial state (App. J ).
We chose drops in which the difference between the two predicted materials is visible in still frames.
We also include two drops on which PhysReader fails.
Over all 80 drops, PhysReader has the smaller parameter distance on 61 and the student on 3D tracklets on 19.
For the trash bin, the bowl, and Kitty, the replay with PhysReader’s material moves like the reference, while the material of the 3D student is too soft: the bin ends tilted, the bowl flattens, and the toy collapses.
For the box, both predictions are too soft, and that of the 3D student more so.
Only the box replayed with the 3D student’s material shears.
For the medkit, both predictions are 1.6–1.8 dex too soft and both replays rebound, unlike the real bag.
For the glove, PhysReader is 1.1 dex too stiff and its replay springs up, while the 3D student is close to the reference.
The reference replay does not match the real video exactly either; for example, the real box stays upright and the reference box tilts.
blocks.zh:
费格。 S6以参考材料和PhysReader和学生在3D赛道上预言的材料重播6个真降.
每个模拟都有自己的精细初始状态(App.J).
我们选择了两个预言材料之间的差别在静态框中可见的下降.
我们还包括了两滴PhysReader故障.
在所有80个滴滴中,PhysReader在61上拥有较小的参数距离,在19上拥有3D轨道的学生.
对于垃圾桶,碗,和Kitty,用PhysReader的材料的重播动作类似参考,而3D学生的材料过于柔软:垃圾桶端倾斜,碗扁,玩具倒塌.
对于盒子来说,两个预测都太柔软了,对于3D学生来说更是柔软.
只有盒子与3D学生的材料剪切重放.
对于medkit来说,两种预测都是1.6–1.8 dex太柔软,两者都重现反弹,与真实的包不同.
对于手套,PhysReader是1.1 dex太僵硬,它的重播弹簧会升起,而3D的学生则接近参考.
参考重播也并不完全符合真实的视频;例如,真实的盒保持直立,参考箱倾斜.

blocks.en: Figure S6 : Replays with predicted materials. Six real drops (trash bin, drop 3; box, drop 4; medkit, drop 1; bowl, drop 5; Kitty, drop 5; glove, drop 4) at the collision frame C C and 6 and 12 frames later. Rows: the real video, and re-simulations with the reference material, with the material predicted by PhysReader (blue), and with the material predicted by the student on 3D tracklets (orange). Each simulation starts from its own refined initial state. Numbers are log 10 ⁡ E \log_{10}E in Pa. The right column shows two drops on which PhysReader fails.

Fig. S7 shows, on three real drops at the collision frame, the estimated depth that Table S6 evaluates.
Each estimate is made metric with one scale per clip, fitted to LiDAR in the first frame of the window.
At the collision frame, the absolute relative error of 4RC against LiDAR on the object is 3–6% on the three drops, and that of Depth Anything 3 (metric) is 4–6%.
Over the 16 frames of the clip, the error of 4RC stays at 4–6%.
The error of Depth Anything 3, which is run on single images, rises to 8–10%, because it is larger in the frames before the collision.
DepthCrafter outputs relative inverse depth, and with a single scale its error is 19–41%.
LiDAR is coarse at silhouettes, so the colors at the rim of the error maps partly reflect the sensor.
Depth of this accuracy does not make the lifted tracklets transfer, and neither does the LiDAR depth itself (Table 4 ).
blocks.zh:
图7. S7显示在碰撞框架的三次实际下降中,表S6评估的估计深度。
每个估计值都是每段标量,每段标量一个,在窗口第一帧安装到LiDAR.
在碰撞框架上,4RC相对于物体的LiDAR的绝对相对误差为3–6%的三滴,深度Anything 3(测量)的绝对相对误差为4–6%.
在短片的16帧上,4RC的错误仍然保持在4–6%.
在单个图像上运行的深度Anything 3的错误上升到8–10%,因为它在碰撞前的帧中较大.
深度Crafter输出相对反深度,单缩放其误差为19-41%.
LiDAR在silhouettes上粗糙,因此误差地图的边缘颜色部分反映了传感器.
这种精度的深度并不能使被解除的轨道转移,而LiDAR深度本身也无法实现(表4 ).

Fig. S8 shows three clips of the texture test of App. M.1 , as the predictors see them, and the spread of the prediction changes over all 880 pairs.

Fig. S9 shows the 40 additional recordings of Kitty that Tables S8 and S9 summarize, with every single prediction.
The predictions of PhysReader, RGB + 2D tracklets, and RGB span 1.0 to 1.3 dex.
Those of the two models on 3D tracklets span 3.5 dex across recordings of the same toy.
This happens under each of the four changed conditions (camera angle, distance, background, and lighting).
The line in the figure is the reference stiffness of Kitty.
blocks.zh:
图. S9显示的是Tables S8和S9汇总的Kitty的另外40张录音,并附有每一个预测.
对PhysReader,RGB + 2D轨道的预测,以及RGB跨度为1.0至1.3 dex的预测.

The number in each image is the index of the recording; the same index is bold on the axis below. Each image is the first of the 16 frames given to the predictors, three frames before the collision. Bottom: every predicted z E = log 10 ⁡ ( E / ρ ) z_{E}=\log_{10}(E/\rho) , one column per recording. The line is the reference stiffness of Kitty ( z E = 2.15 z_{E}=2.15 ) and the thin band its plausible region. The 40 predictions of PhysReader span 1.0 dex, with a standard deviation of 0.24 dex. Those of RGB + 2D tracklets and of RGB each span 1.3 dex (standard deviations 0.27 and 0.31 dex). Kitty被丢弃并录制了40次,在四个变化的条件下,每一次10次. 顶部:每个条件的十个录音中有两个. 每个图像中的数字是录制的索引;在下面的轴上,相同的索引是粗体. 每个图像是给预测器的16帧中的第一个,在碰撞之前有三个帧. 底部:每预言z E = log 10 ⁡ (E / ρ ρ) z _{ E }=\log _{ 10 }(E /\rho),每录一栏. 该线是Kitty的参考硬度(z E = 2.15 z _{E }=2.15),以及其假想区域的薄幅. 对PhysReader的40个预测跨度为1.0 dex,标准偏差为0.24 dex. RGB + 2D 轨迹和RGB 轨迹的轨迹各跨1.3 dex(标准偏差为0.27和0.31 dex). RGB+3D音轨和3D音轨学生的音轨各跨3.5 dex(标准偏差1.02和1.04 dex).

blocks.en:
Fig. S10 illustrates why the reference of a structured object can be softer than its specimens (App. T ).
The silicone pad has the largest gap: its reference stiffness is 1.24 dex below the mean stiffness of its tensile specimens.
One frame after the collision the real pad lies folded on the floor, and so does the replay with the reference material.
With the stiffness measured on its specimens, the simulated pad is a flat plate again and rebounds.
This is clearest in drops 2, 4, and 5; in drops 1 and 3 the pad is seen edge-on.
All replays start from the reference initial state of the drop, so only the stiffness differs.
Later in the window every replay, including the reference replay, rebounds more than the real pad, which stays on the floor. The reference stiffness of the pad lies at the lower bound of our search range ( E = 10 4 E=10^{4} Pa).
Fig. S11 shows the same comparison for one drop of each of the eight tensile-tested objects.
blocks.zh:
图. S10说明了为什么结构化物体的参考物比其标本更柔软(App. T.).
硅酮垫的缺口最大:其参考硬度低于其抗拉强度标本的平均硬度1.24 dex.
碰撞后的一个框架 真实的垫叠在地板上, 与参考材料的重播也是如此。
随着其标本上测量的坚硬度,模拟垫再次成为平板并反弹.
这在2,4和5滴中最为明显;在1和3滴中,垫被看到边缘。
所有重播都从投放的参考初始状态开始,因此只有硬度不同.
后来在窗口里每一次重播,包括参考重播,反弹超过真正的垫子,它停留在地板上. 垫的参考硬度位于我们搜索范围的下方(E=10 4 E=10^{4}pa).
图. S11显示8个抗拉强度测试对象中每滴一个的比较。

blocks.en: Figure S10 : The silicone pad replayed with tensile-measured stiffness. The five drops at the collision frame C C and one frame later. Rows: the real video; the replay with the reference material ( log 10 ⁡ E = 4.00 \log_{10}E=4.00 , E E in Pa); and replays with the lowest and the highest local stiffness of the pad’s tensile curves, that is, the lowest and the highest slope found on its stress–strain curves ( log 10 ⁡ E = 4.96 \log_{10}E=4.96 and 5.47 5.47 ; the specimen mean is 5.24 5.24 ). Yield stress, density, and Poisson’s ratio are unchanged. At C + 1 C+1 the real pad and the reference replay lie folded on the floor, while the replays with measured stiffness are flat plates that rebound. All replays start from the reference initial state of the drop.
blocks.zh: 图S10:硅酮垫以抗拉强度重放. 5架在碰撞帧C C上落下,1架在后. 行:真实的视频;与参考材料的重播(log 10 QQ E = 4.00\log 10}E = 4.00,E E in Pa);与垫面抗拉强度最小且地方性最高的重播,即其压力-斜面曲线上发现的最低和最高斜度(log 10 = 4.96\log 10}E = 4.96和 5.47 5.47;标本平均值为5.24 5.24 ). 叶尔德的压力,密度,和波森的比例没有变化. 在C+1 C+1时,真实的垫子和参考重放在地板上折叠,而有测量强度的重放则是平板反弹. 所有重播从投放的参考初始状态开始.

blocks.en: Figure S11 : All eight tensile-tested objects replayed with tensile-measured stiffness. Drop 2 of each object, one and six frames after the collision. Rows: the real video; the replay with the reference material; and replays with the lowest and the highest local stiffness of the object’s tensile curves, that is, the lowest and the highest slope found on its stress–strain curves. Yield stress, density, and Poisson’s ratio are unchanged. Numbers are log 10 ⁡ E \log_{10}E in Pa. All replays start from the reference initial state of the drop, so only the stiffness differs. A dagger marks the trash bin and the hanger: their highest tensile stiffness lies above 1 GPa, the largest stiffness our simulator accepts, so they are replayed at 1 GPa.
blocks.zh: 图S11:所有8个经抗拉强度测试的物体均以抗拉强度重播。 每个物体投放2个,碰撞后投放1个和6个帧. 行: 真实的视频; 与参考材料重播; 重播对象抗拉强度最小和最高的地方性曲线, 即其应力曲线上发现的最小和最高斜度。 叶尔德的压力,密度,和波森的比例没有变化. 数字是 log 10\\\ log\ 10} E in Pa。 所有重播都从引用的初始状态开始, 所以只有硬度不同 。 一个匕首标记了垃圾桶和吊架:它们最高的抗拉强度位于1GPa以上,这是我们模拟器接受的最大硬度,所以它们被重放在1GPa.

blocks.en:
Fig. S11 repeats the replay with tensile-measured stiffness for one drop of each of the eight objects with tensile tests.
The tensile curves do not give one stiffness per object.
Their local slope, which is the stiffness, varies between specimens, loading directions, and strain levels.
Within an object it varies by 0.5 to 2.5 dex; for the trash bin, it ranges from 8.9 MPa to 1.1 GPa.
We replay each drop at the lowest and at the highest of these values.
The reference lies inside this interval for four objects (trash bin, hanger, crocs, and diaper), 0.12 dex above it for the box, and below it for Kitty, the pad, and the napkin pack.
This interval runs from the lowest to the highest local slope. It differs from the band of Fig. 3 , which is the mean ± \pm 3 standard deviations of the specimens’ Young’s moduli; App. T compares the references with that band.
The replays at tensile stiffness differ visibly from the reference replay for the pad, which becomes a rigid plate at both values.
At the lowest value, the trash bin, the crocs, and the diaper also rebound higher than in the reference replay.
For the box, the hanger, Kitty, and the napkin pack, the replays at tensile stiffness look like the reference replay.
For Kitty, the pad, and the diaper, the reference replay itself rebounds more than the real object, and every replay of the napkin pack rebounds less than the real pack.
The comparison is qualitative. All replays start from the reference initial state of the drop, so only the stiffness differs.
The highest tensile stiffness of the trash bin and the hanger lies above 1 GPa, the largest stiffness our simulator accepts; we replay them at 1 GPa.
blocks.zh:
Fig. S11以抗拉力测量的僵硬度重复重播,用于8个物体中每1滴进行抗拉力测试.
抗拉强度曲线不给每个物体一个硬度.
它们的局部坡度,即坚硬度,因标本,装载方向,和菌株水平而异.
在一个物体内,它有0.5至2.5度的差异;对于垃圾桶,它从8.9兆帕到1.1千帕不等。
我们以最低和最高的数值重播。
参考文献位于此间隔内,用于四件物品(垃圾桶,吊架,鳄鱼和尿布),上方0.12 dex用于盒子,下方用于Kitty,垫子,餐巾包.
这个间隔从最低到最高的地方坡度. 它和图3的带子不同 这是标本的平均值 ±\pm 3标准差 Young的moduli; App. (英语). T将参考文献与那个乐队进行比较.
抗拉强度的回放与垫的参考回放明显不同,垫在两个值都变成了一个硬盘.
在最低值,垃圾桶,鳄鱼,尿布的反弹也比参考重播时高.
对于盒子,吊架,Kitty,和餐巾包,抗拉强度的回放看起来就像参考重放.
对于Kitty,垫子,和尿布,参考重放本身的反弹大于真实对象,每回弹的餐巾包反弹都小于真实的包.
比较是定性的。 所有重播都从投放的参考初始状态开始,因此只有硬度不同.
垃圾桶和吊架的最高抗拉强度位于1GPa以上,是我们模拟器接受的最大抗拉强度;我们以1GPa重播。

blocks.en: Appendix Q Vision-Language Model Baselines
blocks.zh: 附录Q 远景规划 示范基线

blocks.en: We evaluate OpenAI GPT-6 Astra ( gpt-6-astra ) on all 80 real drop recordings under two input conditions: a single image and a sequence of 16 frames. Each drop and input condition is processed in a separate request, without previous responses or conversation history. The two baselines share the system prompt, parameter bounds, and model settings.
blocks.zh: 我们评价OpenAI GPT-6 Astra(gpt-6-astra )在两个输入条件下的所有80个真投影录音:一个图像和一个16帧的序列. 每滴和输入条件在单独的请求中处理,没有先前的回复或对话历史. 这两个基线共享系统即时,参数界限和模型设置.

blocks.en: We use frame 0 of the original recording. From its SAM 3.1 object mask, we compute a bounding box and construct a square crop centered at the box center, with side length ⌈ 1.15 ​ max ⁡ ( w , h ) ⌉ \lceil 1.15\max(w,h)\rceil , where w w and h h are the box dimensions in pixels. Pixels outside the image are padded by edge replication. The crop is resized to 512 × 512 512\times 512 using Lanczos interpolation. We retain the natural background inside the crop; the mask is used only to determine the crop. No additional frames or observations of later motion are supplied.
blocks.zh: 我们使用原始录制的帧0。 从其SAM 3.1 对象掩码中,我们计算一个边框,并构造一个以盒子中心为中心的方块裁剪,边长为 ⌈ 1.15 最大 ⁡ (w, h) ⌉\lceil 1.15\max (w, h)\rceil,其中w和h是像素中的盒子尺寸. 图像外的像素通过边缘复制加成. 作物利用兰科斯插值调整为512×512 512\时. 我们保留作物内部的自然背景;面具只用来决定作物。 没有为以后的动议提供额外的框架或观察。

blocks.en: We use exactly the same 16 frames of the original recording as our predictors. This is the window from C − 3 C-3 through C + 12 C+12 around the collision frame C C , so C C is the fourth frame of the sequence. We compute a single square crop from the union of the SAM 3.1 object masks over these frames, with the same margin, padding, and resizing as the image baseline. This crop remains fixed throughout the sequence. We send the frames as 16 separate image inputs within one request, in chronological order, interleaved with text specifying their original frame indices and timestamps. The timestamp of frame i i comes from its presentation time T i T_{i} , decoded from the source video. We express it relative to frame C C : t i = T i − T C . t_{i}=T_{i}-T_{C}. (S34) For a constant-rate recording, this equals ( i − C ) / f (i-C)/f , where f f is its original frame rate. We do not draw timestamps on the RGB images.
blocks.zh: 我们使用完全相同的16帧 原始录音作为我们的预测器。 这是C−3 C-3通过C+12 C+12环绕碰撞框架C C的窗口,因此C C是序列的第四帧. 我们从SAM 3.1物体口罩的联盟中 计算出一个单一的方块, 与图像基线相同。 这种作物在整个序列中保持不变。 我们在一个请求中将框架作为16个单独的图像输入,按时间顺序,与具体说明其原始框架指数和时间戳的文本相交。 Fram i 的时间戳来自它的演示时间 T i T_{i},解码自源视频. 我们表示它相对于框架C C: t i = T i − T C. t_{i}=i}i}i}i}-T_{C}. (S34) 对于恒定速率的录制,这等于(i-C) / f(i-C)/f,其中f是其原始帧率. 我们不会在 RGB 图像上绘制时间戳 。

blocks.en:
The prompts specify the benchmark’s homogeneous, isotropic Neo-Hookean elastic model with von Mises plasticity. We supply the fixed density and Poisson’s ratio of the object in the recording, gravity, original image dimensions, crop coordinates, processed image dimensions, padding convention, and available original camera intrinsics. Missing intrinsics are recorded as unavailable. Reference materials, plausible regions, tensile measurements, and predictions from other recordings are not included in the prompts.
The permitted absolute parameter ranges are E ∈ [ 10 4 , 10 9 ] ​ Pa , σ Y ∈ [ 10 5 , 2 × 10 7 ] ​ Pa . E\in[10^{4},10^{9}]\,\mathrm{Pa},\qquad\sigma_{Y}\in[10^{5},2\times 10^{7}]\,\mathrm{Pa}. (S35) For the supplied density ρ \rho in kg / m 3 \mathrm{kg/m^{3}} , the corresponding permitted log-ratio bounds are z E \displaystyle z_{E} ∈ [ 4 − log 10 ⁡ ρ , 9 − log 10 ⁡ ρ ] , \displaystyle\in[4-\log_{10}\rho,\;9-\log_{10}\rho], (S36) z Y \displaystyle z_{Y} ∈ [ 5 − log 10 ⁡ ρ , log 10 ⁡ ( 2 × 10 7 ) − log 10 ⁡ ρ ] . \displaystyle\in[5-\log_{10}\rho,\;\log_{10}(2\times 10^{7})-\log_{10}\rho]. (S37) The model returns z E z_{E} and z Y z_{Y} , a categorical description of yield evidence, and a short evidence summary. Absolute parameters are calculated in code as E ^ = ρ ​ 10 z ^ E , σ ^ Y = ρ ​ 10 z ^ Y . \widehat{E}=\rho\,10^{\widehat{z}_{E}},\qquad\widehat{\sigma}_{Y}=\rho\,10^{\widehat{z}_{Y}}. (S38) The model does not predict density separately.
blocks.zh:
提示中指定了基准的同质,异质的Neo-Hookean弹性模型与 von Mises 可塑性. 我们提供物体在记录、重力、原始图像维度、作物坐标、处理图像维度、粘贴常规和可用原始相机内在的固定密度和Poisson的比例。 缺少的内在内容被记录为没有。 参考材料、可信的区域、抗拉强度测量和其他录音的预测没有包括在提示中。
允许的绝对参数范围是 E\\ [10 4, 10 9] pa, \ Y\\ [10 5, 2\ 10 7] pa,\ mathrm{Pa},\quad\ sigma\ Y\\ \\ 10\ 10\\ 5},\\\ 10\ 10\ 10\ 10\ rho,(S36), \ \ \ \ 10\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ , \ \ \ \ \ \ 10\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ (S37)模型返回 z E z_{E}和 z Y z_{Y},对产物证据的断然描述,以及简短的证据摘要. 绝对参数按E^ = ^ 10 z ^ ^ ^ ^ ^ ^ ^ ^ ^ ^ ^ ^ (S38)该模型不分别预测密度.

blocks.en: We use the official OpenAI Python SDK (version 2.48.0) and Responses API, with image detail set to high , reasoning effort to medium , and a maximum output budget of 4,096 tokens, including reasoning tokens. Temperature, top- p p , and seed are left unspecified for both baselines. Responses use the API’s strict JSON-schema output format with exactly the four fields listed below. We retain all raw responses, processed input images, frame indices, timestamps, crop metadata, prompts, and token usage. We do not clamp the predictions to the permitted bounds, and we do not repeat a request because of the accuracy of its prediction. All 160 requests completed successfully on their first attempt. Parameter distance and replay are computed on all 80 drops with the references of Sec. 4 . Yield stress is scored on the 50 drops whose reference simulation yields, independently of the yield evidence that the model reports.
blocks.zh: 我们使用OpenAI Python SDK(版本2.48.0)和Resolution API,图像细节设定为高 ,推理努力为中 ,最大输出预算为4,096个令牌,包括推理令牌. 温度,顶端-pp,种子两个基线都未指明. 回复使用API严格的JSON-schema输出格式,精确地按以下四个字段排列. 我们保留所有原始回复、处理过的输入图像、框架指数、时间戳、作物元数据、提示和符号使用。 我们不把预测限制在允许的限度内,也不因预测的准确性而重复要求。 所有160项请求均在第一次尝试中成功完成。 参数距离和重播 在所有80 滴与参考 第4 sec. Yield压力的得分来自其参考模拟产量的50滴,与模型报告的产量证据无关。

blocks.en: The following prompt is identical for the two baselines. You estimate effective mechanical parameters of a whole deformable object from visual observations. The benchmark represents the entire object using one homogeneous, isotropic Neo-Hookean elastic material with von Mises plasticity. Estimate parameters for this effective whole-object model, not merely textbook properties of a visible constituent material. The requested outputs are: z_E = log10(E / rho) z_Y = log10(sigma_Y / rho) Here E and sigma_Y are in pascals and rho is in kg/m^3. The ratios are expressed numerically in SI units, m^2/s^2. Do not estimate density separately. Use the supplied observation and calibration information. Do not assume unavailable measurements, hidden internal structure, or access to other recordings of the object. When temporal observations are available, use deformation magnitude, deformation timing, recovery, and residual shape change as evidence. Distinguish deformation from rigid translation, rotation, perspective change, and occlusion. A short interval without visible recovery does not by itself prove plasticity. A recording with no visible plasticity does not uniquely identify yield stress. When evidence is insufficient, still return a best prior-based point estimate, and mark the evidence limitation. Return only one JSON object with these fields: - ”log10_E_over_rho”: a finite number - ”log10_sigmaY_over_rho”: a finite number - ”yield_evidence”: one of ”observed”, ”not_observed”, ”unclear”, or ”not_assessable” - ”evidence_summary”: at most two sentences describing the visible evidence and important uncertainty Do not output ranges instead of the required point estimates.
blocks.zh: 两种基线的下列提示相同。 你从视觉观察中估计整个变形物体的有效机械参数. 基准代表整个物体,使用一个同质的,异质的Neo-Hookean弹性材料与von Mises可塑性. 这一有效的整体目标模型的估计参数,而不仅仅是一个可见组成材料的教科书性质。 要求的产出为:z_E=log10(E/rho)z_Y=log10(sigma_Y/rho) 这里为E和sigma_. Y为帕斯卡,rho为kg/m^3. 比率以SI单位(m^2/s^2)的数字表示。 不分别估计密度。 使用所提供的观测和校准信息。 不要假设无法测量、隐藏内部结构或获取物体的其他录音。 当有时间观测时,使用变形规模,变形时间,恢复,剩余形状变化作为证据. 区分变形与刚性翻译,旋转,视角变化,以及隔离. 没有明显恢复的短间隔本身并不证明具有可塑性。 没有可见的可塑性的记录不能唯一地识别产量压力。 在证据不足时,仍应返回最佳的先前点估计,并标出证据限制。 仅返回一个带有这些字段的 JSON 对象 : - “log10_E_over_rho ” : 有限数字 - “log10_sigmaY_over_rho ”: 有限数字 - “产出_证据” : “观察”、“非观察”、“ 不明确” 或 “不可评估” - “证据_摘要” : 最多两句描述明显证据和重要不确定性 不使用输出范围, 而不是所需的点估计 。

blocks.en: Observation type: one RGB image. This is frame 0 of the original drop recording, cropped around the object with a fixed 15% margin. No temporal observations are supplied. Do not infer that a particular deformation, rebound, or recovery event was observed. Shared benchmark context: {COMMON_CALIBRATION_AND_CONTEXT} Benchmark-wide permitted log-parameter bounds: {FROZEN_LOG_PARAMETER_BOUNDS} Estimate the two effective material log-ratios for the object.
blocks.zh: 观测类型:一个RGB图像. 这是原投放录制的框 0,用固定的15%的边距在对象周围裁剪. 没有提供时间观察。 不要推断观察到了特定的变形、反弹或恢复事件。 共享基准背景: {COMMON_CALION_AND_CONTEXT}(中文(简体) ). 全基准允许的对数参数: {FROZEN_LOG_PARAMETER_BOUNDS} 估计对象的两个有效物质对数-梯度。

blocks.en: Observation type: a chronological RGB sequence from one drop. All frames depict the same object in one fixed crop. The timestamps describe the original recording speed. Time zero corresponds to the contact frame. Frame timestamps in seconds: {ACTUAL_TIMESTAMPS} Shared benchmark context: {COMMON_CALIBRATION_AND_CONTEXT} Benchmark-wide permitted log-parameter bounds: {FROZEN_LOG_PARAMETER_BOUNDS} Use the observed temporal behavior to estimate the two effective material log-ratios. Appearance may provide a prior when motion is uninformative, but do not replace observed dynamics with a material name lookup.
blocks.zh: 观测类型:从一个滴出的时间顺序RGB序列. 所有帧在一个固定的裁剪中描绘同一个物体. 时间戳描述了原始的录制速度. 时间0与接触框对应. 帧时间戳( 秒): {ACTUAL_ TIMESTAMPS} 共享的基准上下文 : {COMMON_CALION_AND_CONTEXT}(中文(简体) ). 全基准允许的对数参数: {FROZEN_LOG_PARAMETER_BOUNDS} 使用观测到的时间行为来估计两个有效的物质对数-ratios. 外观可以在运动无信息化时提供前置条件,但不以物名外观取代观测动态.

blocks.en: The names in braces are placeholders that we fill in for each request. {COMMON_CALIBRATION_AND_CONTEXT} is replaced by the calibration fields described above. {FROZEN_LOG_PARAMETER_BOUNDS} is replaced by both the absolute ranges and the density-normalized log bounds. {ACTUAL_TIMESTAMPS} is replaced by a list that gives the original index, the relative frame index, and the relative timestamp of every input frame. After the video user prompt, the request contains the 16 frames in order. Each frame consists of a text entry of the form “Frame r r (original frame i i ), time = t =t seconds” and then its RGB image. Actual timestamp values are written to nine decimal places.
blocks.zh: 牙套里的名字是每个请求的占位符。 {COMMON_CALIBATION_AND_CONTEXT}由上述校准字段所取代. {FROZEN_LOG_PARAMETER_BOUNDS}被绝对范围与密度常态化的日志界限所取代。 {ACTUAL_TIMESTAMPS}被列表所取代,列表给出了原始索引,相对帧索引,以及每个输入帧的相对时间戳. 在视频用户提示后,请求中按顺序包含16帧. 每个帧由“Frame r (原始框架 i ),时间 = t = t 秒”的表单文本条目组成,然后是其RGB图像。 实际时间戳值为小数点后九位。

blocks.en: Q.1 Agent-Based Material Estimation
blocks.zh: Q.1 基于物剂的材料估计

blocks.en:
We evaluate whether a general-purpose coding agent can recover
material parameters by autonomously interacting with a physics
simulator. We use Codex as the agent and provide it with the
full 60-frame real drop video, the reconstructed object mesh,
and our MPM simulator.

The agent uses the same MPM simulator as our other

ratio are fixed to the values in Table S2 , while Young’s

The agent may also estimate drop-specific initial conditions,

模拟

blocks.en:
Each drop is processed by a fresh Codex session, launched
using codex exec . Each session runs in an isolated
workspace containing only its corresponding video, object

The agent cannot access other drop videos, reference material

Each agent is allocated one NVIDIA A100 GPU and a maximum

We convert the predicted parameters to the density-normalized

blocks.en: Appendix R Statistics, Validation Protocols, and Robustness
blocks.zh: 附录R 统计、审定协议和健全性

blocks.en: This section tests how far the main results generalize: their uncertainty over objects, which validation data predict real accuracy, where the lifting failure comes from, and how much training choices matter.
blocks.zh: 本节测试主要结果的概括程度:它们对于物体的不确定性,哪些验证数据预测真实的准确性,升降故障来自何处,以及训练选择有多重要.

blocks.en: R.1 Object-Level Uncertainty
blocks.zh: R.1 对象层次的不确定性

blocks.en:
PhysReader-Real has 16 objects, so we treat the object as the unit of resampling.
We draw 16 objects with replacement 10,000 times, keep all drops of each drawn object, and report the mean parameter distance with its 95% percentile interval.
For the difference between two predictors, each draw uses the same objects for both predictors, so the difference is paired.
An object counts as a win for a predictor when the predictor’s mean parameter distance over the drops of that object is lower than that of the other predictor (Table S19 ).
blocks.zh:
PhysReader-Real有16个对象,所以我们把对象当作再复制的单位.
我们绘制了16个物体,替换了10 000次, 保留每个绘图对象的所有投影, 并报告平均参数距离 95% 的间隔 。
对于两个预测器之间的差数,每个绘图器对两个预测器都使用相同的对象,因此差数成对.
当预测者在该对象的下降点上的平均参数距离低于其他预测者(表S19)时,一个对象算作预测者的胜负。
