blocks.en:
Table 2 compares several kinds of validation data.
We call each of them a protocol.
Each protocol gives one validation error to each of the eight predictors of Table 1 that share the RGB branch; the depth-augmentation variant is left out.
We report Kendall’s τ \tau between these validation errors and the real parameter distances of the same predictors. Synthetic validation is the z E z_{E} error on the 14,588 held-out synthetic videos.
For Real scenes, E E swept , we re-simulate each real drop in its reconstructed scene once for each stiffness value log 10 ⁡ E ∈ { 4 , 4.5 , … , 9 } \log_{10}E\in\{4,4.5,\dots,9\} (App. M.1 ).
The validation error is the log- E E error of a predictor on these re-simulated drops, measured against the stiffness used in the simulation.
This protocol needs scanned objects and scenes and fitted initial states, but no material labels. Replays of real drops is the z E z_{E} error on the same drops re-simulated with the reference materials (Table 4 ). k k real objects uses k k of the 16 real objects as validation data.
The validation error of a predictor is its mean parameter distance on these k k objects, and the protocol selects the predictor with the lowest one.
We compute τ \tau between these validation errors and the parameter distances on the other 16 − k 16-k objects.
We average over all subsets of k k objects.
Intervals for τ \tau resample real objects as in App. R.1 . Real scenes, E E swept and Replays of real drops use renders of the same objects and scenes as the real test videos.
We therefore add a held-out variant of each (rows “held-out objects” in Table S20 ).
It computes the validation error on the renders of half of the objects and compares it with the real error on the other half.
We average over 1,000 random splits.

blocks.en: R.3 Rendered versus Estimated Depth on Replays
blocks.zh: R.3 重播的渲染与估计深度

blocks.en:
The replays are the real drops re-simulated with the reference materials and rendered.
On the replays, a lifted model can fail for two reasons: the errors of depth estimation, or the change from the training scenes to the scenes of the real drops.
To separate the two, we evaluate the lifted models on the replays twice (Table 4 ).
The column “Re-sim.” gives each model depth estimated on the rendered replay, in the same way as on its real videos.
The column “Re-sim., rendered” gives the renderer’s metric depth.
Both columns use WAFT tracks.
The model trained on exact geometry (condition A of Table S7 ) scores 0.820 dex with estimated depth and 1.310 dex with the renderer’s depth.
We also evaluate it with the simulator’s depth and correspondences, so that its replay input contains no estimation error at all.
With exact depth and tracks, its z E z_{E} error on the replays is 1.118 dex, against 0.414 dex on synthetic validation.
The replays therefore differ from the training scenes in their 3D geometry, and not only in the errors of depth estimation.
blocks.zh:
重播是用参考材料重新模拟并渲染出来的真实投放.
在重播时,一个被解除的模型可能因为两个原因失败:深度估计错误,或者从训练场景变为真实滴滴的场景.
为了将两者分开,我们在重播中两次评价被解除的模型(表4).
栏目“Re-sim”以真实视频的同样方式给出了每个模型在制成的重播中估计的深度。
" Re-sim., 渲染器 " 一栏给出了制造器的度量深度。
两列都使用WAFT音轨.
该模型经过精确几何学(表S7A的条件)培训,得分为0.820分,估计深度为1.310分,渲染深度为1.310分。
我们也用模拟器的深度和对应性来评价它,这样它的回放输入就没有任何估计错误.
在精确的深度和轨迹下,其z E z_{E}在重播上的误差为1.118 dex,而在合成验证上的误差为0.414 dex.
因此,重播与其3D几何的训练场景不同,而不只是深度估计的错误.

blocks.en: R.4 Depth Augmentation and Geometry-Only Models
blocks.zh: R.4 深度增强和仅几何模型

blocks.en:
The depth-augmented model is the row “+ depth augmentation” of Table 1 .
It is trained like RGB + 3D tracklets (est. depth), the row above it, except that we perturb the 4RC depth of the training videos before lifting.
The perturbations are:
one scale per clip drawn log-uniformly from [ 0.8 , 1.25 ] [0.8,1.25] , a per-frame multiplicative drift following a random walk with 1% steps, Gaussian noise with a standard deviation of 0.5% of the depth, and depth removed within 3 pixels of the mask boundary with probability 0.3.
The geometry-only model is the row “3D tracklets only (est. depth)” of Table 1 .
It uses the tracklet encoder and the context branch of the “2D tracklets only” model, and it takes lifted tracklets as input.
Both are trained for five epochs with the schedule of App. G.3 ; their results are in Table 1 .
blocks.zh:
深度增强模型是表1中的“+深度增强”一行。
它像 RGB + 3D 轨迹( 最高. 深度) , 它上方的一行, 只不过我们在升起前触动训练视频的 4RC 深度 。
扰动是:
每个片段一个比例尺从 [0.8, 1.25] [0.8, 1.25] 中划出, 随机行走后每帧多变漂移, 步骤为1%, 高斯噪声, 标准偏差为深度的0.5%, 深度在面具边界的 3 像素以 概率 0.3.
只有几何模型是表1中的“只3D轨道(最深)”一行。
它使用轨迹编码器和“只使用2D轨迹”模型的上下文分支,它以升起的轨迹作为输入.
两者都按照App.G.3的时间表接受了培训;结果见表1。

blocks.en: R.5 Training Epochs
blocks.zh: R.5 培训

blocks.en:
The main paper reports a reversal: tracklets lifted to 3D have a lower error than 2D tracklets in simulation and a higher error on real drops.
The models of the main paper are trained with one seed (App. X adds two more).
As a further check, we test here that the reversal does not depend on the epoch at which the models are evaluated.
Table S21 lists the z E z_{E} error after every epoch, on synthetic validation and on the 80 real drops.
At every epoch, lifting lowers the synthetic error and raises the real error.
This holds for the direct predictors (RGB + 2D tracklets against RGB + 3D tracklets) and for the students (PhysReader against the student on 3D tracklets).
blocks.zh:
主论文报告出现逆转:在模拟中,被提升到3D的轨迹存在比2D轨迹更低的误差,在真实投放时出现更高的误差.
主纸的模型用一个种子来训练(App. X增加了两个).
作为进一步检查,我们在这里测试,扭转并不取决于评估模型的时间。
表S21列出了每个纪元之后z E z_{E}的错误,关于合成验证和80个真滴.
在每一个时代,举起都会降低合成错误,提高真正的错误.
这为直接预测器(RGB + 2D 轨道对RGB + 3D 轨道)和学生(PhysReader对3D 轨道对学生)持有.

blocks.en:
PhysFlow and MonoPhysics are each run from two initializations on all 80 drops (Table 5 ).
Started from PhysReader’s predictions, which have a parameter distance of 0.677, PhysFlow ends at 0.668 and MonoPhysics at 0.698.
Started from the predictions of the image-input VLM (1.267), PhysFlow ends at 1.266.
Started from the constants of its original implementation (parameter distance 1.972; “Original init” in Table 5 ), MonoPhysics ends at 1.933.
PhysDreamer in Table 5 starts from PhysReader’s predictions and runs 25 velocity and 25 material updates on all 80 drops.
The mean parameter distance rises from 0.677 to 1.203.
PhysDreamer clips the predictions to its parameter bounds before it starts; after this clipping, the starting distance is 0.673.
Of the 80 drops, 58 end farther from their plausible region, 17 end closer, and 5 stay inside it.
We then replay the drops with the optimized materials.
Relative to the reference material, the total replay loss increases by 21.0% and the deformation replay loss by 40.2%.
For PhysReader’s predictions, from which the optimization started, the increases are 10.1% and 12.3%. Err ref \mathrm{Err}_{\mathrm{ref}} rises from 0.107 for the predictions to 0.147 for the optimized materials.
We also started PhysDreamer from the predictions of our RGB + 2D tracklets + cues predictor (0.739; Table 1 ), with the same 25 velocity and 25 material updates.
That run ends at a parameter distance of 1.164, with increases of 22.9% in the total and 43.3% in the deformation replay loss and an Err ref \mathrm{Err}_{\mathrm{ref}} of 0.143, close to the values of the run from PhysReader’s predictions.
PhysDreamer’s result therefore does not come from its initialization.
For every optimizer and every initialization above, the optimized material either stays close to its initialization or moves away from the reference.

然后我们用最优化的材料来重放投注。

blocks.en:
Fig. S12 looks inside the PhysDreamer runs that start from PhysReader’s predictions.
Over the 25 material updates, the volume mean of the stiffness field moves by 0.73 dex on average, and the mean parameter distance grows from 0.67 to 1.20.
The optimizer’s own image loss does not show this.
In the example of the figure, the loss falls while the stiffness moves away from the plausible region.
Over all drops, the change of the loss and the change of the distance are not correlated.
A lower loss therefore does not mean a better material: the optimizer drifts along directions of the material parameters that its loss does not see.
The parameter distance is computed from the volume means of PhysDreamer’s material field, and the loss shown is the optimizer’s training loss, on the frames that supervise it.

blocks.en: Appendix S Pixie: A Baseline on the Static Asset

blocks.en:
Pixie [ 42 ] predicts a material field from the appearance of a static 3D asset.
It does not see the drop and predicts no yield stress; of its predictions we use Young’s modulus E E only, so we report it here and not in Table 5 .

blocks.en:
We use the released Pixie implementation and pretrained material
networks, without training them on our synthetic dataset.
The input is each object’s reconstructed textured mesh.
Material prediction uses no real drop video, reference material
parameters, plausible regions, tensile measurements, or
PhysReader predictions.
Each of the 16 reconstructed objects produces one material field,
which is subsequently evaluated on its five real drops.

16个重建的物体每个都产生一个物质场,

blocks.en:
For each asset, we render 200 calibrated RGB views at 512 × 512 512\times 512 resolution.
On these views, we fit the feature field of the released pipeline (F3RM) for 5,000 steps.
This field reconstructs CLIP features in 3D.
From it we extract a 64 3 64^{3} grid of 768-dimensional CLIP features,
together with its occupancy mask.
These steps fit the visual feature field; they do not optimize
material parameters against the observed drop.
The released pretrained 3D material network then
predicts spatial fields of Young’s modulus, density, and Poisson’s
ratio.
We keep Pixie’s output normalization and decoding, including the
clipping that its decoder applies.
We do not clip its predictions further to the parameter ranges of
our benchmark.
Pixie has no yield-stress prediction head.

比率。

blocks.en:
We map the predicted Young’s modulus field onto the benchmark’s
MPM particles. To do so, we apply the coordinate transformations between the
reconstructed mesh, the rendered asset, the feature grid, and the simulation.
We use the rule that the released code applies to continuous properties: each particle receives the unweighted average of the predicted modulus over its ten nearest support points. The support points are the occupied cells of the feature grid.
The released code uses a distance threshold of 0.1 in normalized asset
coordinates.
A particle that is farther than this threshold from the support
points receives the global mean of the predicted modulus.
The release requires that such particles are no more than 10% of
all particles, and we keep this requirement.
We preserve the resulting per-particle moduli during simulation.

For the relative replay losses, we refine the initial state of

blocks.en:
The pretrained material network performs feed-forward prediction,
but the complete pipeline also includes per-asset rendering and
5,000 steps of F3RM reconstruction.
These preprocessing costs must be included in an end-to-end
runtime comparison.
They are incurred once per object and shared across its five
drops.
Rendering and reconstruction take 13.5 minutes per object on
average (from 10.5 to 25.9 minutes, depending on the object),
including the failed attempts.
The five drops of an object share one Pixie prediction.
Evaluating this prediction on five drops is therefore not an
independent test of how stable a prediction from video is across
drops.

blocks.en:
The real-video numbers of the main paper are measured against reference materials that we fit in our own simulator.
This section states what that implies.
All numbers are computed from the predictions behind Tables 1 and 5 ; no model is retrained.
blocks.zh:
主论文的真视频数字是用我们自己模拟器所适应的参考材料来衡量的。
本节说明了这意味着什么。
所有数字都从表1和表5后面的预测中计算出来;没有重新调整模型。

blocks.en:
A reference is one homogeneous elastoplastic material that, in our simulator, reproduces the five drops of an object best (App. L.2 ).
It is an effective parameter of the whole object under this simulator, not an intrinsic constant.
The parameter distance, the z E z_{E} and z Y z_{Y} errors, and Err ref \mathrm{Err}_{\mathrm{ref}} therefore measure agreement with these fitted references.
The replay losses compare a simulation with the observed video and do not use the reference material, but their search for the initial state starts from the reference initial state, and they use the same simulator and the same observation terms as the fit.
This is what a predictor is asked for: the material that reproduces the drop under our physical model, which is Neo-Hookean elasticity with von Mises plasticity in an MPM simulator.
We therefore evaluate every prediction against the references, and not against the tensile tests.
The tensile tests are used only to check the references themselves. They cover stiffness for eight of the 16 objects (Fig. 3 ). A tensile test destroys the object, because the specimens are cut from it, and it is expensive and takes much time and labor, so we tested half of the objects. The eight tested objects cover very different materials: their specimen moduli range from 0.05 MPa (the diaper) to 963 MPa (the hanger), more than four orders of magnitude (Table S18 ).
blocks.zh:
一种参考物是同质的弹性材料,在我们模拟器中,它复制了最佳对象的五滴(App. L.2 ).
它是这个模拟器下整个物体的有效参数,而不是内在常数.
参数距离, z E z_{E} 和 z Y z_{Y} 错误, 以及 Err ref\ mathrm{ Err}_{\ mathrm{ ref} 因此, 测量与这些匹配的引用的协议 。

这就是一个预测器需要的: 在我们的物理模型下复制下降量的材料, 也就是在MPM模拟器中与冯·米塞斯的弹性。
因此,我们对照参考文献而不是抗拉强度测试来评估每一项预测。
抗拉强度测试仅用于检查参考文献本身. 它们覆盖了16个物体中的8个物体的僵硬度(图3). 抗拉强度测试会破坏物体,因为标本是从它中切出来的,它很昂贵,需要很多时间和精力,所以我们测试了一半的物体. 八个被测试的物体涵盖了非常不同的材料:它们的标本moduli从0.05兆帕(尿布)到963兆帕(吊架),超过四个数量级(表S18.

blocks.en:
The two lifted models, RGB + 3D tracklets and the student on 3D tracklets, do not fail by random scatter.
They fail by a shift in one direction: their predictions are too soft.
On real videos, their predicted stiffness is lower than the reference on 67 and 66 of the 80 drops, respectively.
On average over the 80 drops, their predictions are 1.1 dex below the reference (columns “Softer” and “Signed” of Table S23 ).
The predictors on 2D tracklets have almost no mean shift.
This shift toward soft materials is also why the lifted models are closer to the references than the 2D models on a few soft objects (App. N ).
All predictors compress the range of stiffness: they predict soft objects too stiff and stiff objects too soft.
The same happens in the simulated sweep in which only E E changes (Fig. S2 ).
blocks.zh:
两个升起的模型,RGB + 3D 轨道和3D 轨道上的学生,不会通过随机散射而失败.
它们因一个方向的转变而失败:它们的预测过于柔软.
在真实的视频中,他们的预测僵硬度分别低于80个跌幅中的67和66的参考.
平均在80个降幅中,它们的预测值低于参考值1.1分(表S23“Softer”和“签署”栏)。
2D轨道上的预测器几乎没有平移.
这种向软材料的转变也是为什么升空模型比几个软物体上的2D模型更接近参考(App. N.
所有预测器都会压缩僵硬度的范围:它们预测软物体太僵硬,硬物体太软.
在模拟扫荡中同样发生,其中只有E E改变(图S2).

blocks.en:
Table S18 gives the numbers behind Fig. 3 .
Five references are within 0.41 dex of the specimen means: hanger ( − 0.07 -0.07 ), crocs ( − 0.13 -0.13 ), box ( + 0.16 +0.16 ), diaper ( + 0.37 +0.37 ), and napkin ( − 0.41 -0.41 ).
Each number is log 10 ⁡ E \log_{10}E of the reference minus that of the nearest specimen mean, so a negative value means that the reference is softer than the specimens.
The other three references are farther from their specimens, and softer: the trash bin by 0.85 dex, Kitty by 0.94 dex, and the silicone pad by 1.24 dex.
Five references lie at or just above the lower bound of our search range, 10 4 10^{4} Pa: the glove, Kitty, the neck pillow, the pad, and the pillow (Table S3 ).
Their true stiffness may be lower, and their plausible regions end at the bound.
Four yield-stress references lie at the lower bound of 10 5 10^{5} Pa: those of the crocs, the diaper, the hanger, and the sneaker.
The bound does not create the gap between 2D and 3D tracklets.
Without the five objects at the stiffness bound, the parameter distance is 0.769 dex for PhysReader and 1.535 dex for the student on 3D tracklets, against 0.677 and 1.164 on all 80 drops.
The gray band of Fig. 3 is the mean ± \pm 3 standard deviations of the specimens.
For Kitty, the pad, and the diaper, the mean minus 3 standard deviations is negative.
On the logarithmic axis of the figure, the band of these three objects therefore has no lower end.
The agreement of these three objects in the figure is thus weak evidence.
The plausible region overlaps the band for seven of the eight objects; the region of the trash bin lies 0.42 dex below its band (last column of Table S18 ).
The reference itself lies inside the band for five objects.
The trash bin, Kitty, and the pad, whose references are softer than their specimens by 0.85 dex or more, are structured objects: a hollow bin, a stuffed plush toy, and a honeycomb pad.
A whole structured object can respond more softly than a specimen cut from its material.
Fig. S10 shows this for the silicone pad: replayed with the stiffness of its specimens, the simulated pad is a nearly rigid plate one frame after the collision, when the real pad lies folded on the floor.

blocks.en:
The tensile tests cannot replace the fitted references as labels, for three reasons.
First, they exist for eight of the 16 objects, and they give no yield stress.
Second, they do not give one stiffness per object.
The mean Young’s moduli of the two loading directions differ by up to 0.93 dex (for the diaper).
The local slope of the stress–strain curves varies within an object by 0.5 to 2.5 dex, depending on the object (App. P ).
Third, a specimen measures the material that it is cut from, not the response of the whole object.
Figs. S10 and S11 replay the drops with tensile-measured stiffness.
In these replays, some objects move visibly differently from the real video.
The silicone pad stays a rigid plate where the real pad folds.
The trash bin, the crocs, and the diaper rebound higher than in the reference replay when they are replayed with their lowest tensile stiffness.
Table S25 repeats this comparison with numbers.
We replay all drops of the eight objects with three tensile values, the lowest and the highest local slope and the mean Young’s modulus, with the same initial-state search as for predicted materials.
Depending on which of the three tensile values is used, the total replay loss is 13.1–24.4% higher than with the reference material, and the deformation replay loss is 36.0–59.4% higher.
For PhysReader’s predictions on the same drops, the increases are 5.5% and 11.4%.
By this measure the tensile values describe the drops less well than the predictions do.
blocks.zh:
抗拉强度测试不能取代贴有标签的参考文献,原因有三。
首先,它们为16个物体中的8个存在,它们不会产生屈服压力。
第二,它们不给每个物体一个硬度。
平均Young的两种装载方向的模组不同,最多为0.93 dex(尿布)。
压力-斜线曲线的局部坡度在一个物体内因物体的不同而变化0.5至2.5 dex(App. P.).
第三,一个标本测量其被切割的材料,而不是整个物体的反应.
数数. S10和S11用拉伸测量的僵硬度重放滴滴.
在这些重播中,一些物体的移动与真实的视频明显不同.
硅酮垫保留着一个硬板,真正的垫片会折叠.
垃圾桶、鳄鱼和尿布的反弹比参考重播时的反弹要高,
表S25与数字重复了这一比较。
我们重新播放八个物体的所有投影, 有三个抗拉强度值, 最小的和最高的局部坡度和平均的Young的模度, 初始状态搜索与预测的材料相同。
根据使用三种抗拉强度值中的哪一种,总回放损失比参考材料高13.1-24.4%,变形回放损失为36.0-59.4%.
对于同样下降的物理学研究者预测,增长率分别为5.5%和11.4%。
通过这个测量,抗拉强度值描述的下降比预测的下降要少.

blocks.en: Table S25: Replays at tensile stiffness. We replay the 40 drops of the eight tensile-tested objects with three stiffness values from the tensile tests: the lowest and the highest local slope of the loading curves before the peak, and the geometric mean of the specimens’ Young’s moduli (App. O ). The yield stress is that of the reference, and the initial state is searched as for a predicted material (Sec. 4 , App. J ). All numbers are relative to the reference material; the replay measures are those of Table 5 . For the trash bin and the hanger, the highest local slope lies above 1 GPa, the largest stiffness our simulator accepts, and is replayed at 1 GPa. The last two rows are predictions on the same 40 drops.

blocks.en: We therefore use the tensile tests to check the references, and not as labels.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们使用抗拉强度测试来检查参考文献,而不是作为标签。

blocks.en:
The deformation terms of the reference fit and of the replay losses compare image-plane cues, the kind of signal that the 2D predictors read. Their trajectory term and the rotation part of their pose term compare 3D motion (App. I ).
Three results do not rely on these image-plane deformation terms.
First, the fit uses SEA-RAFT flow [ 78 ] , not the WAFT flow of the predictors (App. I ).
Second, Err ref \mathrm{Err}_{\mathrm{ref}} compares trajectory, pose, and 3D strain between two simulations and uses no optical flow.
Third, on the rendered replays of the real drops (Table 4 ), the label is the material that the video was simulated with, so the label is exact.
Lifted tracklets lose there as well: their z E z_{E} error is 0.808 dex, against 0.453 dex for 2D tracklets.
blocks.zh:
参考值的变形条款和重播损失条款比较了图像-平面提示,即2D预测器读取的信号类型. 他们的轨迹术语和姿势术语的旋转部分比较了3D运动(pp.
三种结果并不依赖于这些图像-平面变形术语.
首先,适应性使用SEA-RAFT流量[78],而不是预测器的WAFT流量(App.I).
第二,Err ref\mathrm{Err\ mathrm{ref}比较两个模拟之间的轨迹,姿势,和3D压力,不使用光学流.
第三,在真实滴滴的渲染回放(表4)上,标签是视频被模拟的材料,所以标签准确.
升起的音轨也在那里丢失:他们的z E z_{E}误差为 0.808 dex,对2D音轨的0.453 dex.

blocks.en:
In Table 2 , the two sides of each correlation use different metrics: the validation error is a z E z_{E} error, and the real error is the parameter distance.
Here we use the z E z_{E} error on both sides.
Kendall’s τ \tau over the same eight predictors is then − 0.64 -0.64 for synthetic validation, + 0.57 +0.57 for the real scenes with E E swept, and + 0.86 +0.86 for replays of the real drops.
With the real parameter distance, as in Table 2 , the three values are − 0.71 -0.71 , + 0.50 +0.50 , and + 0.93 +0.93 .
We also replace the real error by the distance in stiffness only, from the predicted stiffness to the range of stiffness that the plausible region covers.
It gives the same three values as the real z E z_{E} error.
Each validation set selects the same predictor as in Table 2 .
blocks.zh:
在表2中,每个关联的两侧使用不同的度量衡:验证错误是z E z_{E}错误,而真实错误是参数距离.
在这里,我们使用z E z_{E]两侧的错误.
Kendall的\tau在同一个8个预测器上是−0.64-0.64用于合成验证,+0.57+0.57用于E扫荡的真实场景,+0.86+0.86用于真实下降的重播.
如表2所示,以实际参数距离计算,三个数值分别为− 0.71-0.71、+ 0.50+0.50和+ 0.93。
我们还将真正的错误取而代之的只是僵硬的距离,从预测的僵硬到令人信服的区域所覆盖的僵硬范围。
它给出了与真实的z E z_{E} 错误相同的三个值.
每个验证集选择与表2相同的预测器。

blocks.en: Appendix U Reading the Numbers Across Tables
blocks.zh: 附录 U 读取表格中的数字

blocks.en:
Some models appear with two different numbers in the paper.
Each case has one of four causes: a different metric, a different set of validation videos, a different set of labels, or a separately trained run.
Table S24 lists them.
blocks.zh:
一些模型在论文中出现了两个不同的数字.
每个案例都有四个原因之一:一个不同的度量衡,一个不同的验证视频集,一个不同的标签集,或者一个经过单独训练的运行.
表格S24列出了它们。

blocks.en:
The RGB + 3D tracklets model was trained twice with the same inputs.
The main run is the one reported in Table 1 .
Run D is the model trained under condition D (4RC depth and WAFT tracks) in the study of Table S7 .
The last two rows of Table 3 , for flow tracks lifted with estimated depth, take both numbers from run D: a synthetic z E z_{E} error of 0.444 dex and a real z E z_{E} error of 1.188 dex.
With the main run, these two rows would read 0.441 and 1.249 dex.
The third row of Table 3 , RGB with exact 3D tracks of the visible surface, differs from the teacher above it in more than one way: it has a different network and it adds RGB.
The + 0.189 +0.189 dex of that row is therefore the cost of replacing the teacher and its exact deformation features by a video predictor on exact tracks, not the cost of a single factor.
blocks.zh:
RGB + 3D 轨迹模型曾两次以相同的输入进行训练.
主要运行情况见表1。
运行 D是研究表S7时在条件D(4RC深度和WAFT轨迹)下训练的模型.
表3的最后两行,对于以估计深度升起的流轨,从运行的D取两个数字:一个合成的z E z_{E}错误为0.444 dex,一个真实的z E z_{E}错误为1.188 dex.
随着主跑,这两列将改为0.441和1.249 dex.
Table 3的第三行,RGB带有可见表面的精确的3D音轨,与上面的老师有不止一种不同:它有一个不同的网络,并且增加了RGB.
因此,该行的+0.189+0.189 dex是用准确轨道上的视频预测器替换教师及其确切变形特征的成本,而不是单个因子的成本.

blocks.en:
Every model of the main paper is trained once, with one seed; App. X adds two more seeds.
All direct predictors and students are reported after the fifth epoch, the teacher is selected on synthetic validation, and no checkpoint or hyperparameter is selected on real videos.
We chose the input of PhysReader, 2D tracklets, after comparing the inputs on PhysReader-Real.
Renders of the real scenes, which need no material labels, also rank lifted tracklets far behind 2D tracklets and select PhysReader (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh:
主纸的每个模型都经过一次训练,有一个种子; App. X又增加了两个种子.
所有直接预测器和学生在第五纪元后都会被报道,老师在合成验证时被选中,在真实视频上没有选择检查点或超参数.
在比较了PhysReader-Real上的输入后,我们选择了PhysReader,2D轨道的输入.
真实场景的渲染器,不需要材料标签,也会将升起的轨迹排在远远落后于2D轨迹,并选择PhysReader(表2 ).

blocks.en:
The real data are 16 objects and 80 drops in one capture setup, with one camera and a gripper release, plus 40 recordings of one object under changed conditions.
The result that we consider established within this setup is the reversal between 2D and lifted tracklets: lifted tracklets are more accurate than 2D tracklets in simulation and less accurate on real drops. For stiffness, the reversal holds under every metric, depth source, and training condition, and at every epoch. Lifted tracklets also lose on the rendered replays with exact labels. For yield stress, the reversal holds for RGB + 2D tracklets against RGB + 3D tracklets and for the two students (App. T ), with the exceptions listed in App. N .
The advantage of the teacher–student training over the direct predictor on 2D tracklets is smaller than this reversal.
It is not significant over objects: its object-level interval includes zero.
PhysReader does not have the lowest total replay loss (Table 1 ). PhysFlow started from its predictions ends slightly closer to the references, 0.668 against 0.677 dex, but it takes about 250 times longer per video (49 min against 12 s), and its deformation replay loss and Err ref \mathrm{Err}_{\mathrm{ref}} are higher (17.2% against 12.3%, and 0.115 against 0.107; Table 5 ).
blocks.zh:
真实数据为16个对象和一个捕获设置中的80个滴,其中一台相机和抓取器发布,加上一个对象在改变的条件下的40个录音.
我们认为在这个设置中建立的结果是2D和升空轨迹之间的逆转:升空轨迹在模拟中比2D轨迹更准确,在真实投放时更不准确. 对于僵硬性来说,颠倒现象在每一个尺度、深度、训练条件以及每个时代都存在。 升起的音轨也输在了 精确的标签的重播上。 对于产量应力,反转为RGB+2D音轨对RGB+3D音轨和两个学生(App. T),但App列出的除外. 不详。
师生培训比2D轨道上的直接预测器的优势小于这一逆转.
它对于对象不重要:其对象级间隔包括0.
PhysReader没有最低的总重播损失(表1). PhysFlow从预测开始,结尾略接近参考,0.668对0.677 dex,但每段视频需要约250倍长(49分钟对12秒),其变形重播损失和Err ref\mathrm{Err}_{\ mathrm{ref}}>较高(17.2%对12.3%,0.115对0.107;表5).

blocks.en: Appendix V More Long-Range Trackers
blocks.zh: 附录五 远程跟踪器

blocks.en:
Fig. S3 uses one long-range tracker, CoTracker3 in its online mode.
Here we run ten more trackers and tracker modes on the same 16 frames, C − 3 C-3 to C + 12 C+12 , with the same query points at C − 3 C-3 as in that figure. We compare them with our short tracklets.
Each tracker is called through its released code and weights with its default settings.
A track is valid in a frame when two conditions hold. First, the tracker’s own visibility output marks the point as visible; we use the visibility threshold of the tracker’s released code. Second, the point lies inside the object mask.
blocks.zh:
Fig. S3在其在线模式下使用一个远程跟踪器CoTracker3.
在这里,我们在同一16帧C−3 C-3至C+12 C+12上运行了另外10个跟踪器和跟踪器模式,C−3 C-3的查询点与该图相同. 我们把它们和短小的轨道相比较
每个跟踪器通过它的发布代码和权重及其默认设置来调用.
当两个条件存在时,一个音轨在一个框架内有效. 首先,追踪器自身的可见度输出标志着这一点是可见的;我们使用追踪器释放代码的可见阈值. 第二,点位于物体面具内.

blocks.en:
A material predictor needs tracks on the object in every drop.
We therefore measure coverage: the share of the object mask that lies within 8 pixels of a valid track, on the 224 × 224 224\times 224 crop.
Table S26 reports coverage at the last frame of the window, C + 12 C+12 , for all 80 drops. If a tracker returns fewer than three valid queries for a drop, the drop has no usable tracks and counts as a coverage of zero.
Several recent trackers cover more than half of the object in most drops but fail on a subset of drops.
The best of them, CoWTracker, covers less than half of the object mask at C + 12 C+12 in 10 of the 80 drops. Each of the other long-range trackers does so in 16 to 67 of the 80 drops.
Our tracklets restart on the visible surface at C − 3 C-3 , C + 1 C+1 , C + 5 C+5 , and C + 8 C+8 (window frames 0, 4, 8, and 11). At C + 12 C+12 they cover at least 66% of the object mask in every drop.
Fig. S13 shows one of the failures.
When the napkin pack rotates, the face that was visible at C − 3 C-3 turns away: the trackers lose their points or collapse them onto an edge.
Our tracklets carry no visibility estimate, so we count a tracklet point as valid when it lies inside the object mask. For the long-range trackers we also require that the tracker marks the point as visible. If we count the long-range tracks by position alone, as we count our tracklets, CoWTracker and TAPNext++ each cover less than half of the object at C + 12 C+12 in 2 drops.
blocks.zh:
物质预测器在每次投放时都需要对对象进行跟踪.
因此,我们测量覆盖范围:位于有效轨迹8像素范围内的物体遮罩在224x224/224\times 224作物上的份额。
表S26报告窗口最后一帧(C+12 C+12)所有80个跌幅的覆盖率。 如果一个跟踪器返回少于3个有效查询来进行掉落,则掉落没有可用的音轨,算作0覆盖.
最近几个追踪器在大多数滴滴中覆盖了超过一半的对象,但在一个滴滴子上失败.
其中最好的CoWTracker在80个落点中的10个中C+12 C+12上覆盖了不到一半的物体面具. 在80个滴滴中,16至67个滴滴中,其他远程跟踪者都这样做。
我们的轨道在可见的表面重新开始,C−3 C-3、C+1 C+1、C+5 C+5和C+8 C+8(窗口框架0、4、8和11)。 在C + 12 C + 12时,它们至少覆盖每滴物体罩的66%.
Fig. S13显示失败之一.
当餐巾包旋转时,C−3 C-3上可见的面孔转过身来:跟踪者失去点数或将其倒向边缘.
我们的赛道没有可见度估计,所以当一个赛道点位于物体遮罩内时,我们算它有效. 对于远程跟踪器,我们也要求跟踪器标记点为可见. 如果仅按位置计算远程轨道, 因为我们的轨道, CoWTracker 和 TAPNext++ 在C+12 C+12中,每个小于半数的物体覆盖2滴。

blocks.en:
Sec. 3.3 states that the long-range trackers we tested lose most tracks during impact (Fig. S3 ).
Table S26 gives the full picture for eleven long-range trackers and tracker modes.
Each of them covers less than half of the object at C + 12 C+12 in some of the 80 drops: in 10 drops for CoWTracker, and in 16 to 67 drops for the others.
Our short tracklets do so in none of the 80 drops.
A material predictor needs tracks on the object in every drop, so we use the short tracklets.
blocks.zh:
第3.3条指出,我们测试的远程跟踪仪在撞击期间丢失了大部分轨道(图S3)。
表S26给出了11个远程跟踪器和跟踪器模式的全景.
其中C+12 C+12在部分80个滴滴中分别覆盖不到半个天体:CoWTracker为10个滴滴,其他为16至67个滴滴.
我们的短道速滑 没有在80滴。
物质预测器在每滴的物体上都需要轨道,所以我们使用短轨.

blocks.en: Table S26: Long-range trackers and short tracklets on the 80 real drops. Tracks: number of the 80 drops with usable tracks (at least three valid queries). Coverage: share of the object mask within 8 pixels of a valid track. Last two columns: number of the 80 drops with coverage below 0.5 at C + 12 C+12 , and number with coverage below 0.5 in the worst frame, the frame between C + 1 C+1 and C + 12 C+12 with the lowest coverage.
blocks.zh: 表S26:80个真投篮上的长距离履带和短轨. 音轨:带可用音轨的80个滴数(至少3个有效查询). 覆盖:在有效音轨的8像素内分享对象遮罩. 最后两栏:C+12 C+12的覆盖率低于0.5的80个跌幅数,最差的帧为0.5以下的跌幅数,为C+1 C+1和C+12的跌幅数,覆盖率最低.

blocks.en: Figure S13 : A failure case of long-range trackers. Napkin pack, drop 1, at C − 3 C-3 (queries), C C , C + 4 C+4 , and C + 12 C+12 (rows); one column per tracker. Each dot is a tracked query point that the tracker itself marks visible. Each query keeps one color in all frames; the color is given by the position of the query on the object at C − 3 C-3 . The line is the object mask. The numbers give visible points / queries; unlike Table S26 , they also count visible points outside the object mask. Last column: our short tracklets, drawn as line segments; each frame shows the tracklets of the five-frame window that contains it. Table S26 gives the counts over all 80 drops.
blocks.zh: 图S13:远程跟踪器故障病例. 纳普金包,在C−3 C-3(树脂),C C+4 C+4,以及C+12 C+12(树脂)处投放1,每轨距1列. 每个点是一个跟踪查询点,跟踪器本身标记可见. 每个查询在所有框架中都保留一个颜色;颜色由C−3 C-3上对象的查询位置给出. 线条是对象面具. 数字给出可见点/查询;与表S26不同的是,它们也计算对象罩外的可见点. 最后一列: 我们的短轨, 作为线段绘制; 每个框架显示包含它的五帧窗口的轨迹 。 表S26列出了所有80滴的计数。

blocks.en: Appendix W Poisson’s Ratio in the Reference Fit
blocks.zh: 附录 W Poisson 的参考比率

blocks.en:
Table S2 lists the Poisson’s ratios that are fixed in the reference fit.
They were fixed before the tensile data were processed.
For some objects they therefore differ from the apparent values of App. O .
We keep the values of Table S2 , for two reasons.
blocks.zh:
表S2列出了参考文献中确定的Poisson比率。
它们在抗拉强度数据处理之前就已经固定了。
因此,对于某些物体,它们与App.O的表面值不同。
我们保留表S2的数值有两个原因。

blocks.en:
First, the apparent values are not reliable.
App. O reads them from the change of one specimen width between two photographs, at 0% and at about 5% strain.
The width changes by only a few pixels: for the first box specimen, by 4.3 pixels of a width of 679 pixels.
One pixel of annotation error therefore changes the apparent Poisson’s ratio by a quarter of its value.
For the silicone pad the apparent value is 0.58, above the limit of 0.5 for an isotropic solid.
blocks.zh:
第一,表面价值不可靠。
App. O从两张照片之间一个标本宽度的变化中读取,比例为0%和5%左右。
宽度仅变化了几像素:第一盒标本的宽度为679像素的4.3像素.
因此,一个像素的注解错误将明显的波森比值改变四分之一。
对于硅酮垫,其表面值为0.58,高于异性固体0.5的限度。

blocks.en:
Second, Poisson’s ratio has little effect on the simulated drop.
Fig. S14 shows this for the crocs.
We simulate its five drops again with the reference material and the reference initial state, and change only ν \nu , from the value used in the fit (0.271) to the apparent value (0.392).
After the rigid motion between the two simulations is removed, their corresponding particles are 0.62 mm apart on average, and the frames cannot be told apart.
One pixel of the 224 × 224 224\times 224 crop given to the predictors covers about 3 mm on this drop, so the difference is about a fifth of a pixel.
For the box and the hanger, the same test gives 0.03 and 0.20 mm.
This agrees with the four-head models of App. Y (Fig. S15 ): the student, which reads the video, does not learn ν \nu , while the teacher, which reads the exact 3D deformation, learns part of it.
blocks.zh:
其次,普瓦松的比例对模拟下降的影响很小.
图片S14给鳄鱼看
我们再次以参考材料和参考初始状态模拟其5个下降,并且只改变 \ nu ,从 fit(0.271) 中使用的值变为表面值(0.392)。
两次模拟之间的刚性运动被移除后,其对应的粒子平均相差0.62毫米,框架无法分辨.
224×224×224\时给预测器的224种作物有一个像素,在这个滴滴上覆盖了大约3毫米,所以差异大约是像素的五分之一.
对于盒子和吊架,同样的试验给予0.03和0.20毫米.
这与App. Y(Fig. S15)的四头模型一致:读视频的学生不学ν努,而读到准确的3D变形的老师则学习其中的一部分.

blocks.en: Figure S14 : Re-simulation with a different Poisson’s ratio. Drop 3 of the crocs at the collision frame C C and 6 and 12 frames later. Top: the real video. Middle: the reference simulation, with ν \nu as used in the fit. Bottom: the same simulation with the apparent value of ν \nu .
blocks.zh: 图S14:用不同的波森比进行再模拟. 在碰撞框架C C 和 6 和 12 帧之后, 投下3个鳄鱼. 顶部:真实的视频. 中间: 参考模拟, 使用 {{{} 。} 底部: 与显值\ nu 相同的模拟 。

blocks.en: Appendix X Training Seeds
blocks.zh: 附录十 培训种子

blocks.en:
The main paper trains every model once.
Here we train nine of the eleven models of Table 1 two more times, each time with a different random seed. The two models we do not retrain are 3D tracklets only and the variant with depth augmentation.
Only the seed changes. The code, the data, the schedule, and the number of GPUs are those of the original run.
The seed decides the initial weights of the adapter and the heads, and the order of the training samples.
We checked the procedure with the original seed: after the first training step, all weights agree with the original run to within 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} .
Both students are trained again with the same teacher. The teacher itself is not trained again.
blocks.zh:
主纸培训每个模型一次。
在这里,我们训练了表1的11种模型中的9种,再训练两次,每次用不同的随机种子. 我们不重新训练的两种模式只有3D轨迹和具有深度增强的变体.
唯种子变化. 代码,数据,时间表,以及GPU的数量都是原运行的.
种子决定适配器和头的初始重量,以及训练样品的顺序.
我们用原始种子检查了程序:在训练的第一步之后,所有重量都同意在2×10−6 2\times 10×6}之内的原始运行。
两个学生都再次接受同一教师的培训。 师自不复训.

blocks.en:
Table S27 gives two errors for each model and each seed.
The first is the z E z_{E} error on synthetic validation.
The second is the parameter distance on the 80 real drops.
Both are in dex, and lower is better.
“Mean ± \pm std” is the mean and the sample standard deviation over the three seeds.
blocks.zh:
表S27给出了每个模型和每个种子的两个错误.
第一种是合成验证上的z E z_{E}错误.
第二个是80个真滴的参数距离.
两者都处于dex状态,下级更好.
“Mean ±\pm std”是三种种子的平均值和样本标准偏差。

blocks.en:
The synthetic error changes little with the seed. For every model, its three values differ by at most 0.013 dex.
The parameter distance on real drops changes more. Its standard deviation over the three seeds is between 0.01 and 0.06 dex, depending on the model.
blocks.zh:
合成错误随种子变化不大. 对于每个模型,其三个值最多以0.013 dex不同.
真滴上的参数距离变化更多. 它在三种种子上的标准偏差在0.01至0.06 dex之间,取决于型号.

blocks.en:
The main paper finds that tracklets lifted to 3D are the most accurate input in simulation and the least accurate on real drops.
This holds for each of the three seeds.
Take the two students, which differ only in their tracklets.
On synthetic validation, the student with 3D tracklets has the lower error with every seed.
On real drops, its parameter distance is higher than that of PhysReader by 0.487, 0.368, and 0.497 dex with the three seeds.
The smallest of these gaps is six times the largest standard deviation over seeds in Table S27 .
The two direct predictors behave the same way: RGB + 3D tracklets is worse than RGB + 2D tracklets by 0.465, 0.543, and 0.529 dex.
With every seed, the model with 3D tracklets is worse than the same model with 2D tracklets on 12 of the 16 objects, and the object-level 95% interval of the difference (computed as in App. R.1 ) lies above zero.
blocks.zh:
主论文认为,被提升到3D的轨迹是模拟中最准确的输入,也是真实投放时最不准确的.
此为三种子各持.
带两个徒弟,只在他们的赛道上有所不同.
在合成验证时,拥有3D音轨的学生对每个种子都有较低的错误.
在真正的滴滴上,它的参数距离比PhysReader的要高0.487,0.368,与三个种子的0.497 dex.
其中最小的差距是表S27所列种子的最大标准差的六倍。
两种直接预测器的性能相同: RGB + 3D 轨迹比 RGB + 2D 轨迹差0.465,0.543,0.529 dex.
在每一个种子中,带有3D音轨的模型都比16个对象中的12个对象上带有2D音轨的同一模型更差,对象级别95%的差值间隔(计算如App. R.1)位于0以上.

blocks.en:
PhysReader has the lowest parameter distance of these nine models with each of the three seeds.
The second-best model is RGB + 2D tracklets + cues with every seed. It is behind PhysReader by 0.062, 0.015, and 0.032 dex.
These margins are small.
We therefore average the distance of each object over the three seeds and repeat the object-level comparison of App. R.1 .
PhysReader is then closer to the references than RGB + 2D tracklets + cues, RGB + 2D tracklets, and RGB, each on 12 of the 16 objects.
The mean difference in parameter distance, PhysReader minus the other model, is − 0.036 -0.036 dex (95% interval [ − 0.103 , 0.035 ] [-0.103,0.035] ) against RGB + 2D tracklets + cues, − 0.054 -0.054 dex ( [ − 0.112 , 0.010 ] [-0.112,0.010] ) against RGB + 2D tracklets, and − 0.072 -0.072 dex ( [ − 0.150 , 0.007 ] [-0.150,0.007] ) against RGB.
All three intervals include zero.
With the original seed alone, the interval against RGB + 2D tracklets also includes zero, and the interval against RGB, [ − 0.206 , − 0.029 ] [-0.206,-0.029] , does not.
blocks.zh:
PhysReader拥有这9种模型中最小的参数距离,每三种种子都有.
第二好模式是RGB+2D轨迹+每个种子的提示. 它位于PhysReader以0.062,0.015和0.032 dex的后面.
这些边际很小。
因此,我们平均每个物体在三个种子上的距离,并重复App.R.1的天体级比较。
然后PhysReader比RGB+2D音轨+提示,RGB+2D音轨以及RGB更接近引用,在16个对象中的12个对象上各有参考.
参数距离的平均差,PhysReader减去其他型号,为−0.036 - 0.036 dex(95%间隔[−0.103,0.035] [-0.103,0.035]),对RGB+2D轨迹+提示,−0.054 - 0.054 dex([−0.112,0.010]),对RGB+2D轨迹,−0.072 - 0.072 dex([−0.150,0.007] [0.150,0.007]),对RGB.
所有三个间隔都包含0.
单凭原始种子,对RGB+2D轨迹的间隔也包括0,对RGB的间隔[−0.206,−0.029] [0.206,-0.029],则没有.

blocks.en:
Averaged over the three seeds, RGB + 2D tracklets is closer to the references than RGB, 0.764 against 0.783 dex; with the original seed alone, it was 0.745 against 0.797.
The difference over the three seeds, − 0.018 -0.018 dex, is within the variation between seeds: its object-level 95% interval, [ − 0.053 , 0.017 ] [-0.053,0.017] , includes zero.
PhysReader, which also reads 2D tracklets, is the best of the nine models with every seed.
blocks.zh:
平均在三颗种子上,RGB+2D的赛道比RGB更接近参照,0.764对0.783 dex;仅原种子为0.745对0.797.
与三种种子的差别−0.018-0.018 dex在种子的变异内:其物体级95%间隔[−0.053,0.017],[0.053,0.017],包括0.
PhysReader),也读作2D轨迹,是9个型号中拥有每个种子的最好的.

blocks.en:
Table 2 reports Kendall’s τ = − 0.71 \tau=-0.71 between the synthetic error and the real parameter distance of the eight predictors that share the RGB branch.
A negative τ \tau means that synthetic validation orders the predictors the wrong way.
With the two new seeds, τ \tau is − 0.57 -0.57 and − 0.64 -0.64 .
Computed on the three-seed means, it is − 0.71 -0.71 .
blocks.zh:
表2 报告 肯德尔在合成误差和共享RGB分支的8个预测器的实际参数距离之间,表示=– 0.71\tau=-0.71.
负\ tau 表示合成验证对预测器的命令错误 。
随着两个新种子,\tau为−0.57-0.57和−0.64.
根据三种子表示计算,为−0.71-0.71.

blocks.en:
Err ref \mathrm{Err}_{\mathrm{ref}} (App. L.3 ) simulates each drop twice from the same initial state, once with the predicted material and once with the reference material, and compares the two simulations.
The last column of Table S27 gives its mean and standard deviation over the three seeds.
For PhysReader it is 0.109 ± \pm 0.001, and for the student with 3D tracklets it is 0.146 ± \pm 0.007.
For every model in the table, the three values differ by at most 0.013.
blocks.zh:
Err ref\mathrm{Err}_{\ mathrm{ref}}(App.L.3)从相同的初始状态模拟每次下降两次,一次与预测的材料,一次与参考材料,并比较两次模拟.
表S27的最后一栏给出了相对于三个种子的平均值和标准偏差.
PhysReader为0.109±\pm 0.001,拥有3D音轨的学生为0.146±\pm 0.007.
对于表中的每个模型,三个值最多为0.013。

blocks.en: Table S27: Three training seeds. Columns 2–5: z E z_{E} error on synthetic validation (dex). Columns 6–9: parameter distance on the 80 real drops (dex). Both are measured after the fifth epoch, for the original seed (1701) and for the two new seeds. We test how sharply the drops determine the reference stiffness.
We replay each drop with the reference material and change only its stiffness, by a factor of 10 − 1 10^{-1} , 10 − 0.5 10^{-0.5} , 10 + 0.5 10^{+0.5} , or 10 + 1 10^{+1} .
The yield stress, the density, and Poisson’s ratio are those of the reference.
The initial state is searched in the same way as for a predicted material (App. J ).

blocks.en:
The replay losses rise with the size of the change, on both sides of the reference.
A change of 0.5 dex raises the total loss by 8.6–10.6% and the deformation loss by 13.5–31.4%.
A change of 1 dex raises them by 19.3–24.8% and 32.6–53.2%.
For comparison, the materials predicted by PhysReader raise them by 10.1% and 12.3% on all 80 drops (Table 5 ).
On the same drops as each row, they raise them by 12.4% and 9.5% (the 55 drops of the two softer rows), 10.3% and 13.6% (the 65 drops of the row × 10 + 0.5 \times 10^{+0.5} ), and 11.0% and 14.3% (the 60 drops of the row × 10 + 1 \times 10^{+1} ).

This removes five objects from the rows × 10 − 1 \times 10^{-1} and × 10 − 0.5 \times 10^{-0.5} (glove, Kitty, neck pillow, pad, and pillow), three objects from the row × 10 + 0.5 \times 10^{+0.5} (bowl, box, and hanger), and four from the row × 10 + 1 \times 10^{+1} (the same three and the bottle).

Our models predict the two ratios E / ρ E/\rho and σ Y / ρ \sigma_{Y}/\rho , because a drop does not determine density and Poisson’s ratio (App. E ).
We test this in simulation.
We train the teacher and the student again with four heads instead of two.
The two additional heads predict Poisson’s ratio ν \nu and the density ρ \rho (trained on log 10 ⁡ ρ \log_{10}\rho ; we report the error in kg/m 3 , because the density is sampled uniformly in ρ \rho ).
All other settings are those of PhysReader.
Table S30 compares the error on synthetic validation with two baselines.
The first is a constant prediction, the mean of the training set.
The second shows how much the ratios alone reveal about the density.
In PhysReader-Sim, E E ranges from 10 kPa to 1 GPa and ρ \rho from 100 to 2000 kg/m 3 , and the two are sampled independently.
The smallest possible ratio, E / ρ = 10 4 / 2000 = 5 E/\rho=10^{4}/2000=5 m 2 /s 2 , occurs only when E E is at its minimum and ρ \rho at its maximum.
A model that knows only E / ρ E/\rho can therefore guess the density of such a video without sensing it.
Likewise, the largest ratios occur only when ρ \rho is near 100 kg/m 3 , while in the middle of the range any density is possible.
The baseline “From ratios” measures this effect: for each pair of true z E z_{E} and z Y z_{Y} , it predicts the mean density (or Poisson’s ratio) of the training videos with these ratios.
It uses no information about the density itself.
A model that beats the constant prediction but not this baseline shows no sign of sensing the density.
blocks.zh:
我们的模型预测两种比率E / ^ E/\rho和\ Y →\sigma\Y}/\rho,因为下降不能决定密度和Poisson的比例(App. E)。
我们在模拟中测试这个。

所有其他设置都是物理阅读器的设置.
表S30将合成验证的错误与两个基线进行比较。
第一个是不断的预测,训练集的平均值.
第二种情况表明,这些比率本身揭示了密度的多少。
在PhysReader-Sim中,EE介于10 kPa到1 GPa之间, ^\rho介于100到2000 kg/m 3之间,两者独立采样.
最小的可能比率,E = 10 4 / 2000 = 5 E /\rho = 10 /\ 4}/ 2000 = 5 m 2 /s 2 时,只在 E E 处于最低值时出现,而 o =\rho 在最大值时出现。
因此,只有E / ^ E/\rho 才知道这种视频密度的模型可以不感知它。
同样,最大比率只发生在 $\rho 接近 100 kg/m 3 时,而在中间区域,密度是可能的。
基线 " 从比率 " 衡量这种影响:对每对真实的z E z_{E}和z Y z_{Y},它用这些比率预测培训录像的平均密度(或Poisson的比例)。
它没有使用关于密度本身的信息.
一个模型比常数预测要强,但这个基线没有显示能感知密度的迹象.

blocks.en:
The student, which reads the video, learns neither quantity (Fig. S15 , bottom row).
Its error for Poisson’s ratio is 0.083, against 0.088 for the constant prediction.
Its error for the density is 463 kg/m 3 , against 469 kg/m 3 for the constant prediction and 381 kg/m 3 for the true ratios alone.
The teacher, which reads the exact 3D deformation of the whole surface, does not learn the density either (434 kg/m 3 ).
It does read part of Poisson’s ratio from the exact deformation (error 0.048, against 0.088 for both baselines).
Poisson’s ratio shows in how much the object expands sideways when it is compressed at impact.
The teacher sees this lateral and volumetric change in 3D, while in a video it is very small.
App. W gives an example on a real drop: changing ν \nu of the crocs from 0.271 to 0.392 moves the particles by 0.62 mm on average, while one pixel of the 224 × 224 224\times 224 crop given to the predictors covers about 3 mm.
The change is about a fifth of a pixel.
Sec. 3.1 states that a drop does not determine Poisson’s ratio. This holds for what the video shows: exact 3D deformation, which only the teacher sees in simulation, carries some information about it.
The two additional heads do not change the errors of z E z_{E} and z Y z_{Y} : they are 0.164 and 0.196 dex for the teacher, against 0.161 and 0.192 in Table S4 , and 0.482 and 0.357 dex for the student, against 0.481 and 0.356.
blocks.zh:
阅读视频的学生既不学习数量(图S15,下行).
它对波依森比率的误差为0.083,对常数预测为0.088.
其密度误差为463公斤/米3,而恒定预测误差为469公斤/米3,而仅真实比率误差为381公斤/米3。
该教师读取了整个表面的精确的3D变形,也没有学会密度(434公斤/米3 ).
它确实从确切的变形(error 0.048, 而两个基线为0.088)读取了部分的Poisson的比例.
Poisson的比值显示物体在撞击时被压缩时会有多大的侧面膨胀.
老师在3D中看到这种横向和体积变化,而在视频中则非常小.
App. W给出了一个真实下降的例子:将 cro的ν从0.271改变为0.392,使颗粒平均移动0.62毫米,而给预测器的224×224/224\时的224个作物有一个像素覆盖约3毫米.
变化约为像素的五分之一.
第3.1条规定,下降并不决定Poisson的比例。 这代表了视频所显示的内容: 精确的3D变形,只有老师在模拟中看到, 包含了一些关于它的信息.
两个额外的头并不改变z E z_{E}和z Y z_{Y}的差错:老师的差错是0.164和0.196 dex,表S4中的差错是0.161和0.192,学生的差错是0.481和0.356。
